 Beyond the core technical\-win role, the Distinguished FSE is also expected to:
   

  

 Shape the direction of our platforms, and provide direction and oversight to the Product Managers in Platform Engineering.
   

  

 Anticipate technology trends and client needs, keeping the portfolio ahead of the market.
   

  

 Lead and grow the India\-based PoC and Demo team.
   

  

 Set the global standard for demos and coach demo teams worldwide.
   

  

 Drive sales and adoption across our go\-to\-market teams.
   

  

 Publish communications and success stories that build market momentum.
   

  

 Provide mindshare across AI Platforms and to senior levels within the firm.
   

  

 In This Role, You Will
   

  

 Lead technical strategy, influence platform roadmap, build PoC and Demo teams, and represent Cognizant in client and industry engagements.
   

  

 Partners with sales, account and professional services teams as the technical lead on enterprise platform pursuits, owning the technical win from qualification to close.
   

  

 Runs technical discovery to understand a client's engineering, AI, cloud and operations landscape, and maps their outcomes to the right platform or combination of platforms.
   

  

 Designs and presents solution architectures that show how our platforms integrate with the client's existing tooling, hyperscaler footprint and ecosystem partners.
   

  

 Builds and delivers compelling, tailored demonstrations and drives proofs of concept and readiness assessments that de\-risk adoption and prove value.
   

  

 Articulates the commercial and delivery value of platforms — including chargeback, managed\-services and outcome\-based models — and helps quantify productivity, cost and time\-to\-market benefits.
   

  

 Responds to the technical sections of RFPs, RFIs and bid processes, and shapes proposals with credible, defensible solutioning.
   

  

 Represents the platforms at industry events and conferences (e.g. AWS re:Invent, Google Next, Microsoft Ignite) and in cloud\-marketplace and partner motions.
   

  

 Champions the platforms in the market — building client mindshare and establishing Cognizant as a leading software firm and our platforms as best\-in\-class software.
   

  

 Serves as the voice of the field into the platform roadmap — capturing recurring client requirements and field feedback, prioritizing them with our Platform Engineering teams, and shaping where the platforms go next; then takes new capabilities and releases back to clients and the field to drive adoption.
   

  

 Acts as a primary stakeholder to the Product Managers within Platform Engineering — providing direction and oversight on priorities, requirements and release decisions so the roadmap reflects field and client reality.
   

  

 Hands off to our implementation teams and Forward Deployed Engineers for delivery, protecting adoption and reducing churn once a platform is adopted.
   

  

 Identifies opportunities to leverage our Forward Deployed Engineers to drive platform adoption across the client's estate, driving outcomes and creating value for clients.
   

  

 Leads, grows and manages a team of PoC and Demo specialists in India — hiring, coaching, developing talent, managing performance and planning capacity across concurrent pursuits — and mentors FSEs to scale the technical go\-to\-market motion.
   

  

 Defines demo needs and tailors demonstrations for specific audiences — from hands\-on engineers to C\-suite buyers — so each story lands with the right depth and messaging.
   

  

 Trains and coaches our demo teams globally on how to deliver demonstrations and the messaging that goes with them, raising demo quality across the firm.
   

  

 Works continuously across our Commercial, Delivery, Marketing and Solution Architect teams to improve the sales velocity and adoption of the platforms.
   

  

 Publishes timely communications and success stories — client wins, case studies, new releases and platform achievements — to build mindshare internally and in the market.
   

  

 Observes technology trends and evolving client needs, and anticipates which trends our platforms should address proactively — keeping the portfolio ahead of the market.
   

  

 Provides mindshare across AI Platforms leadership — including regular, direct briefings to senior levels within the firm — on field insight, client needs and platform direction.
   

  

 What You Need to Have to Be Considered
   

  

 20\+ years of software, AI, cloud or engineering experience with strong client\-facing leadership and people management skills.
   

  

 A senior software or platform product engineer — for example an advisory/solutions engineer, developer advocate or solution architect for a software product, who has moved decisively into a client\-facing technical go\-to\-market leadership role; experience in software products is valued over IT\-services.
   

  

 On that foundation, 20\-25 years in software, AI, digital and cloud engineering — including 7\+ years in advisory\-led technical conversations on software products and platforms with senior client engineers and architects and C\-suite technology leaders (CTO, CDO, CIO, CAIO).
   

  

 Proven people\-leadership experience — building, managing and developing technical teams (ideally PoC, demo, presales or solutions\-engineering teams), with the maturity to lead a technical team in India across concurrent, high\-stakes pursuits.
   

  

 A product mindset — demonstrated ability to shape product roadmaps, prioritize competing requirements and translate field feedback into product direction, without needing a formal product\-management title.
   

  

 Minimum 2\+ years hands\-on across the AI\-infused Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) — modern engineering and DevSecOps, legacy and cloud modernization for AI readiness, AI assurance (quality testing and performance\-drift monitoring) and run operations (SRE / AIOps) — and the Agent Development Lifecycle (ADLC), building agentic and gen\-AI solutions with large language and performance\-optimized small language models.
   

  

 Working knowledge of our key partner ecosystems — hyperscalers (AWS, Microsoft, Google) and AI\-native providers (Anthropic, OpenAI, NVIDIA) — and the surrounding AI/engineering tooling (LLM providers, orchestration frameworks, CI/CD and observability).
   

  

 Excellent communication and storytelling — able to build and deliver demos, and to write and publish crisp communications and success stories, that translate technical capability into clear business outcomes.
   

  

 Comfort operating in ambiguity, managing multiple pursuits, and collaborating across our Commercial, Delivery, Marketing and Communications, Platform Engineering, Demo and Workshops, Solution Architect and implementation/Forward Deployed Engineering teams.
   

  

 Willingness to travel to client sites, studios and industry events as required.
   

  

 These Will Help You Succeed
   

  

 Hyperscaler certifications, SaaS/PaaS platform experience, product strategy exposure, and marketplace/co\-sell experience.

title: Solution Architect Manager
description:
**Overview**
 Microsoft Industry Solutions Delivery (ISD) is a global organization hosting over 6,000 strategic sellers, industry and security experts, elite engineers, world\-class data scientists and architects, consultants, and delivery specialists. Together with our partners, we help Microsoft’s most strategic customers worldwide to address their specific challenges and provide comprehensive and industry\-specific solutions that meet their unique needs. ISD is at the forefront of innovation, driving value across the entirety of the customers’ digital and AI transformation journey through repeatable and customized cutting\-edge solutions through strategic engagements with customers across the globe powered by Microsoft Cloud and AI.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 People Management
   

  

 Managers deliver success through empowerment and accountability by modeling, coaching, and caring.
   

  

 Model \- Live our culture. Embody our values. Practice our leadership principles.
   

  

 Coach \- Define team objectives and outcomes. Enable success across boundaries. Help the team adapt and learn.
   

  

 Care \- Attract and retain great people. Know each individual’s capabilities and aspirations. Invest in the growth of others.
   

  

 Understanding Customer/Partner Technical Environment
   

  

 Provides support for their team in gathering and propagating customer/partner insights to help shape and form both the definition and ongoing execution of the project. Holds teams accountable for mapping architecture and digital transformation solutions to customer/partner business goals. Leverages prior work, customer/partner insights, and industry trends, and shares insights with team to apply.
   

  

 Supports their team in working with customer/partner stakeholders (e.g., Enterprise Architects, Security Team, Development Team, Operations Team) and business sponsor to socialize both the business solution and the project approach. Advises team on managing changes and facilitating feedback. Contributes to Microsoft\-centric operations and cadences to align with customer feedback.
   

  

 Drives internal advocacy by facilitating insight sharing with Product Engineering teams, and providing guidance through escalation, acceleration, and prioritization. Looks across multiple customers/partners for opportunities to consolidate and prioritize items across the business. When appropriate, establishes accountabilities to drive customer outcomes and ensure internal stakeholders are in place. Ensures that customer opportunities, questions, and/or issues are brought to the appropriate internal teams.
   

  

 Architecture Design and Deployment
   

  

 Holds teams accountable for leveraging existing architecture approaches to achieve Microsoft's agreed commitments to the customer/partner and developing new solutions to scale across multiple customers/partners and markets. When appropriate, governs areas of fiscal responsibility, through delivery team, staying within budget while driving engagement profitability and risk management.
   

  

 Guides team in defining and documenting the architecture through an architecture description document, an architecture decisions log, and a requirements/constraints traceability matrix. Ensures team is equipped to communicate the value proposition of the business solution along with the project approach. Guides team in cost\-based and technology\-based discussions to explain the architecture in terms of its build, deployment, and ongoing operational use to determine customer appetite for the business solution. Promotes a business\-value approach that values return on investment (ROI) and customer costs\-savings over technical ease of execution. Provides coaching to allow architects to scale solutions. Support new customer opportunities in partnership with Sales with highly significant or global impacts for Microsoft, as needed.
   

  

 Collaborates with the other managers to jointly drive project/technical governance of the design, build, and deployment into use of proof of concepts (POCs) and pilots. Provides guidance to team in understanding and demonstrating business value (e.g., release of revenue, cost savings) that the business solution realizes.
   

  

 Guides team in working with the business sponsor and customer/partner stakeholders (e.g., Business users, Enterprise Architects, Security Team, Operations Team) to gather and ratify requirements and constraints. Supports team in managing and resolving complex ambiguity in the requirements and constraints and documents assumptions and implications where it cannot be resolved. Ensures maintenance of the requirements/constraints traceability matrix to prove that solution components have a rationale/justification for inclusion in the Architecture of the business solution. Oversees development and execution of test plans to prove that each requirement/constraint has been implemented as expected by the customer.
   

  

 Leads team in collaborating to understand the business solution/problem. Drives agreement, based on the customer’s priorities, requirements/constraints, approach, principles, concepts, and expectations. Ensures team builds and documents a realistically costed, advanced/complex solution approach. Provides thought leadership on oversight and governance sets expectations for quality practices and standards to realize the business solution. Promotes a cohesive build methodology so the solution can be transitioned to live operations, leveraging solution expertise. Ensures communication of and adherence to the pre\-sales value proposition. Ensures that customer opportunities, questions, and/or issues are brought to the appropriate internal teams. When appropriate, negotiates, collaborates on, reviews, and contributes to deal approval processes. Challenges deal construct to ensure Microsoft initiatives are incorporated appropriately. Communicates current view of delivery to customer executives on regular cadence, as needed. When appropriate, oversees a broad portfolio of accounts. Manages and ensures the all\-up delivery of consulting engagements, as necessary. Innovates and implements long\-term, strategic plans, in partnership with Sales to create new opportunities and sustainable growth for customer accounts across the portfolio, as needed. Ensures delivery team alignment and holds delivery team accountable for delivering on sales strategy.
   

  

 Creates a culture and clarity around technical insights and escalations, and ensures broad sets of projects move forward. Provides support and guidance to team in identifying scenarios that could slow or impede pre\-sales/delivery. Resolves escalations as needed and coaches team on best practices for handling escalations. Ensures that issues and blockers and addressed by the appropriate groups. Identifies patterns in blockers across business areas or a territory. When necessary, attends steering committee meetings with strategic customers to remove blockers and ensure delivery success.
   

  

 Works in close collaboration with the Project Manager and Account Team to identify, categorize, and communicate business and technical risks. Defines risk mitigation activities that are foundational to the project plan. Defines risk contingency plans for invocation should the risk occur. When appropriate, oversees a broad portfolio of accounts. Manages and ensures the all\-up delivery of consulting engagements, as necessary.
   

  

 Practice Development
   

  

 Generates new and/or improvements to existing intellectual property. Connects gaps and patterns across business and technology areas to drive changes. Identifies which ideas should be culled, with consideration for scale across customers. Drives the re\-use of intellectual property and recommends practices in both pre\-sales and delivery. Participates and contributes to internal/external communities.
   

  

 Trusted Advisor
   

  

 Develops a network of internal/external relationships with senior\-level decision makers to build influence in addressing problems/blockers and facilitating additional views on the matter of interest. Acts as an advisor to external stakeholders. Provides direction to facilitate relationships between others. Stays up to date on Microsoft’s technologies, products, and services in order to communicate Microsoft's mission, strategy, and capabilities. When appropriate, develops a strategic relationship with key stakeholders within the customer portfolio, often as part of a steering committee, to ensure service delivery is on track and major issues are being anticipated, identified, and managed.
   

  

 Coaches team to use evidence\-based arguments that articulate complex concepts in a simple manner to respectfully challenge Microsoft and customers/partners when a decision or course of action will not produce optimal results. Leverages strategic expertise to encourage alternative approaches where applicable. Serves as the "technical conscience" to challenge the status quo and unrealistic expectations. Proactively resolves conflicts and seeks resolution to balance the overall outcome. Drives consensus where possible and leads decisions to resolve conflict when needed and guides team in doing so.
   

  

 Provides their team with a holistic perspective of customer/partner challenges, industry trends, and competitor architectures to allow team members to engage with customers/partners, demonstrate Microsoft's value, and develop counter strategy.
   

  

 Thought Leadership
   

  

 Fosters community sharing of stories and leveraging of pre\-existing resources by encouraging and empowering team to share learnings and by establishing a cadence (e.g., internal technical brainstorming calls, presenting latest challenges in staff meetings) to calibrate on challenges and trends that impact the team across the subsidiary level. Holds teams accountable for sharing insights with v\-team members to inform the direction they take with customers/partners.
   

  

 Participates in external architect community events (e.g., conferences, seminars, technical meetups, Webcasts, blogs, hackathons) and shares learnings with internal team. Acts a mentor to less experienced colleagues by educating them on technical and non\-technical concepts and sharing best practices. Demonstrates deep industry knowledge and drives recognition for Microsoft solutions through presentations and engagements with external audiences.
   

  

**Other**
 Embody our culture and values
   

  

**Qualifications**
 Required/Minimum Qualifications
   

  

 Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field AND 8\+ years' experience in technology solutions, practice development, architecture, consulting, and/or technology domain (e.g., Security)
   

  

 OR master's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field AND 6\+ years' experience in technology solutions, practice development, architecture, consulting, and/or technology domain (e.g., Security)
   

  

 OR equivalent experience.
   

  

**Additional Or Preferred Qualifications**
 Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field AND 12\+ years' experience in technology solutions, practice development, architecture, consulting, and/or technology domain (e.g., Security)
   

  

 OR master's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field AND 8\+ years' experience in technology solutions, practice development, architecture, consulting, and/or technology domain (e.g., Security)
   

  

 OR equivalent experience.
   

  

 6\+ years technical sales experience.
   

  

 6\+ years project management experience.
   

  

 2\+ years managing multiple projects or portfolios.
   

  

 1\+ year(s) experience leading blended, multidisciplinary teams.
   

  

 3\+ years people management experience, including managing consultant practice managers, technical sales managers, and/or technical architect managers.
   

  

 Technical or Professional Certification in Domain (e.g., Security).
   

  

 This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.
   

  

 Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. If you need assistance with religious accommodations and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application process, read more about
 **requesting accommodations.**

title: SAP TM Global Solution Architect
description:
**The opportunity**
 At Hitachi Energy, we are accelerating our digital transformation journey by optimizing and modernizing global transportation and logistics operations. As a SAP TM Solution Architect, you will play a critical role in defining, designing, implementing, and supporting enterprise\-wide transportation management solutions that enable efficient, scalable, and intelligent logistics processes across our global business landscape.
   

  

 In this role, you will combine transportation management expertise, solution architecture leadership, and emerging technologies such as SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) and Artificial Intelligence (AI) to drive innovation and operational excellence. You will lead SAP TM transformation initiatives, define strategic roadmaps, and deliver robust, integrated logistics solutions aligned with business objectives and enterprise architecture standards.
   

  

**How You'll Make An Impact**
* Define and govern the SAP TM solution architecture strategy, standards, and roadmap across global business functions.
* Design scalable, standardized, and best\-practice transportation management processes that support global logistics operations.
* Ensure solution alignment with enterprise architecture principles, cybersecurity requirements, compliance regulations, and digital transformation objectives.
* Lead architecture reviews, solution governance forums, and technical decision\-making processes.
* Design and optimize SAP TM capabilities including Freight Unit Building, Transportation Planning, Load Planning and Optimization, Carrier Selection, Freight Order Management, Transportation Execution, Freight Settlement, Cost Allocation, Charge Management, Logistics Visibility, and Event Tracking.
* Drive global standardization and harmonization of transportation management processes and solutions.
* Provide technical leadership for SAP TM solution development and architecture.
* Review and approve technical designs, enhancements, custom developments, and solution integrations.
* Deliver expertise in ABAP OO, BOPF Framework, FPM Applications, CDS Views, OData Services, APIs, Enhancement Framework, Workflow, and BRF\+.
* Architect SAP BTP\-based extensions, integrations, and cloud\-native transportation management solutions.
* Evaluate and implement innovative technologies and digital capabilities that improve transportation planning, visibility, and execution.
* Enable event\-driven and API\-based architectures to support modern business processes and integrations.
* Define and lead AI\-enabled transportation optimization strategies.
* Evaluate AI and machine learning use cases including route optimization, shipment consolidation, predictive freight planning, load planning optimization, transportation exception management, and logistics cost optimization.
* Support the integration of AI services within SAP solutions and external platforms.
* Lead adoption and integration of SAP Business Network for Logistics (BN4L), including carrier collaboration, freight tendering, shipment tracking, and logistics visibility capabilities.
* Strengthen collaboration with carriers, freight forwarders, logistics providers, and external business partners.
* Define end\-to\-end integration architecture between SAP TM and connected systems, including SAP S/4HANA, SAP EWM, SAP GTS, SAP BTP, BN4L, third\-party logistics providers, and external carrier platforms.
* Ensure reliable, scalable, and secure integrations using APIs, IDocs, events, middleware technologies, and SAP Integration Suite.
* Act as the senior escalation point for critical SAP TM issues and support complex incident resolution activities.
* Conduct root cause analysis, provide solution recommendations, and drive continuous improvement initiatives.
* Mentor and guide functional consultants, developers, and project teams to build organizational capability and best practices.


**Your background**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Supply Chain Management, or a related discipline.
* Minimum 10 years of SAP experience, with at least 7 years of hands\-on expertise in SAP Transportation Management (SAP TM).
* Proven experience as an SAP TM Solution Architect within complex global organizations.
* Strong expertise in transportation management, logistics operations, freight management, and supply chain processes.
* Experience delivering global SAP implementation, transformation, and rollout programs.
* Deep knowledge of SAP Transportation Management (SAP TM) and SAP S/4HANA TM.
* Experience with SAP Business Network for Logistics (BN4L), SAP BTP, SAP EWM, and SAP GTS.
* Strong technical architecture knowledge covering ABAP OO, BOPF, FPM, CDS Views, OData Services, APIs, BRF\+, Enhancement Framework, and SAP Integration Suite.
* Experience with RAP (RESTful Application Programming Model) is preferred.
* Strong understanding of cloud\-based architectures, integration patterns, and event\-driven solutions.
* Familiarity with AI and machine learning applications in transportation and logistics domains is highly desirable.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, leadership, and problem\-solving skills.
* Demonstrates effective use of AI and digital tools to enhance problem\-solving, decision\-making, and productivity, while applying sound judgment, ensuring accuracy and compliance, and maintaining accountability for outcomes.
* Ability to work effectively in a global, cross\-functional, and multicultural environment.

title: Sr. Engineer - Endpoint security | On-Site, Bangalore

description:
**Hungry, Humble, Honest, with Heart.**
**The Opportunity**
 Founded in 2009 and headquartered in San Jose, California, Nutanix is a global leader in cloud software and a pioneer in hyperconverged infrastructure (HCI) solutions. With a passionate team of over 6,000 employees worldwide (affectionately known as "Nutants"), we make computing invisible anywhere. Companies around the world rely on Nutanix software to manage any app, at any location, and at any scale across private, hybrid, and multi\-cloud environments. We value intellectual curiosity, a bias for action, customer obsession, and an entrepreneurial spirit. Nutanix welcomes builders who thrive on tackling seemingly impossible challenges while celebrating what makes each of us unique.
   

  

 As a senior staff engineer, you will serve as a key technical leader and architect for the NKP team. This is a high\-impact, hands\-on leadership role where you will look beyond single\-cluster management to solve "fleet\-scale" problems—designing systems that manage tens of thousands of clusters across hybrid and multi\-cloud environments. You will bridge the gap between Nutanix’s core infrastructure and the evolving CNCF ecosystem.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The Nutanix Cloud Native team is at the forefront of building the next generation of enterprise infrastructure. Nutanix Kubernetes Platform (NKP), a complete, enterprise\-grade solution that simplifies Kubernetes operations across hybrid, edge, and multi\-cloud environments.
   

  

 Our mission is to make NKP the foundational layer for all modern workloads. We are solving complex distributed systems challenges in fleet management, multi\-tenancy, and edge computing to deliver a robust, scalable control plane.
   

  

 You will report to the engineering leader at Nutanix. The work setup is hybrid, allowing for flexibility and a healthy work\-life balance. As a new hire, you will be expected to work from the office three days a week, ensuring face\-to\-face interactions with your team members and promoting a sense of camaraderie and community within the team.
   

  

**Your Role**
 Architectural Strategy: Lead the design of critical NKP components with a focus on multi\-tenancy, resilience, and "Fleet Management". You will ensure NKP operates reliably at the Edge and in resource\-constrained environments.
   

  

 Force Multiplier: Act as a technical "bar\-raiser". " You will lead and mentor a distributed team of 5\-10 engineers, driving excellence through design reviews, coding standards, and a culture of technical curiosity.
   

  

 Cross\-Functional Leadership: Partner with Product Management, the Data Services (NDK) team, and Core Hybrid Cloud teams to translate high\-level business goals into technical roadmaps for stateful workloads and disaster recovery.
   

  

 Community \& Innovation: Represent Nutanix in the open\-source community. Contribute to upstream CNCF projects (Cluster API, Kappa, etc.), file patents, and author white papers that define the future of hybrid cloud.
   

  

 Operational Excellence: Engage with customers and support teams to resolve complex production issues, ensuring our platform meets the highest standards of scale and user experience.
   

  

**What You Will Bring**
 Experience: 12\+ years of software development experience within product\-led companies, with a significant tenure architecting and shipping large\-scale distributed systems. Technical: Rock\-solid proficiency in Go, Python, or Java. While deep K8s internals (controllers, API machinery) are a plus, we value "systems thinkers" who can master new stacks quickly.
   

  

 Domain Expertise: A proven track record in cloud\-native systems, Docker/containers, and large\-scale control plane management is a great plus. Leadership: You can navigate ambiguity, drive consensus across multiple teams, and balance long\-term innovation with short\-term risk/reward trade\-offs.
   

  

 Education: BS/MS/PhD in Computer Science or a related field.
   

  

**Work Arrangement**
 Hybrid: This role operates in a hybrid capacity, blending the benefits of remote work with the advantages of in\-person collaboration. In locations where our workplace policy applies (i.e. San Jose, Durham, Mexico City, Bangalore, Pune, Hoofddorp, Belgrade, Barcelona, Singapore, Sydney and Tokyo), employees are expected to work onsite a minimum of 3 days per week to foster collaboration, team alignment, and access to in\-office resources. Workplace type may vary based on location and team requirements. Please speak with your recruiter for details. Additional team\-specific guidance and norms will be provided by your manager.

 – Experience with authorization policy engines (OPA, Casbin, or equivalent) and modeling complex permission structures.
   

  

 – Familiarity with multi\-tenant isolation patterns and the security implications of getting them wrong.
   

  

 – Comfort in an AWS/EKS environment with secrets management (AWS Secrets Manager, Vault).

description:
Qdrant is an
 **open\-source vector** 
 search engine powering the next generation of AI applications, from semantic search and retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) to AI agents and real\-time recommendations.
   

  

 Trusted by global leaders like
 **Canva, HubSpot, Tripadvisor, Bosch, and Deutsche Telekom** 
 , we’re building the retrieval infrastructure layer for modern AI. Recently raising
 **$50M in Series B** 
 funding, we are growing rapidly and committed to transforming how AI understands and interacts with data.
   

  

 As a remote\-first company, we believe diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences fuel innovation. Here, you’ll own meaningful work, tackle challenges, and grow alongside passionate individuals dedicated to shaping the future of AI.
   

  

 As we expand our presence across Asia\-Pacific, we're looking for a
 **Senior Solutions Engineer** 
 to be the technical authority in deals that determine how enterprises build AI infrastructure for the next decade, and the trusted technical owner for our most strategic accounts in the region. Most SE roles are demo cycles. This one is different.
   

  

 You'll work directly with Staff Engineers and CTOs, architect real systems, and own the technical outcome of every engagement you touch, from a first prospect call through to expansion conversations with customers you already support. We care more about time\-zone overlap with our regional accounts than a specific city, so this role is open to candidates based anywhere aligned with major APAC hubs like India, Singapore, Japan, or Australia.
   

  

****What you will own:****
* Own the technical strategy in enterprise deals from first call to production deployment, partnering with Account Executives to qualify, architect, and close for our entire Asian\-Pacific client base
* Act as a Technical Account Manager for a small portfolio of existing enterprise customers in the region alongside active prospects, identifying new use cases, expansion opportunities, and upsell paths, and looping in Account Executives and internal resources to advocate for the customer.
* Design vector search architectures for high\-scale workloads, including multi\-tenant agentic systems, hybrid search pipelines, and low\-latency retrieval at billion\-vector scale.
* Build proof\-of\-concept systems that customers take to production (not throw away), demonstrating Qdrant's performance advantages over JVM\-based or proprietary alternatives.
* Serve as a trusted advisor on AI infrastructure decisions, helping customers navigate migration from legacy databases, avoid architectural lock\-in, and deploy across cloud, on\-prem, or air\-gapped environments.
* Contribute to the field engineering knowledge base: reference architectures, technical guides, and reusable POC frameworks that scale the team's impact.


****Who you are****
* 5\+ years of pre\-sales or solutions engineering, ideally with a background in data infrastructure or systems architecture. Hands\-on infrastructure depth alone isn't enough, we need a proven track record running technical qualification and proof\-of\-concept processes within a live sales cycle.
* Experience designing or operating distributed systems, search infrastructure, or data pipelines at production scale.
* Ideally, hands\-on experience with RAG (retrieval\-augmented generation) pipelines specifically, plus working knowledge of the broader modern AI stack (LLMs, embedding models, agentic frameworks).
* Ideally, working knowledge of a structured sales qualification framework such as MEDDICC/MEDDPICC, and the ability to apply it in real deal conversations, connecting technical decisions to business outcomes and deal strategy.
* Strong communicator across audiences: you can go deep on indexing trade\-offs with a Staff Engineer and explain infrastructure ROI to a CIO in the same afternoon.


****Nice to have****
* Experience with vector search, approximate nearest neighbor algorithms, or semantic retrieval systems.
* Background with Rust, C\+\+, or other systems languages.
* Familiarity with deployment patterns: Kubernetes, hybrid cloud, on\-prem, or air\-gapped environments.


****Why join us****
* A remote\-first, international team working on cutting\-edge AI infrastructure.
* A competitive salary with additional perks.
* Flexible working hours and async\-friendly culture.
* High ownership and real impact.
* Open\-source, engineering\-driven culture.
* Choose your own laptop equipment.


 For US\-based full\-time employees, we also offer a comprehensive benefits package including 401k match, health, dental, and vision insurance, plus flexible PTO policy.
   

  

 Qdrant is an equal\-opportunity employer. We believe the best ideas come from diverse teams, and we actively welcome applicants from all backgrounds. If this role excites you but you don't check every single box, we'd still love to hear from you! We don't want to miss out on great people because of a checklist.
   

  

**Come build with us!**
 For information on how we handle your personal data, please refer to our Recruitment Privacy Policy

**Calling all innovators – find your future at Fiserv.**


We’re Fiserv, a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. We connect financial institutions, corporations, merchants, and consumers to one another millions of times a day – quickly, reliably, and securely. Any time you swipe your credit card, pay through a mobile app, or withdraw money from the bank, we’re involved. If you want to make an impact on a global scale, come make a difference at Fiserv.

**Job Title**


Advisor, Product Delivery**What does a successful Product Owner do at Fiserv?**


The Product Owner (PO) s responsible for maximizing the value delivered by the team and ensuring that the Team Backlog is aligned with customer and stakeholder needs. The PO is the team’s primary customer advocate and primary link to business and technology strategy. This enables the team to balance the needs of multiple stakeholders while continuously evolving the Solution.


The PO represents the needs of customers and the business within a particular Solution domain, which is typically co\-represented by a Product Manager. Together, they ensure that product strategy and implementation remain connected throughout the value stream. Serving as the ‘voice of the customer’ for the team entails a broad range of responsibilities. The PO must build and manage key relationships, synthesize information from multiple sources, maintain business alignment in the Team Backlog, and communicate effectively with a variety of audiences—all with a bias toward delivering, and learning, quickly.


The PO is ultimately responsible for maximizing the value delivered by the Agile team, which requires the PO to ensure that the right solutions are built and that they are built the right way. However, the PO cannot accomplish this alone. Building the right solutions requires deep knowledge of business strategy, customer segments, market dynamics, and value stream economics. The PO establishes a close relationship with Product Management to derive these macro\-level insights and apply them to specific product domains. Building solutions the right way requires Team and Technical Agility, DevOps practices, and a Continuous Delivery Pipeline. These technical capabilities determine the speed and quality with which value can be delivered, and the PO relies on the Agile team to provide them. The PO provides a crucial link in the bi\-directional information flow between Product Management and the Agile team. As shown in Figure 2, the PO keeps the Agile team informed of the strategy that drives product design and keeps Product Management informed of the innovations that influence the evolution of product strategy. Customer feedback aligns thinking from strategy through execution and is accessible to all roles.

**What you will do:**

* The PO, in close partnership with Product Management, applies a customer\-centric mindset along with design thinking tools to guide the team toward delivering solutions that are desirable, viable, feasible, and sustainable.
* The PO must understand what solutions and experiences the teams can deliver. This practical insight is a valuable contribution to the vision and roadmaps that guide solution implementation.
* In collaboration with Product Management, System Architects, Delivery Management and other stakeholders, POs help guide the sequencing of features over time toward the best economic outcomes. Through their understanding of which problems need to be solved, which solutions would best solve them, and the feasibility of delivering those solutions, POs help ensure that the vision and roadmap are reflected in the Jira Project Backlog.
* The PO should communicate the vision and roadmap during PI Planning to ensure teams are aligned and ready to execute against them.
* It is the PO’s responsibility to ensure that they are well\-formed and aligned with product strategy. The PO clarifies story details, applies user\-story voice, ensures ‘INVEST’ characteristics are present, assists with story splitting, defines enablers, and incorporates behavior\-driven design (BDD) to ensure stories support continuous value flow. The PO also allows space for ‘local’ stories and spikes that advance product design but are not derived explicitly from the strategic roadmap.
* Achieving continuous value flow requires that the highest\-value backlog items are delivered in the shortest sustainable lead time and in the right sequence. The PO enables this by regularly ordering backlog items according to their cost of delay and communicating that sequence to the team during backlog refinement
* The PO works with the team to agree on accepted story completion. This includes validating that the story meets acceptance criteria, that it has the appropriate, persistent acceptance tests, and that it otherwise complies with its Definition of Done (DoD). In so doing, the PO assures that quality is built in.
* POs facilitate frequent conversations with their teams to resolve questions, manage dependencies, and communicate priorities that emerge as stories are implemented. This information also helps the team slice stories effectively to achieve increased velocity and shortened learning cycles.
* The PO regularly evaluates progress toward story acceptance criteria, including compliance with Built\-In\-Quality criteria, such as the scalable definition of done, and non\-functional requirements (NFRs). The PO works closely with the team to detect quality issues as they are introduced and correct them in or near real time.
* As a member of the Agile team, the PO attends and actively participates in team events during PI execution. During iteration planning, backlog refinement, iteration reviews, team retrospectives, and team syncs, the PO provides crucial feedback on the team’s work from an outside\-in, customer\-centric point of view. By participating in PO Sync and System Demos, the PO helps the team satisfy dependencies, demonstrate incremental value, and maintain cadence with the roadmap.
* The PO collects and shares feedback with Product Management and System Architects as part of Continuous Exploration, with their teams during backlog refinement, iteration planning, and iteration reviews, system demos, and, if applicable, Inspect and Adapt events.

**What you will need to have:**

* Degree or equivalent experience
* 5 \+ years relevant experience in the Fintech sector
* Extensive Agile experience preferably with a recognised Product Owner certification
* Proven track record of managing a complex product backlog for delivery through regular refinement and prioritisation
* Experience in delivering a new product from inception to market/live
* Expert in User Story and Acceptance criteria creation, coaching and review
* Great communication and meeting facilitation skills
* Experience in managing and developing team members
* Expert in defining success criteria and creating meaningful reporting through the use of metrics and empirical measurements
* International travel may be required
* Strong verbal, written and organizational skills; strong customer orientation
* Ability to prioritise
* Pro\-active approach in meeting agreed deadlines
* Committed to clients and to delivery
* Strong analysis skills; tenacious, determined, interested in detail
* Strong document\-writing ability
* Quality\-focused, with attention to detail, good use of language (proficient with Word, Excel PowerPoint, Visio), familiarity with Jira and Confluence tools.
* Ability to adapt to different situations; Clients, technical requirements, business outputs
* Organised; analysis and documentation must follow pre\-determined project methodologies
* Present information to / illicit relevant information from stakeholders with ease
* Flexible
* Project and Process Management

**What would be great to have:**

* 2\+ years of experience in defining and implementing the security architecture of enterprise applications within the .NET family.
* 2\+ years of experience with SQL Server and other relational databases.
* Knowledge of tools and testing approaches such as AppScan, Burp Proxy, Sonar, and Coverity.
* Experience in the printing domain.
* Extensive experience in Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) methodologies such as Agile/Scrum and waterfall.
* Ability to gather requirements, translate them into technical design, and guide teams through implementation.

As a Solution Architect (E30\), you will design and deliver new services on Microsoft Azure aligned with Pearson’s enterprise standards. Your remit includes the development of secure, scalable solution architectures, while ensuring integration across legacy on\-premise and AWS components where needed. You will collaborate with product owners, business analysts, delivery teams (including technical architects and developers) and external partners to convert business requirements into effective technical solutions. This includes evaluating solution options, estimating costs and ensuring that designs meet both functional and non\-functional requirements (e.g. security, performance, availability, scalability). Clear communication and stakeholder engagement are essential in this role.


**Key Responsibilities**

* Solution Architecture Design: Lead the design of end\-to\-end solutions on Azure (and advise on on\-premise or AWS where needed), selecting optimal services and patterns to meet both functional and non\-functional requirements. Produce architecture blueprints, dataflows and interface specifications.
* Solution Option Analysis \& Cost Estimation: Work with business analysts and product owners to evaluate multiple solution options, ensuring the trade\-offs are understood. Provide cost and effort estimations (including infrastructure, licensing and operational considerations), and help recommend solutions that balance performance, scalability and total cost of ownership.
* Technical Leadership \& Governance: Serve as design authority throughout delivery. Provide guidance, mentoring and quality assurance to delivery teams and third\-party partners. Develop and refine architectural standards where gaps exist to ensure consistent best practices.
* Support Delivery Teams: Collaborate closely with delivery teams—including technical architects, developers, testers and DevOps engineers—to interpret and implement architecture designs correctly. Assist with troubleshooting technical issues, and ensure that Technical Architects and developers share a common understanding of architecture decisions and design patterns.
* Stakeholder Collaboration: Engage with product owners, business analysts, subject matter experts and external partners to refine requirements. Communicate complex technical concepts clearly to diverse audiences, ensuring alignment and shared understanding.

* Documentation \& Planning: Produce system diagrams, interface specifications and implementation roadmaps. Ensure design decisions are thoroughly documented and communicated.
* Innovation \& Continuous Improvement: Monitor industry trends and evaluate new technologies (e.g. infrastructure automation, AI, data platforms) for relevance to Pearson. Propose enhancements that support robust, modern and cost\-effective solutions.
* Compliance \& Security: Ensure all solutions comply with Pearson’s security and data privacy standards. Participate in design reviews and governance forums to ensure compliance with enterprise architecture policies.
* Lifecycle Support: Support implementation teams from development through deployment, addressing technical issues and ensuring solutions deliver the intended business value.

**Essential Experience \& Skills**

* Extensive Solution Architecture Experience: Proven track record of designing and implementing complex enterprise solutions, with a strong emphasis on Azure cloud services and cloud\-native principles.
* Architecture \& Design Expertise: Ability to produce architecture blueprints, dataflows, integration diagrams and detailed specifications.
* Cloud Proficiency: Deep understanding of Azure compute, storage, networking, security and infrastructure\-as\-code (e.g. ARM, Terraform). Familiarity with cybersecurity best practices.
* Technical Leadership \& Collaboration: Experience overseeing design implementation, defining architectural standards and providing technical guidance to teams and vendors.
* Solution Analysis \& Cost Estimation: Ability to evaluate solution options and provide well\-reasoned recommendations based on technical fit, effort and cost.
* Stakeholder Engagement: Strong communication and interpersonal skills; able to articulate architecture rationale to technical and non\-technical stakeholders and foster alignment.
* Problem Solving \& Adaptability: Proven analytical skills and adaptability; comfortable working in dynamic environments and adjusting solutions as requirements evolve.
* Business Insight: Ability to balance technology decisions with business outcomes to ensure solutions deliver value.
* Education \& Certification: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field; Master’s degree and/or relevant certifications (e.g. BCS Intermediate Certificate in Enterprise Architecture, Azure Solutions Architect Expert) are highly regarded.

**Desirable Skills**

* Knowledge of relational databases, data modelling and data analytics solutions.
* Familiarity with DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines and containerisation (e.g. Docker, Kubernetes).
* Experience with Agile methodologies, TDD and other modern development practices.
* Programming/scripting for automation (PowerShell, Python).
* Good understanding of AWS PaaS services (such as RDS/SQL, SNS, Aurora) to support integrated or legacy components.
* Understanding of business continuity and disaster recovery planning.
* Awareness of AI/ML and emerging technologies and their impact on architecture.

**Job Location and Hours**

The role is aligned to our Bangalore or Chennai offices in India, working a 45 hour week. All our roles are hybrid working; our current policy requires our team to work from their base office 3 times per week.

At Pearson, our purpose is simple: to help people realize the life they imagine through learning. We believe that every learning opportunity is a chance for a personal breakthrough. description:
Introduction
   

  

**Job Title:** 
 Technical Architect
   

  

**About SymphonyAI Retail:**
 SymphonyAI Retail is a leading provider of advanced AI\-driven solutions and services specifically designed for the retail industry. We empower retailers and consumer packaged goods (CPG) companies with innovative technology to enhance their operations, optimize decision\-making, and deliver exceptional customer experiences. SymphonyAI Retail is a global leader in the supply of integrated business solutions to organizations worldwide, serving 30 of the top 50 global grocery retailers and numerous consumer brands.
   

  

**Overview:**
 We are seeking a highly experienced Technical Architect for the SCM GOLD platform to lead the design and delivery of complex retail supply chain implementations. This role requires deep expertise across both functional supply chain processes and technical architecture, with the ability to translate business requirements into scalable solution designs. The Architect will work closely with clients, Professional Services, R\&D, and partner teams to ensure successful implementation, integration, and deployment of SCM GOLD solutions across large\-scale retail environments. This role is critical for high\-visibility programs and will provide architectural leadership from solution design through implementation, UAT, and production cutover.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Key Responsibilities:**
**Solution Architecture \& Design:**
* Lead end\-to\-end solution architecture for SCM GOLD implementations, ensuring alignment with client business goals and SymphonyAI product capabilities.
* Translate complex retail supply chain requirements into scalable functional and technical solution designs.
* Define system architecture, integration frameworks, and configuration strategy across SCM GOLD modules.
* Guide design decisions across forecasting, replenishment, inventory optimization, and supply chain planning capabilities.


**Technical Leadership:**
* Provide hands\-on architectural guidance for system configuration, customization, integrations, and performance optimization.
* Partner closely with R\&D teams to ensure product capabilities align with client requirements and implementation strategy.
* Support technical teams in resolving complex implementation challenges and architectural trade\-offs.
* Ensure best practices across data architecture, APIs, and system integrations.


**Client and Stakeholder Engagement:**
* Lead technical and functional discussions with client executives, program leaders, and technical teams.
* Act as the primary architecture authority during design workshops, solution reviews, and executive checkpoints.
* Provide architectural guidance during UAT, testing cycles, and production deployment.
* Support client change management and adoption of SCM GOLD capabilities.


**Program Delivery Support:**
* Collaborate with Professional Services, Partner Delivery teams, and Implementation Leads to ensure solution integrity throughout the program lifecycle.
* Provide oversight during key delivery phases including design validation, system build, UAT readiness, and production cutover.
* Support risk mitigation and architectural governance for complex implementations.


**Technical Skills:**
* Hands\-on experience in:
+ Solid understanding of System Design \& Architecture and Integration.
+ Solid understanding of Java (core Java).
+ Solid understanding of REST APIs.
+ Solid understanding of database concepts (preferably Oracle), SQL, and PL/SQL.
+ Solid understanding of Shell scripting.
+ Fair understanding of JavaScript/HTML/CSS\-based applications implementation.
+ Basic understanding of Vue/React\-based applications implementation.


**Other Experience:**
* 10\+ years of experience in retail supply chain technology implementations.
* Deep expertise in SymphonyAI SCM GOLD platform (technical and functional) is a plus but not essential.
* Proven experience designing and delivering large\-scale supply chain planning solutions.
* Strong understanding of retail planning, forecasting, replenishment, and inventory optimization processes.
* Experience working across solution architecture, system integration, and enterprise deployment.
* Ability to lead complex client\-facing discussions with both business and technical stakeholders.
* Experience collaborating with product teams, delivery teams, and global partners.
* Good understanding of cloud platforms.


**Preferred Qualifications:**
* Experience delivering large enterprise retail transformation programs.
* Strong background in supply chain data architecture and system integration.
* Experience supporting UAT, testing governance, and deployment strategies.
* Ability to mentor implementation teams and guide architectural best practices.


**Diversity \& Inclusion Statement:**
 We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.
   

  

**About Us**
 SymphonyAI is building the leading enterprise AI SaaS company for digital transformation across the most critical and resilient growth industries, including retail, consumer packaged goods, financial crime prevention, manufacturing, media, and enterprise IT. Since its founding in 2017, SymphonyAI has grown to today serve 2000\+ Enterprise customers globally and has grown to 2,500 talented leaders, data scientists, and other professionals across over 30 countries.

description:
Director of Software Engineering
 



  





 Medical Enterprise \| Dental Healthcare \| Greater Bengaluru Area \| Hybrid
 



  





 About the Client
 



 Our client is a high\-growth medical enterprise serving major US clients across the dental and broader
 



 healthcare ecosystem. The company operates a vertically integrated, subscription\-led procurement and
 



 supply\-chain platform spanning dental, veterinary, lab, and adjacent medical categories. The business is
 



 revenue positive and is scaling into a broader healthcare enterprise platform.
 



 The Role
 



 This is a hands\-on engineering leadership role for a Founding Engineer / VP Engineering\-type profile.
 



 You will lead a 10–15 member engineering team while owning system design, software architecture,
 



 delivery execution, and people leadership. Architecture and execution are the primary evaluation areas;
 



 this is not a management\-only role.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 



 ● Lead a 10–15 member engineering team, with responsibility for hiring, coaching, performance, team
 



 development, and delivery.
 



 ● Own system design and software architecture for scalable, data\-heavy, distributed and cloud\-native
 



 platforms; lead architecture reviews and key technical decisions.
 



 ● Stay hands\-on enough to challenge designs, review critical technical decisions, guide implementation,
 



 and unblock engineering teams while driving predictable execution.
 



 ● Scale the engineering platform and organization sustainably—improving reliability, observability, code
 



 quality, testing, CI/CD, release processes, and technical debt.
 



 ● Drive AI transformation across the SDLC using Applied AI for code generation, testing, developer
 



 productivity, workflow automation, evaluation, and engineering\-process improvement.
 



 ● Evaluate new technologies and establish pragmatic engineering standards, development
 



 methodologies, and best practices as the company scales.
 



 ● Partner closely with Product, Data, and Operations to evolve the business from a scale\-up into a
 



 broader medical/dental enterprise ecosystem.
 



 What We’re Looking For
 



 ● 12–15\+ years of software engineering experience preferred; 10\+ years is the bare minimum for
 



 exceptional candidates with strong architecture and leadership depth.
 



 ● Strong product\-company background, ideally in data\-heavy Series A, B, or C startups or bootstrapped
 



 scale\-ups; Founding Engineer, early engineering leader, or VP Engineering\-type experience is highly
 



 relevant.
 



 ● Deep expertise in SYSTEM DESIGN and SOFTWARE ARCHITECTURE, combined with people
 



 management and hands\-on technical leadership—not a management\-only profile.
 



 ● Proven experience scaling an engineering team from single digits to at least 10–15 people;
 



 experience building or leading a 30\+ person engineering organization is strongly preferred.
 



 ● Track record of scaling products through significant revenue growth; ideally part of a profitable $10M
 



 → $100M ARR journey with sustainable engineering practices.
 



  





 ● Strong backend/architecture experience with Python, Node.js, and/or Go, plus Kafka, RabbitMQ,
 



 Terraform, and modern cloud\-Strong fundamentals in distributed systems, event\-driven architecture,
 



 data design, service boundaries, scalability, reliability, and observability.
 



 ● Practical Applied AI experience, especially AI\-led SDLC transformation across code generation,
 



 testing, automation, developer workflows, evaluation/observability, and production reliability. Model
 



 fine\-tuning is a plus.
 



 ● Strong delivery execution, stakeholder management, agile development practices, communication,
 



 and ability to build high\-performing teams in fast\-growth environments.
 



 ● Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, a related technical field, or
 



 equivalent practical experience.
 



 Nice to Have
 



 ● Domain exposure to dental, healthcare, medical supply chain, procurement, veterinary, lab platforms,
 



 marketplaces, or other data\-heavy enterprise products.
 



 ● Experience serving major US customers and scaling a lean startup/scale\-up into a mature enterprise
 



 platform ecosystem.

**About Us:** 




 Zendesk is a leader in customer experience solutions, dedicated to delivering innovative technology and exceptional service. Our Contact Center Center of Excellence (CoE) focuses on optimizing customer support platforms, including Zendesk, Amazon Connect, and AWS\-based solutions, to enhance customer interactions and operational efficiency.
 



  





**Position Overview** 




 We are seeking a seasoned Contact Center Partner Solutions Consultant with deep expertise in contact center technologies and CX Suites—preferably Zendesk, Amazon Connect, and AWS—with a strong focus on partner onboarding, technical enablement, and co\-selling support. This role will lead partner technical enablement efforts, ensuring partners are fully equipped and supported to resell and implement Zendesk Contact Center solutions effectively. The ideal candidate will provide strategic direction, technical leadership, and hands\-on expertise to drive partner success and seamless integration of contact center solutions.
 



  





**Core Daily Activities** 



* Partner Onboarding and Enablement: Drive the technical onboarding process for partners, ensuring they acquire the skills and knowledge necessary to successfully implement and resell Zendesk Contact Center solutions.
* Co\-Sell Technical Support: Collaborate closely with partners during co\-sell engagements, providing expert technical guidance and solving complex implementation challenges.
* Architect and Optimize Contact Center Solutions: Design scalable and efficient architectures leveraging Amazon Connect, AWS, and Zendesk to support partner deployments.
* Lead Technical Strategy and Partner Roadmap: Define technical enablement strategies aligned with partner needs and evolving business goals.
* Provide Technical Leadership and Mentorship: Coach partners, internal teams, and presales specialists on best practices in solution design and deployment.
* Drive Innovation and Emerging Technology Adoption: Stay updated on AI, ML, and automation trends in contact centers to continuously improve partner technical capabilities.
* Support Pre\-Sales and Post\-Sales Activities with Partners: Support technical discovery, solution design, demonstrations, PoCs, and ongoing partner support.
* Develop Enablement Materials: Create technical documentation, playbooks, and training content tailored for partner consumption.



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Partner Success Focus: Own the technical onboarding and enablement process for partners, reducing onboarding friction and accelerating time to market.
* Strategic Leadership: Define and execute the architectural vision for partner\-facing contact center solutions within the CoE framework.
* Technical Oversight: Support and guide partners and internal teams to adhere to architectural best practices, security standards, and delivery excellence.
* Collaboration: Work with partner sales leads, sales, and engineering teams to align on technical requirements, scope, and co\-sell strategies.
* Innovation Advocacy: Promote adoption of the latest contact center technologies and best practices with partners.
* Governance and Compliance: Ensure partner solutions meet compliance, security, and governance requirements.



  





**Qualifications** 



* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or Business Administration.
* Experience: Minimum of 10 years in solution architecture, with at least 5 years focused on contact center technologies including Amazon Connect and Zendesk, with partner\-facing or customer enablement experience preferred.
* Technical Expertise: Proficient designing solutions using Zendesk, Amazon Connect, AWS services (Lambda, Lex, IAM, DynamoDB, S3, API Gateway). Experience with Python and/or NodeJS is a plus.
* Enablement Skills: Demonstrated ability to deliver technical training and enablement to partners or customers.
* Leadership: Experience leading technical engagements involving multiple stakeholders including partners, internal teams, and vendors.
* Communication: Exceptional verbal and written skills with the ability to translate complex technical information for diverse audiences.
* Problem Solving: Strong analytical skills and ability to devise creative technical solutions in partner\-centric contexts.



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Certifications: Zendesk certifications, AWS Certified Solutions Architect, or equivalent.
* Industry Knowledge: Familiarity with omnichannel contact centre solutions, AI\-driven automation, workforce engagement management, and reporting tools.
* Agile Experience: Working knowledge of Agile and DevOps methodologies.

description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION: BIM ARCHITECT**

**Location:** Ahmedabad, Gujarat (Work from Office)  
**Experience:** 1 to 4 Years  
**Qualification:** B.Arch (Mandatory)  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time

**About the Company (Our Client)**

**Our client** is a premier **BIM \& CAD Outsourcing firm** headquartered in Ahmedabad, serving as a trusted extended delivery partner for leading AEC (Architecture, Engineering, and Construction) firms across the United States, United Kingdom, Europe, and Australia.

**Our client** specializes in providing end\-to\-end BIM solutions for large\-scale residential, commercial, healthcare, and institutional projects. The team at **our client** works remotely with international clients to produce clash\-free, coordinated models, construction documentation, and reality\-capture outputs—strictly adhering to global BIM standards. **Our client** is now looking to expand their production team and invites talented architects to join their Ahmedabad hub.

**Role Overview**

As a **BIM Architect** with **our client**, the candidate will be responsible for developing, coordinating, and managing detailed Building Information Models using Autodesk Revit. The role involves working closely with **our client's** internal production team and international clients to translate design intent into accurate, data\-rich models and construction\-ready documentation. This position requires a strong architectural background, technical proficiency in BIM software, and the ability to deliver high\-quality outputs within strict project timelines.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop, coordinate, and manage **Architectural BIM models** (LOD 100 to LOD 500\) using Autodesk Revit for **our client's** international projects.
* Create accurate **construction documentation**, including plans, sections, elevations, schedules, and detailed shop drawings.
* Perform **clash detection** and model coordination using Navisworks, resolving conflicts across architectural, structural, and MEP systems.
* Collaborate remotely with **our client's** international project managers, architects, and engineers to ensure model accuracy and adherence to design intent.
* Implement and follow global **BIM standards** (AIA, ISO, or client\-specific protocols) for naming conventions, file management, and data integrity.
* Respond to client **RFIs (Requests for Information)** and incorporate design changes and revisions into the model efficiently.
* Conduct regular internal **quality checks** to ensure models are clash\-free, coordinated, and compliant with project specifications.
* Manage multiple projects simultaneously while ensuring on\-time digital delivery.

**Mandatory Qualifications \& Skills**

* **B.Arch (Bachelor of Architecture)** — This is a mandatory requirement. Candidates without B.Arch will not be considered.
* **1 to 4 years** of professional experience in BIM modeling, architectural drafting, or coordination (preferably in an outsourcing or project consultancy environment).
* **Expert proficiency in Autodesk Revit** (Architectural modeling, families, schedules, and worksharing).
* Working knowledge of **Autodesk Navisworks** (clash detection, reviewing, and coordination).
* Strong understanding of architectural design principles, building systems, construction methodologies, and international drafting standards.
* Excellent **communication skills** (written and verbal) to interact effectively with global clients and cross\-functional teams.
* Ability to read, interpret, and model from architectural, structural, and MEP drawings with high accuracy.
* Strong attention to detail, problem\-solving abilities, and a commitment to delivering **clash\-free, coordinated outputs**.

**Preferred Skills (Good to Have)**

* Familiarity with **Revit,** **AutoCAD**, **SketchUp**, or **Rhino**.
* Experience working on US, UK, or Middle Eastern projects.

**What Our Client Offers (Perks \& Benefits**)

* Opportunity to work on **international projects** from a global client base.
* Competitive salary package based on experience and expertise.
* A collaborative and learning\-driven work environment with upskilling opportunities in the latest BIM technologies.
* Exposure to complex, large\-scale architectural projects across diverse sectors.
* Standard working hours with a 5\-day work week (subject to project timelines).

**How to Apply**

If you meet the above qualifications and are interested in this opportunity with **our client**, please share your updated resume and portfolio (or work samples) with **us** (Camellia Staffing). We will forward your application to our client's hiring team for further review.

Application Question(s):

* Do you have a B.Arch degree?
* Q2\. Notice period in days? (Enter numeric value only)
* Q3\. Current monthly salary in INR? (Enter numeric value only)
* Q4\. Expected monthly salary in INR? (Enter numeric value only)

 The Snowflake \& Databricks Solution Architect will work closely with sales, presales, delivery, consulting, Snowflake partner teams, Databricks partner teams, hyperscaler teams, and client stakeholders to define end\-to\-end cloud data platform, lakehouse, data engineering, analytics, and AI\-ready data solutions.
 



 The role will support business growth by shaping high\-quality proposal responses, solution blueprints, modernization strategies, migration approaches, lakehouse and cloud data platform architecture diagrams, delivery models, reusable solution assets, managed operations models, and transformation roadmaps aligned to client business outcomes.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 



* Lead and contribute to end\-to\-end presales solutioning activities for Snowflake and Databricks modernization, migration, implementation, optimization, AI\-ready data platform, and managed services opportunities.
* Analyze client RFPs, RFIs, RFQs, business requirements, current\-state data landscape, legacy platform constraints, pain points, workload characteristics, compliance needs, data governance requirements, and evaluation criteria to design fit\-for\-purpose Snowflake and Databricks solutions.
* Create solution responses covering technical approach, target architecture, Snowflake platform design, Databricks lakehouse architecture, migration approach, data engineering patterns, AI/ML enablement, integration strategy, governance approach, implementation roadmap, assumptions, dependencies, risks, and differentiators.
* Architect enterprise Databricks solutions covering data ingestion, data lake modernization, lakehouse architecture, Delta Lake, medallion architecture, ETL/ELT transformation, batch and streaming pipelines, analytics consumption, machine learning, GenAI enablement, feature engineering, and governed data sharing.
* Develop proposal\-ready architecture narratives, logical architecture diagrams, data flow diagrams, migration architecture views, deployment views, Snowflake workload patterns, Databricks lakehouse workload patterns, AI\-ready data platform blueprints, and technology stack recommendations.
* Support solution estimation by defining work breakdown structures, delivery phases, migration factory approach, team composition, assumptions, dependencies, accelerators, and high\-level effort inputs.

* Participate in client workshops, discovery sessions, Snowflake readiness assessments, Databricks readiness assessments, lakehouse modernization workshops, migration planning workshops, solution walkthroughs, technical presentations, and proposal defense discussions.
* Contribute to reusable assets, solution playbooks, reference architectures, estimation models, proposal templates, migration factory patterns, modernization assessment templates, Snowflake best practices, Databricks best practices, and industry\-specific solution accelerators.
* Stay updated on emerging trends in Snowflake, Databricks, Lakehouse architecture, Snowpark, Snowflake Cortex AI, Snowflake Intelligence, Unity Catalog, Delta Lake, Delta Sharing, Delta Live Tables, AI\-enabled data engineering etc.
* Collaborate with marketing and presales teams in developing collateral, case studies, reusable content, and thought leadership materials..



**Principal KPIs for the Role** 



* Contribution to strategic deal wins
* Quality and timeliness of RFP/RFI responses
* Customer solution acceptance and feedback
* Innovation and value\-added solution recommendations
* Alignment of Snowflake and Databricks solutions to customer business outcomes, AI\-readiness, governance, modernization, cost optimization, and enterprise data strategy.
* Effectiveness of proposed Snowflake and Databricks migration, lakehouse modernization, optimization, and managed services approaches.



**Core Competencies \& Technical Expertise** 



* Hands\-on experience in preparing solution responses, architecture documents, presentations, technical proposals, migration approaches, operating models, and implementation roadmaps.
* Experience responding to RFPs/RFIs/RFQs and creating solution narratives, architecture diagrams, delivery approaches, modernization strategies, migration estimates, governance models, and managed services constructs.
* Experience with Snowflake and Databricks deployment and integration across cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, and Google Cloud Platform.
* Strong understanding of migration patterns from legacy data platforms to Snowflake and Databricks, including workload assessment, data lake modernization, schema conversion, ETL/ELT rationalization, data pipeline migration, data reconciliation, testing automation, parallel run, cutover strategy, performance tuning, and post\-migration optimization.
* Knowledge of BI and analytics tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Qlik, Looker, ThoughtSpot, or Sigma from a Snowflake and Databricks consumption and semantic layer perspective.
* Strong communication and presentation skills with experience interacting with customer stakeholders, CDO organizations, CIO teams, enterprise architects, data platform teams, analytics leaders, security teams, AI/ML teams, and business stakeholders.
* Ability to work independently across multiple concurrent opportunities in a fast\-paced presales environment.



**Required Qualifications**

* Experience in presales solutioning, proposal development, consulting, or customer\-facing architecture roles is strongly preferred.

 Terraform.
