title: Guidewire Technical Architect – ClaimCenter / Jutro
description:
**Summary**
 Professional Services at Guidewire partners with P\&C insurers worldwide to implement, modernize, and optimize their core platforms, with a strong focus on cloud adoption and AI\-enabled delivery. We work as one global team, combining deep product expertise, implementation excellence, and a culture of continuous improvement to help customers realize value faster. Our environment is collaborative, customer\-obsessed, and innovation\-driven, centered on Guidewire InsuranceSuite and the Guidewire Cloud Platform.
   

  

 As a Guidewire Architect focused on ClaimCenter / Jutro, you will define and own the end\-to\-end technical architecture for complex Guidewire implementations, modernization programs, and digital transformation initiatives across on\-premise, cloud, and hybrid environments. You will provide architectural leadership for ClaimCenter implementations, claims transformation programs, and digital experience solutions built using Jutro, ensuring scalable, secure, and high\-performing solutions that accelerate customer value.
   

  

 This role is ideal for a hands\-on expert who enjoys solving complex business problems, shaping implementation strategy, and accelerating our customers’ path to value while contributing to Professional Services’ mission to cut implementation effort and time through AI and automation.
   

  

**Job Description**
**What you’ll do**
* Define and own the end\-to\-end technical architecture, design standards, and implementation roadmap for Guidewire ClaimCenter and/or Jutro\-based digital solutions across on\-premise, cloud, and hybrid environments, ensuring alignment with customer enterprise architecture and Guidewire best practices.
* Lead solution design and implementation, including ClaimCenter configuration and customization (Gosu, data model extensions, rules, workflows, integrations, and plugins) and/or Jutro digital experience architecture, UI design, and portal development, delivering scalable, secure, and maintainable solutions.
* Architect and oversee complex integrations between Guidewire applications and enterprise systems such as policy administration, billing, CRM, document management, data platforms, and third\-party services using APIs, web services, messaging, and event\-driven patterns.
* Provide technical leadership to cross\-functional delivery teams through architecture reviews, code reviews, mentoring, and engineering governance, driving quality, reusability, automation, and best\-in\-class delivery practices.
* Partner with business stakeholders, architects, and customer teams to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions that address performance, availability, security, resiliency, and operational excellence.
* Champion cloud adoption, AI\-enabled delivery, and automation initiatives to accelerate implementation timelines, improve productivity, and establish repeatable delivery patterns across programs.
* Contribute to organizational assets including accelerators, reference architectures, technical standards, and thought leadership while promoting knowledge sharing across Guidewire, customer, and partner teams globally.
* At Guidewire, we foster a culture of curiosity, innovation, and responsible use of AI—empowering our teams to continuously leverage emerging technologies and data\-driven insights to enhance productivity and outcomes.


**Required**
**What you’ll bring**
* Demonstrated ability to leverage AI, automation, and data\-driven insights to improve delivery efficiency, solution quality, and customer outcomes.
* 10–18 years of software engineering and architecture experience, including significant hands\-on expertise in Guidewire ClaimCenter and/or Jutro, with experience leading at least two large\-scale implementation, modernization, or cloud transformation programs.
* Deep expertise in Guidewire ClaimCenter configuration and architecture, including Gosu, data model extensions, rules, workflows, activities, integrations, plugins, and Guidewire development best practices; or strong expertise in Jutro architecture and development, including digital portals, UI frameworks, component design, and customer\-facing insurance applications.
* Guidewire ClaimCenter ACE Certification, Jutro certification, or equivalent Guidewire implementation credentials preferred.
* Proven experience designing and delivering complex integrations using REST APIs, web services, messaging frameworks, and event\-driven architectures across Guidewire and enterprise ecosystems.
* Strong understanding of object\-oriented design, cloud\-native architecture, performance optimization, security best practices, scalability, resiliency, and non\-functional requirements for mission\-critical applications.
* Excellent communication, consulting, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence both technical and business audiences in Agile delivery environments.
* Ability to collaborate effectively across global teams, customers, and time zones.


**Preferred**
* Experience with Guidewire Cloud Platform (GWCP), including cloud\-native implementation patterns, observability, DevOps, and CI/CD practices.
* Proven success leading ClaimCenter Cloud, Jutro digital transformation, or Guidewire modernization programs leveraging automation and AI\-enabled delivery approaches.
* Familiarity with other Guidewire products such as PolicyCenter, BillingCenter, Data Platform, and Analytics.
* Experience with modern microservices, API\-first architectures, event\-driven systems, and digital experience platforms.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.


**Your Impact**
 We believe in clarity and setting you up for success. In your first six months, you will take architectural ownership of one or more complex PolicyCenter implementations, aligning solution designs with customer business objectives while embedding Professional Services’ priorities around AI\-enabled, faster, and more predictable delivery.
   

  

 You will define technical roadmaps, guide teams through critical design and integration decisions, and put in place patterns and assets that measurably reduce implementation effort and time for future projects. As your influence grows, you will help customers fully leverage Guidewire’s cloud and AI platform, directly supporting our wider mission to transform how the world’s P\&C insurers do business and advancing Guidewire’s ambition to deliver secure, scalable, and innovative solutions globally.
   

  

**About Guidewire**
 Guidewire is the platform P\&C insurers trust to engage, innovate, and grow efficiently. We combine digital, core, analytics, and AI to deliver our platform as a cloud service. More than 540\+ insurers in 40 countries, from new ventures to the largest and most complex in the world, run on Guidewire.
   

  

 As a partner to our customers, we continually evolve to enable their success. We are proud of our unparalleled implementation track record with 1600\+ successful projects, supported by the largest R\&D team and partner ecosystem in the industry. Our Marketplace provides hundreds of applications that accelerate integration, localization, and innovation.
   

  

 For more information, please visit www.guidewire.com and follow us on Twitter: @Guidewire\_PandC.
   

  

 Guidewire Software, Inc. is proud to be an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. We are committed to an inclusive workplace, and believe that a diversity of perspectives, abilities, and cultures is a key to our success. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, citizenship, marital status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or disability. title: Senior Principal Engineer
description:
TechGrove is the
 **Centre of Excellence** 
 for Banyan Software, based in Chennai, India. It plays a key role in supporting Banyan’s global businesses through technology, security, and software development. TechGrove brings together India’s deep pool of technical talent with Banyan’s long\-term approach to growth, creating a trusted, developer\-focused environment where people can do their best work.
 



**Senior Principal Engineer** 




*Technical Lead / Architect, TechGrove AI Engineering Pod* 




 You are the kind of engineer other engineers want to build with. You have spent your career going deep on production systems, and you have reached the point where your judgment shapes architectures, raises teams, and makes hard problems look simple. This is the most senior technical seat in the pod, and it is unapologetically hands\-on.
 



 As Technical Lead and Architect, you own the architecture for an OpCo’s modernized applications and set the engineering bar the whole pod builds to. You operate as a player/coach: designing complex systems, writing meaningful code, and running rigorous reviews of work produced by both engineers and AI agents. You treat agentic development as a first\-class part of the architecture, not a novelty, and you define how the pod gets the most out of it without ever compromising quality or security.
 



 If you want your decisions to matter, your code to ship, and your standards to lift an entire team, this is built for you.
 


**About the Pod** 

 A TechGrove AI Engineering Pod is a self\-contained, AI\-native software delivery team that we embed inside one of our Operating Companies (OpCos) to build, modernize, and ship production software. Each pod pairs senior engineering talent with agentic AI tooling such as Claude Code, plus the accelerators of Banyan’s AI Application Modernization Factory, to deliver at a velocity and quality bar a traditional team cannot match.
 



 A pod is typically four to eight people, and OpCos add more pods as their ambitions grow. You will work as part of a tight, high\-trust team with real ownership of what you build. Pods are delivered from Banyan’s India\-based TechGrove.
 


**What You Will Do** 
* **Own the architecture:** 
 Define and own the end\-to\-end software architecture for the pod’s applications, ensuring designs are scalable, secure, resilient, and cloud\-native across AWS and Azure.
* **Own the frontend architecture:** 
 Set the frontend architecture: state management, a scalable library of reusable components, design\-system integration, and the patterns, standards, and performance budgets the pod builds against.
* **Lead the technical direction:** 
 Serve as the highest technical authority and escalation point in the pod. Set design patterns and standards, and make confident architectural decisions amid ambiguity.
* **Stay hands\-on:** 
 Operate as a player/coach. Make significant code contributions, lead complex designs, and deliver thorough code reviews of work from both engineers and AI agents.
* **Lead AI\-native development:** 
 Define how the pod uses agentic tooling such as Claude Code across the SDLC, establishing patterns for AI\-assisted design, implementation, testing, and review that maximize velocity while protecting quality and security.
* **Set the quality bar:** 
 Define and enforce engineering excellence: clean code, Domain\-Driven Design, modern design patterns, Twelve\-Factor principles, meaningful test coverage, and application security.
* **Build secure and reliable systems:** 
 Embed secure\-by\-design principles and cloud\-native observability so applications run fast, stay available, and stay safe in production.
* **Mentor and raise the team:** 
 Coach senior engineers, grow the technical capability of the team (human and agentic), and foster a culture of ownership and continuous improvement.
* **Partner with the OpCo:** 
 Work with the OpCo’s technical leadership and existing teams to align architecture with their landscape, integrate with existing systems, and transfer knowledge.


**What You Bring** 
* **Experience:** 
 10\+ years in software engineering, with significant time in Principal Engineer, Staff Engineer, or Architect roles leading the architecture of complex, production systems.
* **Production experience on BOTH AWS and Azure (required):** 
 You have personally designed, built, and run production software on both AWS and Azure. This dual\-cloud depth is essential: you are the technical authority who sets cloud architecture regardless of which target cloud an OpCo runs on. Hands\-on depth includes containers (Docker/Kubernetes), serverless (Lambda and Azure Functions), and Infrastructure\-as\-Code with Terraform.
* **Architectural depth:** 
 Deep command of modern architectural patterns (microservices, event\-driven, distributed systems), DDD, and design patterns, with a record of turning business objectives into technical solutions at enterprise or B2B scale.
* **Hands\-on technical depth:** 
 Current, real coding ability. A player/coach who contributes code, leads design, and delivers thorough reviews, including of AI\-generated work.
* **AI\-native engineering:** 
 Demonstrated fluency with AI\-assisted and agentic development tooling (Claude Code or similar) and a clear, practiced approach to architecting and delivering software in an AI\-native team.
* **Modern tech stacks:** 
 Hands\-on production experience with at least two of: .NET Core, Python, TypeScript, and Java.
* **Frontend architecture:** 
 Deep expertise in modern frontend architecture with React.js and Next.js: state management, scalable and reusable component design, design\-system strategy, and frontend performance at scale.
* **DevSecOps:** 
 Strong command of CI/CD (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI) and modern DevSecOps practices.
* **Communication and leadership:** 
 You align technical and business stakeholders, lead under competing priorities, and bring calm and clarity to fast\-moving teams.


**Nice to Have** 
* Experience building and operating multi\-tenant SaaS at scale.
* A track record leading application modernization or re\-platforming of large enterprise or B2B applications.
* GenAI architecture experience: RAG and GraphRAG, LLM orchestration, multi\-agent frameworks, MCP servers and tools, context engineering, and vector databases.
* Experience leading embedded or client\-facing engineering teams.
* Working knowledge of GCP, in addition to AWS and Azure.


**What Success Looks Like** 
* **First 90 days:** 
 You understand the OpCo’s landscape, have set the architectural direction and engineering standards, and the pod is shipping against them with a clean, AI\-native workflow.
* **First 6 months:** 
 The architecture is proven in production, quality and delivery metrics are trending up, and the team’s technical capability, human and agentic, has visibly grown under your leadership.


**Why TechGrove, Why Banyan** 
* **Permanent home, long\-term thinking:** 
 Banyan acquires great software businesses and keeps them for good. We invest for the long term, which means you build software meant to last, not to flip.
* **Real ownership:** 
 You own outcomes end to end inside a small, senior team. The OpCo owns the “what”; the pod owns the “how.”
* **AI\-native by default:** 
 You work every day with agentic tooling and the AI Application Modernization Factory, not as a side experiment but as the core of how we build.
* **Variety with stability:** 
 Pods work across a portfolio of real products and domains, so you keep learning, with the security of a permanent employer behind you.
* **Growth and excellence:** 
 A Banyan Director of Engineering Excellence supports every pod with coaching, standards, and continuous improvement, so your craft compounds over time.


**Should You Apply?** 

 We have written this role to be honest about what it takes, not to describe a mythical perfect candidate. If you meet most of what is listed and you are excited by the work, we want to hear from you. Strong engineers grow into the rest, and we will help you do exactly that.
 



 We are building diverse, inclusive teams, and we welcome applicants of every background. What matters most is the quality of your engineering, your curiosity about AI\-native development, and your appetite to own outcomes.
 







***Beware of Recruitment Scams***




 We have been made aware of individuals fraudulently posing as members of our Talent Acquisition team and extending fake job offers. These scams may involve requests for personal information or payment for equipment. 
 



**Protect yourself by following these steps:** 



* Verify that all communications from our recruiting team come from an
 **@banyansoftware.com** 
 email address.
* Remember, employers will
 **never** 
 request payment or banking information during the hiring process.
* If you receive a suspicious message,
 **do not respond** 
 — instead, forward it to careers@banyansoftware.com and/or report it to the platform where you received it.



 Your safety and security are important to us. Thank you for staying vigilant.

title: Senior CAD Engineer
description:
NVIDIA has been redefining computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. Today, we're tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing — an era in which our GPUs act as the brains of computers, robots, and self\-driving cars. Doing what's never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world's best talent. Come join our diverse team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.
   

  

 We are now looking for a Physical Design Methodology and Operations Engineer! You'll join a small team that owns the infrastructure powering NVIDIA's semiconductor design flows — coordinating hundreds of thousands of jobs per day across datacenters with 10,000\+ hosts, serving over 1,000 chip designers worldwide. Our platform spans job orchestration, event\-driven trigger systems, global service interconnection, web interfaces to tools, and a Jenkins\-like CI/CD backbone — a production system with direct stakes in GPU, CPU, SoC and networking tapeouts. You'll own a functional area within the team while contributing across broader operations. Our stack includes mature Perl and Python services alongside modern React frontends and Elasticsearch\-based telemetry. We're actively modernizing, and we need someone who can think architecturally — evaluating what we have, identifying what needs to change, and driving that evolution in a way the team can execute and maintain. If you want to own something critical at scale and shape how it grows, this role is for you.
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing**
* Designing and supporting mechanisms for coordinating and maintaining large\-scale semiconductor design tasks across multiple global datacenters.
* Owning the architecture of one or more platform components — defining interfaces, data models, and service boundaries that can scale and evolve.
* Leading the modernization of legacy services — evaluating existing Perl and Python backends, proposing migration strategies, and driving execution with the team.
* Debugging and improving production services spanning web browsers, containerized microservices, and bare\-metal Linux hosts.
* Building and improving web interfaces to configure, launch, and analyze EDA tools and design flows.
* Mining and analyzing large datasets of job execution telemetry and tool quality\-of\-results data to improve flows and catch regressions.
* Mentoring junior engineers and contributing to design reviews and technical standards across the team.
* Helping invent next\-generation semiconductor design methodology.
* Optionally, contributing directly to the physical design of GPU, CPU, SoC, and networking products — a rare opportunity for an infrastructure engineer.


**What We Want To See**
* Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science or computer systems engineering (or equivalent experience).
* 5\+ years of software engineering experience, with a track record of designing and delivering production systems.
* Strong software architecture and design skills — experience defining service boundaries, APIs, data models, and system interfaces.
* Proficiency in Python and/or Perl; comfort with JavaScript and web technologies.
* Experience with distributed systems at meaningful scale.
* Proven ability to lead a project through its full lifecycle, from requirement solicitation to architecture design, to implementation, to maintenance and support.
* Comfort owning and debugging Linux\-based production services.


**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**
* Experience with workflow orchestration systems (Airflow, Argo, Temporal, Luigi, or similar).
* Experience with containerization technologies such as Docker or Kubernetes.
* Familiarity with Elasticsearch / Kibana / Vega for telemetry and dashboarding.
* Experience with MSSQL/Mysql/SQLite or other relational and NoSQL datastores.
* Exposure to Static Timing Analysis or VLSI physical design.


 NVIDIA is widely considered one of the technology world's most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward\-thinking and talented people in the world working for us. If you're an engineer who thinks in systems, takes pride in designing things that last, and wants to see the silicon your work helps produce — we want to hear from you.

title: Member of Technical Staff, Distributed Systems
description:
logcat.ai is the AI engineering layer for the operating\-system stack. We build agentic systems for Linux and Android devices: we ingest the diagnostic artifacts a device emits (bugreports, logcat, dmesg, modem traces, ramdumps, perfetto, pcap, CAN) and help device makers diagnose, remediate, test, and author features across their OS stack, grounded in their own BSP. A VC\-backed startup with a small, senior team — you work directly with the founders.
 



  





 We recently raised a $2\.55M pre\-seed. The product is scaling and the customer list is growing. The team is still small, so you'll own what you build.
 



  





 Own the core platform end to end: ingestion and processing of very large system\-log artifacts, the runtime under our AI investigation agents, and the infrastructure that keeps it all reliable for customers. This is a founding seat — architecture, tech selection, CI/CD, and reliability are your calls, and you'll have a real vote in what we build and who we hire next.
 



  





 We're not hiring for a traditional lane. We want someone who builds the automation, agentic workflows, and self\-scaling systems that let a small team ship like a large one.
 



  





**A note on location** 




 This role is on\-site in Bengaluru. We've kept it that way on purpose: the platform work moves fastest with people in a room together, and this is the seat where that matters most. You must be eligible to work in India.
 



  





**The Bar** 




 A quick, honest gut\-check before you spend time on an application. If most of this sounds like you, we'd genuinely love to talk.
 



  




* 5\+ years building backend or distributed systems at product companies. You've personally owned a system under real load and can talk concretely about its failure modes.
* Full\-stack capable: you'll ship the API, the pipeline, the infra, and sometimes the UI.
* AI\-native: you build harnesses and evals, not just accept autocomplete.
* Startup DNA: you've worked at an early or high\-growth startup, or genuinely want to now. Ownership over lanes, speed over ceremony, many hats.
* Proficient in day\-to\-day work with CLI\-based AI coding tools like Claude Code (or an equivalent). It's how the team operates, not a nice\-to\-have.



  





**What You'll Do** 



* Build ingestion and processing for very large system\-log artifacts, and the runtime our AI investigation agents run on.
* Own the infrastructure that keeps the platform reliable for customers: architecture, tech selection, CI/CD.
* Build the automation and agentic workflows that let a small team ship like a large one.



  





**Bonus** 



* Observability, logging, or tracing systems.
* eBPF, Perfetto, ftrace.
* OS internals.
* Public OSS track record.



  





**What we offer you** 



* A front seat as we scale. Customer calls, the roadmap, the pipeline, how the company is actually doing.
* Top\-of\-market salary and founding equity. You'll own a piece of what you build.
* The AI tools you need. We use AI across writing code, reviewing it, research, ops, and internal tooling. If something would help you work better, we'll get it.
* Early ownership, and full visibility. We move fast, and you'll help decide where.
* Comprehensive medical insurance for you and your family.
* Start\-up perks and flexible time off, the kind people actually take.
* A small team that's easy to work with. People here like solving hard problems and helping each other out.



  





**What to expect after you apply** 



* Screening call with Head of People \& Business Operations
* Technical conversation with Co\-founder/ Head of Engineering
* Technical exercise with Co\-founder/ Head of Engineering
* Final conversation with CEO
* References, then offer



  





 In your application, tell us what you'd own here, and the hardest thing you've shipped, a link to something you've built beats a resume.

 Excellent communication skills with the ability to work across teams, functions, and geographies.

 Passion for quick learning and adapting in a dynamic global environment.

 Work

title: Principal Software Architect
description:
OPENTEXT \- THE INFORMATION COMPANY
  
OpenText is a global leader in information management, where innovation, creativity, and collaboration are the key components of our corporate culture. As a member of our team, you will have the opportunity to partner with the most highly regarded companies in the world, tackle complex issues, and contribute to projects that shape the future of digital transformation.
  
  

AI\-First. Future\-Driven. Human\-Centered.
  
At OpenText, AI is at the heart of everything we do—powering innovation, transforming work, and empowering digital knowledge workers. We're hiring talent that AI can't replace to help us shape the future of information management. Join us.
  
  

Your Impact
  
Sets data and applied AI architecture direction for OpenText, working across product lines rather than within a single team. Defines how OpenText builds and governs data platforms (warehousing, lakehouses, graphs, vector stores) and the applied AI systems built on top of them. Acts as a technical authority that other architects and engineering teams consult on data and applied AI decisions.
  
What the role offers
  
1\.Design and review data architectures (warehouses, lakehouses, data platforms, graph and vector stores) that support analytics and AI workloads, including data quality, lineage, and governance (e.g., using layered patterns such as medallion/bronze\-silver\-gold where applicable).
  
2\.Evaluate and recommend data contract and product standards (e.g., ODCS, ODPS) for cross\-product adoption.
  
3\.Define reference architectures and patterns for applied AI systems (RAG, agentic AI, LLM integration) that other product teams can adopt, including governance considerations such as safety filtering, bias assessment, human\-in\-the\-loop mechanisms, and audit evidence requirements for autonomous/agentic systems.
  
4\.Advise on agentic AI architecture, including interoperability protocols such as MCP and A2A as well as emerging standards such as OpenID AuthZEN and OIDC\-A.
  
5\.Partner with product architects across OpenText to align data and AI architecture decisions with company\-wide standards. 6\.Represent data engineering and applied AI perspectives in architecture review boards and standards discussions. 7\.Communicate architectural trade\-offs to executive and non\-technical stakeholders, influencing direction across product lines without formal authority.
  
8\.Mentor other architects informally on data engineering and applied AI practices, without formal people\-management responsibility.
  
  

**What you need to succeed:**  

1\.10\+ years in software architecture, data engineering, or AI/ML systems, or equivalent demonstrated depth.
  
2\.Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent professional experience.
  
3\.Track record operating as a software architect across multiple teams or products, not just within a single team.
  
4\. Demonstrated design of production data architectures at scale (e.g., data warehouse, lakehouse, or data platform), using layered patterns such as medallion/bronze\-silver\-gold where applicable.
  
5\.Hands\-on experience architecting applied AI systems (e.g., RAG pipelines, LLM\-integrated services) that have shipped to production.
  
6\.Experience building cloud\-native applications on a major hyperscaler (AWS, Azure, or GCP), including containerized applications deployed on Kubernetes.
  
One last thing
  
Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field.
  
Prior cross\-product or cross\-org architecture role at a similarly sized enterprise software company.
  
Breadth across data warehousing, lakehouses, data platforms, graphs, and vector technologies, valued over deep specialization in a single area.
  
Familiarity with data contract/product standards such as ODCS (Open Data Contract Standard) or ODPS (Open Data Product Specification).
  
Familiarity with data catalog and metadata management tools (e.g., Unity Catalog, Google Cloud Dataplex Universal Catalog, Apache Atlas, or equivalent).
  
Experience with graph databases and building knowledge graphs.
  
Experience with vector database technologies and embedding pipelines in production RAG systems (e.g., pgvector, Milvus, or equivalent).
  
Experience designing streaming data architectures (e.g., Kafka, Flink, Delta Live Tables, or equivalent) alongside batch/medallion patterns.
  
Experience with agentic AI architecture and interoperability protocols (MCP, A2A) or similar emerging standards.
  
Familiarity with agentic AI safety patterns, including prompt injection defenses, guardrail design, and PII handling in agentic contexts.

Our Employment Equity and Diversity Policy provides direction on maintaining a working environment that is inclusive of everyone, regardless of culture, national origin, race, color, gender, gender identification, sexual orientation, family status, age, veteran status, disability, religion, or other basis protected by applicable laws.
  
If you need assistance and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please contact us athr@opentext.com. Our proactive approach fosters collaboration, innovation, and personal growth, enriching OpenText's vibrant workplace.

description:
**Company:**
------------

Qualcomm India Private Limited
**Job Area:**
-------------

Engineering Group, Engineering Group \> Hardware Engineering
**General Summary:**

Qualcomm's System Validation \& Emulation (SVE) organization is seeking exceptional engineers with deep expertise in Embedded Software Architecture, Framework Development, Validation Infrastructure, and System Software Debug. The ideal candidate will possess strong software architecture skills and the ability to root\-cause complex issues across multicore, multiprocessor, and heterogeneous SoC environments spanning hardware, firmware, operating systems, validation frameworks, and system infrastructure.


**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Engineering, or related field and 3\+ years of Hardware Engineering or related work experience.

OR
  

Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Engineering, or related field and 2\+ years of Hardware Engineering or related work experience.
  

OR
  

PhD in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Engineering, or related field and 1\+ year of Hardware Engineering or related work experience.
**Responsibilities**

* Architect, design, develop, and maintain scalable embedded software frameworks, validation infrastructure, and platform software for pre\-silicon and post\-silicon SoC validation.
* Develop reusable framework components, platform abstraction layers, middleware, and system software services supporting multicore and heterogeneous compute environments.
* Drive software architecture and framework design to enable portability, scalability, maintainability, and reuse across multiple SoC programs and IP validation domains.
* Develop and maintain bring\-up, validation, and debug infrastructure for bare\-metal, lightweight RTOS, emulation, FPGA, and post\-silicon environments.
* Debug and root\-cause complex system\-level issues spanning hardware, firmware, operating systems, framework software, memory subsystems, coherency fabrics, and system infrastructure IPs.
* Develop framework capabilities supporting multicore, multiprocessor, and heterogeneous CPU architectures, including system\-level synchronization, coherency, and performance optimization.
* Design, implement, and optimize automated validation, regression, and release workflows to improve productivity, quality, and scalability.
* Integrate static analysis, code\-quality tools, build systems, and release processes into Continuous Integration (CI) environments.
* Collaborate closely with architecture, design, verification, firmware, software, and validation teams to enable efficient silicon bring\-up, feature validation, and debug.
* Drive continuous improvements in software quality, framework architecture, automation, and validation methodologies.

**Minimum Qualification**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electronics \& Communication Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
* 6\+ to 10 years of industry experience in Embedded Software, System Software, SoC Validation, Silicon Enablement, Platform Software, Framework Development, or related domains.
* Proven experience in embedded software architecture, framework development, low\-level software design, and complex system\-level debug.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and debugging skills in hardware\-software integrated environments.

**Mandatory Skills**

* Strong expertise in Embedded Software Architecture, Framework Design, and Infrastructure Development using C, C\+\+, and Assembly.
* Proven experience designing and developing scalable software frameworks, platform abstraction layers, middleware, validation infrastructure, and reusable system software components.
* Extensive experience in low\-level software development, including boot code, exception handling, interrupt management, startup sequences, and C\-Assembly interworking.
* Deep understanding of CPU architectures and microarchitectural concepts, including ARMv8/ARMv9, x86, and PowerPC architectures.
* Strong expertise in multicore, multiprocessor, and heterogeneous SoC environments, including SMP, AMP, heterogeneous compute subsystems, and cross\-core software interactions.
* Demonstrated ability to debug complex system\-level issues spanning hardware, firmware, operating systems, framework software, and validation infrastructure.
* Strong understanding of cache coherency, I/O coherency, memory ordering, synchronization primitives, inter\-processor communication, and concurrency\-related issues.
* Deep knowledge of SoC architecture, including compute subsystems, memory hierarchies, interconnect fabrics, power management, and system infrastructure IPs.
* Strong understanding of Operating Systems, RTOS, and Linux kernel internals, including multithreading, scheduling policies, locking mechanisms, interrupt handling, virtual memory, MMU architecture, and kernel synchronization primitives.
* Deep understanding of memory management, weakly ordered memory models, cache architectures, pipelining, memory barriers, TLBs, coherency protocols, and performance optimization techniques.
* Strong expertise in software build infrastructure, compiler toolchains, linker internals, Makefiles, linker/scatter scripts, and build system architecture.
* Proficiency with GCC, Clang/LLVM, ARM toolchains, code optimization techniques, and root\-causing complex compiler and linker issues.
* Strong debugging expertise using JTAG, trace, emulation, FPGA, and silicon debug tools.
* Proficiency in Python and Shell scripting for automation, framework development, debug, and productivity tooling.

**Desired Skills**

* Experience architecting and developing large\-scale embedded software frameworks or validation infrastructure used across multiple engineering teams and SoC programs.
* Experience with silicon bring\-up, board bring\-up, post\-silicon validation, and hardware\-software integration.
* Hands\-on experience with pre\-silicon emulation, FPGA prototyping, and post\-silicon debug environments.
* Strong understanding of ARM\-based SoC architectures, memory hierarchies, cache coherency protocols, interconnect fabrics, and system infrastructure IPs.
* Experience developing framework abstractions supporting heterogeneous processing elements such as application processors, real\-time processors, DSPs, AI/ML accelerators, and security subsystems.
* Familiarity with CI/CD systems, automated regression infrastructure, release management, and software quality methodologies.
* Experience with JTAG, Lauterbach Trace32, hardware trace, and performance analysis tools.
* Experience with source code management systems such as Git and Perforce.
* Familiarity with build automation, containerized development environments, and scalable software deployment workflows.

* Experience mentoring engineers and driving technical direction for framework and infrastructure development initiatives.

**Job Description**  

HPE’s acquisition of Juniper Networks is one of the most significant moves in the company’s history, bringing two networking leaders together to build **HPE Networking**, with the ambition of creating the **best networking business on the planet**. This role sits at the center of that effort as part of **the Lead\-to\-Cash (L2C) program**, responsible for unifying quoting, ordering, and fulfillment across the combined HPE and Juniper networking portfolios onto a **single platform**, replacing fragmented legacy systems with one seamless, scalable experience for sellers, partners, and customers worldwide.


As part of a fast\-moving, **multi\-year transformation**, the team will stabilize near\-term operations, **migrate core** **platforms, onboard businesses and suppliers globally**, and build new capabilities from the ground up. The choices made here will shape how the combined networking business operates for years to come. You will work closely with **business leaders, IT architects, suppliers, and partner stakeholders** on a program with direct executive visibility, solving integration challenges at a scale few companies ever attempt.


For the right person, this is a rare opportunity to help **build a new business unit from its earliest days**, rather than inherit someone else’s systems. You will gain **hands\-on exposure to enterprise\-scale platform integration and cross\-functional program leadership**, with the kind of complexity and pace that can accelerate your career. If you want your work to have a visible impact on a company making a significant investment in its future, this is where that happens.

**HPE Global IT is a dynamic organization enabling the enterprise to innovate and lead the industry with our consumption\-based IT transformation and our consulting, financial, educational, and operational support services. Join us as we develop innovative solutions that revolutionize how we help customers by simplifying their operations and move the world forward.**

**What you’ll do:**

**Workstream\-Specific Details**

**Responsibilities**

* Own the end\-to\-end solution architecture for services and software subscription offers across the combined HPE and Juniper portfolios, spanning quote, order, fulfillment, entitlement, and renewal.
* Translate subscription and SaaS commercial constructs — term, usage\-based, committed\-consumption, co\-term, and mid\-term change — into platform\-level design on the target L2C stack.
* Design and document subscription data models, product/offer structures, and integration patterns between CPQ, order management, entitlement, billing, and asset management systems.
* Partner with business, product, and pricing leaders to pressure\-test offer designs for feasibility, then define the architecture runway required to deliver them.
* Lead design reviews and architecture decision records; resolve cross\-workstream dependencies and drive alignment with enterprise architecture standards.
* Guide migration of subscription and support contracts from fragmented legacy systems onto the unified platform, including data mapping, reconciliation, and cutover design.
* Support build and test teams as the design authority — clarifying intent, reviewing configuration, and triaging defects that trace to architectural decisions.
* Identify and escalate architectural risks, technical debt, and scalability constraints with recommended mitigations to program leadership.

**Education And Experience Required**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field; advanced degree an asset.
* 10\+ years of experience in enterprise solution or application architecture, with at least 5 years focused on Lead\-to\-Cash, CPQ, order management, or subscription billing platforms.
* Demonstrated experience architecting services and software subscription offers (SaaS, term license, consumption\-based, and support/services contracts) at enterprise scale.
* Hands\-on delivery experience with platforms such as SAP S/4HANA, Salesforce CPQ, Oracle, Zuora, or comparable subscription and order management systems.
* Track record on large\-scale transformation, ERP/CRM migration, or post\-merger integration programs, including legacy data migration and cutover.
* Experience operating in a global, matrixed environment with onshore/offshore delivery teams.
* Relevant architecture or platform certifications (e.g., TOGAF, SAP, Salesforce) an asset.

**What you need to bring:**

**Knowledge And Skills**

* Deep knowledge of subscription commercial models — term, usage, committed consumption, co\-term, ramp, renewal, and mid\-term change — and how they are represented in system design.
* Strong command of quote\-to\-cash process design across CPQ, contracting, order orchestration, entitlement, provisioning, billing, and revenue recognition.
* Solid grasp of integration architecture: APIs, event\-driven patterns, middleware, and master data management across product, customer, and install\-base domains.
* Ability to produce clear architecture artifacts — solution designs, data models, interface specifications, and decision records — that development teams can build from.
* Analytical and structured problem solver, comfortable making design decisions with incomplete information and revisiting them as the program matures.
* Excellent communication and influencing skills; able to explain technical trade\-offs to executives and business stakeholders in plain language.
* Collaborative working style with the credibility to act as design authority across multiple workstreams and vendors.
* Comfortable with ambiguity, shifting priorities, and the pace of a multi\-year integration program.

Subscription/SW

Expert

* Strong expertise in UVM‑based testbench architecture and development

* Exposure to formal verification and hybrid formal‑simulation flows
* Familiarity with high‑speed or complex IPs, such as:
	+ H.264
	+ Security, debug, or safety‑crititical

Renesas is an embedded semiconductor solution provider driven by its Purpose, **To Make Our Lives Easier**. title: Senior Security Architect
description:
**Be the one building AI\-powered experiences where they matter most.**
 At Genesys, we help organizations create better customer experiences through AI\-powered experience orchestration. Our platform connects people, systems, data and AI to help organizations deliver more personalized service, improve operational efficiency and build stronger customer relationships.
   

  

 Help build, support and operate technology used by more than 8,000 organizations in over 100 countries – moving AI from possibility to production in real\-world enterprise environments every day.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The Genesys Global Security, Privacy \& Compliance Centre of Excellence (COE SPC) provides expert security advisory services to Sales, Pre\-Sales, Customers, and Partners. The team serves as the single point of contact for all security, privacy, and compliance\-related customer engagements within the Genesys Cloud Business Unit.
   

  

**Role Summary**
 We are seeking an experienced Senior or Principal
 **Cloud Security Architect** 
 to join the Genesys Global Security, Privacy \& Compliance Centre of Excellence (COE SPC) as a technical Security Subject Matter Expert (SME). This is a hands\-on, customer\-facing technical security role, not a compliance or GRC position. You will work closely with Sales, Engineering, Product Security, and Architecture teams to support consulting, customer audits, security assessments, technical reviews, executive briefings, and evidence\-based engagements for Genesys Cloud.
   

  

 As one of the team's technical security SMEs, you will apply your expertise in cloud security, AI security, and security controls to explain and defend the Genesys Cloud security, privacy, and compliance posture. You will interpret technical evidence, respond to complex security inquiries, defend security contractual terms, and engage directly with customers, partners, auditors, and executive stakeholders within the APAC region.
   

  

 This role is highly consultative and requires excellent English communication and presentation skills. You will regularly represent Genesys Cloud during customer executive briefings, security workshops, webinars, conferences, partner events, and industry forums. You must be comfortable presenting complex technical security concepts to audiences ranging from security practitioners and architects to CISOs, CIOs, and other senior executives, both remotely and in person, to any of our global customers.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead customer\-facing security discussions with customers, prospects, partners, auditors, and internal stakeholders on Genesys Cloud architecture, penetration testing, vulnerability management, remediation, privacy, compliance, and AI security.
* Provide technical consulting that maps Genesys Cloud security capabilities and controls to customer security, regulatory, and risk management requirements.
* Develop, validate, and present technical evidence demonstrating the effectiveness of controls across identity and access management, encryption, key management, network security, logging, monitoring, incident response, application security, AI security, and secure software development.
* Deliver technical deep dives, security workshops, and executive briefings for audiences ranging from security practitioners and auditors to CISOs, CIOs, and senior business leaders.
* Own complex customer security, privacy, and compliance matters and contractual security negotiations.
* Represent Genesys at strategic customer engagements, partner events, conferences, webinars, and industry forums across APAC, contributing to external security thought leadership.


**This Role Offers**
* A highly technical, customer\-facing Cloud Security Architect role within a global Centre of Excellence.
* Collaboration with Engineering, Product Security, Architecture, Privacy, Compliance, and AI teams.
* Exposure to complex enterprise cloud environments and leading global customer security organisations.
* The opportunity to shape customer trust in Genesys Cloud and its AI capabilities through technical assurance, executive engagement, and industry representation.


**Minimum Qualifications**
* Expert\-level experience designing, implementing, assessing, or defending security architectures and controls for enterprise cloud or SaaS platforms.
* Strong hands\-on experience with AWS security, cloud\-native architectures, distributed systems, and DevSecOps practices.
* Strong vulnerability\-management and application\-security expertise, including penetration testing, secure SDLC, CI/CD security, SAST, DAST, SCA, container security, Infrastructure as Code security, remediation, and risk\-based prioritisation.
* Proven experience with AI technologies and AI security, including generative AI, large language models, AI governance, AI risk management, and emerging Frontier AI threats to AI\-enabled platforms.
* Experience interpreting and defending technical security evidence, architecture diagrams, policies, penetration testing results, and other security artefacts.
* Proven experience leading customer security assessments, technical workshops, executive briefings, and discussions with enterprise customers, auditors, and engineering teams.
* Ability to communicate complex security topics clearly to both technical and executive audiences, supported by excellent analytical, consulting, writing, and presentation skills.
* Professional fluency in English and willingness to travel internationally as required.


**Nice\-to\-Have Qualifications**
* Hands\-on experience with Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, or similar Infrastructure as Code technologies.
* Experience securing microservices and cloud\-native applications.
* Experience with security automation, detection engineering, or modern Security Operations.
* Professional speaking experience at conferences, webinars, customer events, or technical forums.
* Relevant certifications such as AWS Certified Security – Specialty, CISSP, CCSP, or equivalent.
* Experience supporting regulated industries such as financial services, healthcare, government, or critical infrastructure.
* Fluency in an additional language, preferably Japanese or Korean.


**Working at Genesys**
* AI at enterprise scale – Build, support and operate AI\-powered technology used by more than 8,000 organizations worldwide. 150\+ new AI features were released in the last fiscal year
* A flexible\-first culture – Join a global team of nearly 7,000 employees with flexible ways of working designed to help people do their best work
* Growth in the AI era – Build future\-ready skills through mentorship, learning programs, leadership development and education support
* Time to recharge and give back – Benefits include paid volunteer time, August Free Fridays, well\-being resources and regionally tailored programs for employees and their families
* Recognized globally – Genesys is Great Place to Work® certified in 17 countries and 94% of employees are proud to tell others they work at Genesys


 Learn more about our culture, AI innovation and sustainability commitments through our Careers site and Sustainability Report.
   

  

**What Happens After You Apply**
 After you apply, here's what you can typically expect:
   

  

* Our Talent Acquisition team reviews your application with the hiring team
* A Talent Acquisition Partner will review your application and, if your background is aligned, schedule a Zoom interview.
* Next, you'll meet the hiring manager and other members of the interview team

**Be the one building what's next \- where AI, experience and impact come together.**

We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.



Caterpillar’s Connectivity System Team is hiring a **Connectivity System Senior Engineer (System Integration / Product Owner)** with expertise in telematics, connectivity platforms, and system integration across embedded and enterprise systems.



In this role, you will work on highly complex and scalable connectivity solutions spanning across CAT and non\-CAT assets. This role combines **system integration engineering and product ownership**, requiring end\-to\-end ownership of connectivity features across embedded systems, connectivity layers, and enterprise/cloud ecosystems.



You will collaborate with global teams including Product Groups (RI, CI, P\&E), Intelligent Machine Systems (IMS), Cat Digital, and platform teams to deliver high\-quality, data\-driven connectivity solutions aligned with customer and business needs.


**What You’ll Do (Job Duties)**


* Own and manage **connectivity features**, driving end\-to\-end lifecycle from requirements definition, system design, integration, validation, and release
* Drive **end\-to\-end system integration** across embedded systems, connectivity modules (5G/LTE, Wi\-Fi, Bluetooth), and enterprise/cloud platforms, ensuring consistent system behavior and readiness
* Act as a **Product Owner**, maintaining and prioritizing feature backlog (WSJF or similar), leading backlog grooming, and ensuring alignment with business priorities and system architecture
* Define and manage **system and feature requirements (SRS/MFRD)** with full traceability across system, software, and validation
* Collaborate with **product teams, Cat Digital, architects, and onboard/offboard engineering teams** to deliver scalable connectivity solutions aligned with customer use cases
* Lead **system validation and quality assurance**, ensuring full feature coverage, production readiness, and robust integration across all subsystems
* Perform **deep system\-level debugging and root cause analysis** across embedded, connectivity, and cloud layers to resolve complex issues
* Apply **DFMEA and Built\-In Quality (BIQ) practices** to proactively identify risks and ensure high system reliability
* Drive **data\-driven decision making** using validation data, system insights, and field feedback to continuously improve performance and quality
* Support **release management**, including Go/No\-Go decisions, release readiness, and tracking feature delivery

Level: Extensive Experience

* Organizes and prioritizes the sequence of steps to be taken to remedy the situation.
* Identifies many possible causes for a problem based on prior experience and current research.
* Quantifies the costs, benefits, risks and chances for success before recommending a course of action.

Level: Working Knowledge


* Delivers helpful feedback that focuses on behaviors without offending the recipient.
* Listens to feedback without defensiveness and uses it for own communication effectiveness.
* Makes oral presentations and writes reports needed for own work.


**Teamwork:** Knowledge of the necessity and value of teamwork; experience with; ability to work cooperatively towards shared goals and being supportive of others at all levels.



Level: Working Knowledge


* Explains own role and responsibility within team.
* Actively participates in team meetings.
* Shares information, knowledge, and experiences openly and proactively.


**Technical Excellence:** Knowledge of a given technology and various application methods; ability to develop and provide solutions to significant technical challenges.



Level: Working Knowledge


* Provides effective technical solutions to routine functional challenges via sound technical competence, effectively examining implications of events and issues.
* Effectively performs the technical job aspects, continuously building knowledge and keeping up\-to\-date on technical and procedural job components.
* Applies technical operating and project standards based on achieving excellence in delivered products, technologies and services.


**Producing Results:** Understanding of the criticality of getting things done in spite of current circumstances and the ability to utilize assigned resources and leverage back\-channel resources (individuals or teams) to achieve or exceed planned outcomes.



Level: Working Knowledge


* Finds or creates ways to measure performance against goals.
* Identifies and exploits own strengths; solicits support from others to minimize limitations.
* Strives for excellence in performance by surpassing established standards.


**Software Development:** Knowledge of software development tools and activities; ability to produce software products or systems in line with product requirements. Level: Extensive Experience

* Elaborates on multiple\-development toolkits for traditional and web\-based software.
* Has participated in development of multiple or large software products.
* Contrasts advantages and drawbacks of different development languages and tools.


**Requirements Analysis:** Knowledge of tools, methods, and techniques of requirement analysis; ability to elicit, analyze and record required business functionality and non\-functionality requirements to ensure the success of a system or software development project.



Level: Extensive Experience

* Ensures the successful completion of all major activities, tasks and deliverables pertaining to the requirement analysis stage.
* Supervises the advanced use of requirements analysis tools and services, including prototyping and use cases.

Level: Working Knowledge

September 7, 2026 \- September 13, 2026

title: Principal Architect-UI Platforms
description:
****Overview****
 Architect, UI Platforms, Windows Platform \& Developer (WPD) Organization
   

  

**Overview**
 Would you like to help shape the UI platform that powers Windows experiences used by millions of developers and customers every day? The Windows Platform \& Developer (WPD) Organization team builds and evolves the UI frameworks and APIs that first and thirdparty developers rely on to create highquality desktop and enterprise line\-of\-business (LOB) applications.
   

  

 We are looking for a UI Platform Architect to help guide the next phase of Windows UI Platform’s evolution (including WinUI3\) —modernizing the platform, improving fundamentals such as performance and reliability, and ensuring the developer experience meets the expectations of today’s desktop and enterprise app builders. This role blends strategic thinking with handson technical leadership and offers the opportunity to influence a widely used platform while staying close to real developer scenarios.
   

  

 As a UI Platform Architect, you will also focus on evolving WinUI into a modern, AI‑native UI framework that remains competitive with SwiftUI while embracing a future where agents author a significant portion of application code. This requires rethinking WinUI as a declarative, composable, and semantically rich platform—one that is easy for web and SwiftUI developers to adopt, straightforward for AI agents to reason about, and powerful enough to enable dynamic, personalized user experiences at scale.
   

  

**As an UI Platform Architect,you will focus on**
* AI‑first developer experience: Design WinUI to be natively consumable by AI agents, with clear semantic models, stable abstractions, and predictable composition patterns that allow agents to author, refactor, and optimize UI code at scale.
* Seamless migration and adoption: Use AI‑assisted tooling and compatibility layers to enable low‑friction migration from legacy Windows UI stacks and SwiftUI on macOS, making WinUI a competitive and approachable choice for modern app developers.
* Declarative, dynamic UI foundation: Evolve WinUI into a truly declarative, state‑driven framework that supports real‑time personalization, adaptive layouts, and agent‑driven UI mutation without sacrificing performance or reliability.
* Lowering the barrier for web and SwiftUI developers: Provide opinionated projections, simplified APIs, and familiar programming models that align with modern web and SwiftUI mental models, accelerating time‑to‑productivity on Windows.
* Future‑proofing for AI‑generated code: Architect WinUI so that a majority of UI code can be safely generated and maintained by AI agents—emphasizing composability, guardrails, testability, and runtime validation.


****Responsibilities****
 As a Windows UI Platform Principal Architect, you will provide technical leadership across the Windows UI platform and work closely with engineering, program management, and partner teams.
   

  

**Platform architecture and technical leadership**
* Define and evolve the architectural direction for WinUI and related Windows UI components, ensuring designs are scalable, maintainable, and aligned with long‑term platform goals.
* Review and guide architecture and design proposals across multiple teams, helping ensure consistency and technical quality.
* Act as a trusted technical advisor and sounding board for senior engineers and leaders working across UI, shell, graphics, input, and app model areas.


**Modernization and quality of fundamentals**
* Drive improvements in core platform fundamentals that matter to real desktop and LOB apps, including startup performance, memory usage, responsiveness, reliability, accessibility, and theming.
* Help identify and address common friction points that developers encounter when building or modernizing Windows desktop applications.


****Developer Experience And Adoption****
* Influence API design patterns, lifecycle models, diagnostics, and tooling to make the platform easier and more predictable to build on.
* Partner with PM and engineering teams to improve guidance and reduce friction for teams adopting newer UI technologies.
* Engage constructively with the developer community (including open‑source communities where appropriate) to incorporate feedback and improve trust in the platform.


**Mentorship and architecture culture**
* Mentor senior ICs and aspiring architects, raising the overall bar for technical decision‑making and design quality.
* Promote clear written specs, design reviews, and thoughtful technical storytelling across the organization.


**Frontier mindset and AI\-powered productivity**
* Demonstrate a frontier\-firm mindset: stay ahead of emerging UI platform trends (including AI\-native UX patterns), challenge assumptions, and prototype quickly to de\-risk big bets.
* Use modern AI tools responsibly to increase personal and team efficiency (e.g., drafting specs, summarizing design discussions, generating test ideas, exploring API surface options), while maintaining high standards for correctness, security, and privacy.
* Create reusable accelerators (prompts, templates, automation, reference implementations) that help teams move faster without sacrificing quality, reliability, accessibility, or maintainability.
* Model a culture of learning and iteration: share best practices, run lightweight demos, and help the organization adopt effective AI\-assisted workflows.


****Qualifications****
**Required/Minimum Qualifications:**
* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 8\+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C\+\+, C\#
+ OR equivalent experience.

* Significant hands‑on experience building desktop or rich‑client applications, with a strong focus on UX quality and system fundamentals.
* Depth in one or more UI frameworks for desktop or cross‑platform development, such as WinForms, WPF, WinUI, SwiftUI, UIKit/AppKit, .NET MAUI, Avalonia UI, Qt, Uno Platform, Flutter, or Electron in strongly desired.
* Proficiency in C\+\+ and/or C\# (or comparable systems languages), with the ability to reason across framework, runtime, and OS layers.
* Experience navigating UI architecture tradeoffs involving performance, memory, rendering, input, threading, accessibility, and app lifecycle.
* Demonstrated ability to influence technical direction beyond your immediate team through design reviews, architectural guidance, or technical leadership.


**Other Requirements:** 
 Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:
   

  

* Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

title: Senior Manager, App Dev & Support
description:
Through our dedicated associates, Conduent delivers mission\-critical services and solutions on behalf of Fortune 100 companies and over 500 governments \- creating exceptional outcomes for our clients and the millions of people who count on them. You have an opportunity to personally thrive, make a difference and be part of a culture where individuality is noticed and valued every day.
   

  

**Job Description:**
**Senior Technical Architect (Application Modernization)**
 We are seeking a visionary Technical Architect with a deep background in Application Modernization to lead a critical digital transformation. This role is focused on deconstructing a legacy 2\-tier architecture and rebuilding it into a scalable, high\-performance N\-tier system.
   

  

 You will be the bridge between the past and the future—moving our logic out of SQL stored procedures and migrating our legacy C\# frontend into a modern, responsive React/Redux ecosystem.
   

  

**Core Responsibilities**
* Architectural Strategy: Define the roadmap for migrating a monolithic 2\-tier application (Client/Server) to a decoupled, N\-tier architecture.
* Legacy Deconstruction: Analyze legacy C\# codebases and complex SQL stored procedures to identify business logic for extraction.
* Modernization Execution: Lead the shift of business logic from the database layer into a dedicated C\#/.NET Business Logic Layer (BLL) or Microservices.
* Frontend Leadership: Direct the transition from legacy UI to a modern React.js frontend, utilizing Redux for robust state management using Vite, Material UI, Redux Toolkit, React Query, React Hook Form, and Styled Components/SCSS.
* Ensure cross\-browser compatibility, visual consistency, and WCAG accessibility compliance.
* API Design: Architect and implement secure, RESTful APIs that serve as the communication backbone between the new frontend and the re\-engineered backend.
* Technical Governance: Establish coding standards, design patterns (e.g., Repository, Unit of Work), and CI/CD pipelines tailored for modernization projects.


**Technical Requirements**
 Category Requirements Modernization Proven experience moving logic from Stored Procedures to Application Code (Refactoring the "Smart Database" anti\-pattern). Frontend Expert\-level proficiency in React.js, Redux / Redux Toolkit, Vite, Material UI, React Query, React Hook Form, and Styled Components/SCSS and modern CSS frameworks (Bootstrap). Backend Strong mastery of C\# and .NET (6/7/8/9\+), specifically in building Web APIs and Service Layers (must have strong hands\-on experience in RestSharp, Dapper, Fluent Validations etc.). Database Deep understanding of SQL Server; ability to read/debug complex legacy T\-SQL and optimize new schemas. Architecture Solid grasp of N\-tier architecture, Dependency Injection, and Microservices patterns. Cloud/Containerization Expert\-level proficiency in Cloud (Azure), Docker and Kubernetes. Cache Mechanism Strong mastery in Redis for Cache Management
   

  

**Experience \& Qualifications**
* Modernization Veteran: 15\+ years of experience in software engineering, with at least 5\+ years specifically leading Legacy\-to\-Modern migration projects.
* The "2\-to\-N" Specialist: Demonstrated success in breaking down 2\-tier "Fat Client" or "Fat DB" systems into modular N\-tier environments.
* Strategic Thinker: Ability to balance "perfect" architecture with business continuity.
* Communication: Ability to explain technical debt and architectural ROI to stakeholders who may only see the UI changes.
* Industry certifications would definitely be considered.


 Conduent is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers applicants for all positions without regard to race, color, creed, religion, ancestry, national origin, age, gender identity, gender expression, sex/gender, marital status, sexual orientation, physical or mental disability, medical condition, use of a guide dog or service animal, military/veteran status, citizenship status, basis of genetic information, or any other group protected by law.

title: Principal Software Architect
description:
**Opentext \- The Information Company**
 OpenText is a global leader in information management, where innovation, creativity, and collaboration are the key components of our corporate culture. As a member of our team, you will have the opportunity to partner with the most highly regarded companies in the world, tackle complex issues, and contribute to projects that shape the future of digital transformation.
   

  

**AI\-First. Future\-Driven. Human\-Centered.**
 At OpenText, AI is at the heart of everything we do—powering innovation, transforming work, and empowering digital knowledge workers. We're hiring talent that AI can't replace to help us shape the future of information management. Join us.
   

  

**Your Impact**
 Sets data and applied AI architecture direction for OpenText, working across product lines rather than within a single team. Defines how OpenText builds and governs data platforms (warehousing, lakehouses, graphs, vector stores) and the applied AI systems built on top of them. Acts as a technical authority that other architects and engineering teams consult on data and applied AI decisions.
   

  

**What The Role Offers**
* Design and review data architectures (warehouses, lakehouses, data platforms, graph and vector stores) that support analytics and AI workloads, including data quality, lineage, and governance (e.g., using layered patterns such as medallion/bronze\-silver\-gold where applicable).
* Evaluate and recommend data contract and product standards (e.g., ODCS, ODPS) for cross\-product adoption.
* Define reference architectures and patterns for applied AI systems (RAG, agentic AI, LLM integration) that other product teams can adopt, including governance considerations such as safety filtering, bias assessment, human\-in\-the\-loop mechanisms, and audit evidence requirements for autonomous/agentic systems.
* Advise on agentic AI architecture, including interoperability protocols such as MCP and A2A as well as emerging standards such as OpenID AuthZEN and OIDC\-A.
* Partner with product architects across OpenText to align data and AI architecture decisions with company\-wide standards. 6\.Represent data engineering and applied AI perspectives in architecture review boards and standards discussions. 7\.Communicate architectural trade\-offs to executive and non\-technical stakeholders, influencing direction across product lines without formal authority.
* Mentor other architects informally on data engineering and applied AI practices, without formal people\-management responsibility.


**What You Need To Succeed**
 1\.10\+ years in software architecture, data engineering, or AI/ML systems, or equivalent demonstrated depth.
   

  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent professional experience.
* Track record operating as a software architect across multiple teams or products, not just within a single team.
* Demonstrated design of production data architectures at scale (e.g., data warehouse, lakehouse, or data platform), using layered patterns such as medallion/bronze\-silver\-gold where applicable.
* Hands\-on experience architecting applied AI systems (e.g., RAG pipelines, LLM\-integrated services) that have shipped to production.
* Experience building cloud\-native applications on a major hyperscaler (AWS, Azure, or GCP), including containerized applications deployed on Kubernetes.


**One last thing**
 Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field.
   

  

 Prior cross\-product or cross\-org architecture role at a similarly sized enterprise software company.
   

  

 Breadth across data warehousing, lakehouses, data platforms, graphs, and vector technologies, valued over deep specialization in a single area.
   

  

 Familiarity with data contract/product standards such as ODCS (Open Data Contract Standard) or ODPS (Open Data Product Specification).
   

  

 Familiarity with data catalog and metadata management tools (e.g., Unity Catalog, Google Cloud Dataplex Universal Catalog, Apache Atlas, or equivalent).
   

  

 Experience with graph databases and building knowledge graphs.
   

  

 Experience with vector database technologies and embedding pipelines in production RAG systems (e.g., pgvector, Milvus, or equivalent).
   

  

 Experience designing streaming data architectures (e.g., Kafka, Flink, Delta Live Tables, or equivalent) alongside batch/medallion patterns.
   

  

 Experience with agentic AI architecture and interoperability protocols (MCP, A2A) or similar emerging standards.
   

  

 Familiarity with agentic AI safety patterns, including prompt injection defenses, guardrail design, and PII handling in agentic contexts.

title: Senior CAD Engineer
description:
NVIDIA has been redefining computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. Today, we're tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing — an era in which our GPUs act as the brains of computers, robots, and self\-driving cars. Doing what's never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world's best talent. Come join our diverse team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.
   

  

 We are now looking for a Physical Design Methodology and Operations Engineer! You'll join a small team that owns the infrastructure powering NVIDIA's semiconductor design flows — coordinating hundreds of thousands of jobs per day across datacenters with 10,000\+ hosts, serving over 1,000 chip designers worldwide. Our platform spans job orchestration, event\-driven trigger systems, global service interconnection, web interfaces to tools, and a Jenkins\-like CI/CD backbone — a production system with direct stakes in GPU, CPU, SoC and networking tapeouts. You'll own a functional area within the team while contributing across broader operations. Our stack includes mature Perl and Python services alongside modern React frontends and Elasticsearch\-based telemetry. We're actively modernizing, and we need someone who can think architecturally — evaluating what we have, identifying what needs to change, and driving that evolution in a way the team can execute and maintain. If you want to own something critical at scale and shape how it grows, this role is for you.
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing**
* Designing and supporting mechanisms for coordinating and maintaining large\-scale semiconductor design tasks across multiple global datacenters.
* Owning the architecture of one or more platform components — defining interfaces, data models, and service boundaries that can scale and evolve.
* Leading the modernization of legacy services — evaluating existing Perl and Python backends, proposing migration strategies, and driving execution with the team.
* Debugging and improving production services spanning web browsers, containerized microservices, and bare\-metal Linux hosts.
* Building and improving web interfaces to configure, launch, and analyze EDA tools and design flows.
* Mining and analyzing large datasets of job execution telemetry and tool quality\-of\-results data to improve flows and catch regressions.
* Mentoring junior engineers and contributing to design reviews and technical standards across the team.
* Helping invent next\-generation semiconductor design methodology.
* Optionally, contributing directly to the physical design of GPU, CPU, SoC, and networking products — a rare opportunity for an infrastructure engineer.


**What We Want To See**
* Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science or computer systems engineering (or equivalent experience).
* 5\+ years of software engineering experience, with a track record of designing and delivering production systems.
* Strong software architecture and design skills — experience defining service boundaries, APIs, data models, and system interfaces.
* Proficiency in Python and/or Perl; comfort with JavaScript and web technologies.
* Experience with distributed systems at meaningful scale.
* Proven ability to lead a project through its full lifecycle, from requirement solicitation to architecture design, to implementation, to maintenance and support.
* Comfort owning and debugging Linux\-based production services.


**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**
* Experience with workflow orchestration systems (Airflow, Argo, Temporal, Luigi, or similar).
* Experience with containerization technologies such as Docker or Kubernetes.
* Familiarity with Elasticsearch / Kibana / Vega for telemetry and dashboarding.
* Experience with MSSQL/Mysql/SQLite or other relational and NoSQL datastores.
* Exposure to Static Timing Analysis or VLSI physical design.


 NVIDIA is widely considered one of the technology world's most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward\-thinking and talented people in the world working for us. If you're an engineer who thinks in systems, takes pride in designing things that last, and wants to see the silicon your work helps produce — we want to hear from you.

description:

As an increasing number of enterprises move their critical systems to the cloud, AWS India is in need of highly efficient technical consulting talent to help our largest and strategically important customers navigate the operational challenges and complexities of AWS Cloud. We are looking for Technical Consultants to support our customers creative and transformative spirit of innovation across all technologies, including Compute, Storage, Database, Data Analytics, Application services, Networking, Server\-less and more.
