Established in 1990, we are now a 1000\+ member strong global organization with a presence in 25 countries.
   

  

 For more information about sa.global, please click www.saglobal.com.
   

  

**Why choose sa.global**
 Open, flexible, vibrant, collaborative, and diverse – these are just some of the terms that our employees use to describe the culture at sa.global. We believe and encourage innovative and dynamic thinking. Our culture and values give us the extra edge to help us scale greater heights.
   

  

**Led by our Core Values:** 
 Agile, Capable, and Committed, which form an integral part of who we are, we constantly strive to provide an inclusive work environment. Our employees come from varied cultural and social backgrounds, and we strive each day to work towards making sa.global a great place to work.
   

  

**Values of sa.global**
* Contribute towards a working environment that represents “one sa.global” where everyone is seen as an equal, and equality and diversity is championed.
* Interact with a wide variety of colleagues, customers, and stakeholders at all levels with respect, courtesy, and professionalism.
* Come as you are, make work fun \& others successful, and foster an always learning mentality.


**About The Role**
 We offer a career with growth opportunities in a dynamic, collaborative, and supportive organization. We also have a strong and ethical working culture. If you'd to work with a team that is passionate about their work while also having a good sense of fun, you might have just found what you are looking for!
   

  

 sa.global is looking for a motivated and skilled D365 Customer Engagement (CE) Technical Consultant to join our dynamic consulting team in India! In this role, you will build robust CE solutions while leveraging cutting\-edge AI capabilities to drive intelligent business outcomes.
   

  

**Job Description**
* Customize and configure the D365 CE platform using various tools and technologies including but not limited to Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI, and Copilot Studio.
* Design, develop, and deploy custom solutions, plugins, custom workflows, and integrations using the D365 CE SDK, C\#, JavaScript, and other relevant programming languages.
* Design and implement AI\-driven features within the Power Platform ecosystem, utilizing AI Builder, Microsoft Copilot integrations, and Azure Cognitive Services to enhance user productivity and automate processes.
* Extend the functionality of D365 CE by creating custom entities, attributes, relationships, and business rules to meet the specific business requirements of the organization.
* Implement integrations with other systems, both within the Microsoft ecosystem (e.g., SharePoint, Azure, Office 365\) and external third\-party applications using various integration methods and APIs.
* Integrate external AI models and Large Language Models (LLMs) via Azure OpenAI or custom RESTful APIs into D365 CE and Power Apps workflows.
* Assist in data migration activities including data extraction, transformation, and loading into the D365 CE platform.
* Conduct unit testing and debugging of customizations to ensure that they meet the specified requirements and are free of defects.
* Create and maintain technical documentation, including technical design documents, code documentation, and deployment instructions.
* Ensure that all customizations and developments adhere to security and compliance standards, including data protection and access control.
* Collaborate with functional consultants, business analysts, and other stakeholders to understand business requirements and translate them into technical, AI\-enhanced solutions.
* Keep up to date with the latest features, updates, and best practices related to D365 CE development and emerging AI trends, ensuring that the organization is leveraging the platform effectively.


**The Requirements For This Role Include**
* Demonstrated 7\+ years of experience as a D365 CE Developer.
* Strong proficiency in C\#, JavaScript, HTML, and web services development.
* Familiar with D365 CE customization and configuration using Power Apps, Power Automate, and Power BI.
* Practical knowledge of integrating AI capabilities within Dynamics 365, including experience with AI Builder, Copilot Studio (Power Virtual Agents), or Azure AI.
* Knowledge of D365 CE SDK and development tools such as Visual Studio and Azure DevOps.
* Experience with integration tools and methods, RESTful APIs, and data migration.
* Fundamental understanding of prompt engineering and how to apply AI to solve CRM\-specific business challenges.
* Understanding software development best practices, including version control and code review processes.
* Graduate degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.

title: Technical Document Writer
description:
**A Snapshot of Your Day**
--------------------------


You will develop accurate, user\-centric, and technically sound documentation for SCADA systems in wind turbine operations, supporting engineering, commissioning, operations, and maintenance teams.


The role requires close collaboration with SCADA engineers, network architects, software developers, and field technicians to document highly technical content related to wind farm control systems, networking architecture, data acquisition, and remote monitoring. You will translate complex engineering concepts into clear and usable documentation, ensuring consistency, quality, and alignment with industry standards.

**How You’ll Make an Impact**
-----------------------------

* Create and maintain comprehensive documentation for SCADA software and network infrastructure
* Develop system architecture and topology diagrams
* Prepare network configuration guides (switches, routers, firewalls)
* Document communication protocols (e.g., IEC 60870\-5\-104, Modbus, OPC)
* Develop installation and commissioning manuals
* Define cybersecurity and access control procedures
* Document alarm handling and data logging processes
* Create end\-user and admin operation guides
* Develop assembly work instructions
* Prepare electrical work instructions and wiring routing for SCADA panels
* Work on product specifications and engineering circuit drawings
* Manage BoM and components documentation
* Translate complex engineering concepts into clear documentation for technical and non\-technical stakeholders
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams (SCADA engineers, software developers, OT/IT teams, vendors) to gather source content
* Use documentation tools such as MS Office, Excel, Visio, Markdown, LaTeX, XML/DITA, and version control systems (e.g., Git)
* Ensure consistency in format, terminology, and compliance with industry standards and company style guidelines
* Regularly update documentation based on system upgrades, regulatory changes, and new deployments

**What You Bring**
------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Technical Communication, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field with 3 to 6 years of experience
* Experience as a technical writer in the energy, automation, or SCADA domain
* Solid understanding of SCADA systems, industrial networking, and data acquisition principles
* Familiarity with wind turbine operations, control systems, and remote monitoring tools
* Strong grasp of networking concepts (TCP/IP, VLANs, VPNs, IP routing)
* Proficiency in creating structured technical documents using tools like MS Office, Excel, Visio, Xmetal, LaTeX, Markdown, or Sphinx
* Experience working in Agile engineering environments and interpreting technical drawings and network schematics using NX software / SEE Electrical software

**About the Team**
------------------


You will be part of a collaborative and cross\-functional team supporting SCADA systems and wind energy solutions. The team works closely across engineering, software, and operations functions to ensure accurate documentation and smooth system deployment.


The environment encourages knowledge sharing, continuous learning, and high\-quality documentation practices, enabling teams to effectively operate and maintain wind turbine systems while contributing to Siemens Energy’s mission of sustainable energy solutions.

Together, we are committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. As a leading player in the wind industry and manufacturer of wind turbines, we are passionate about driving the energy transition and providing innovative solutions that meet the growing energy demand of the global community. At Siemens Gamesa, we are always looking for dedicated individuals to join our team and support our focus on energy transformation.

description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.


This Position reports to:


R\&D Team Manager **What We Believe In**


ABB's Process Automation business area enables customers to operate some of the world's largest and most complex industrial infrastructures, helping them outrun – leaner and cleaner.


We deliver automation, electrification, and digital solutions across process, hybrid, and maritime industries through advanced industrial software, distributed control systems, safety solutions, and analytics technologies that accelerate digital transformation and operational excellence.

**Your Role and Responsibilities**
----------------------------------


In this role, we are looking for a Senior R\&D Software Engineer – Control Library Development to join our Energy Industries Digital Organization. You will contribute to the design, development, validation, and lifecycle management of AC 800M Control Libraries that power ABB's industrial automation and safety systems.


Working as part of a collaborative Agile engineering team, you will develop reusable control software components, perform product validation, and ensure the delivery of robust, reliable, and standards\-compliant automation solutions while partnering with Product Management, Architects, Safety Engineers, Quality Engineering, and global R\&D teams.


This role is contributing to the Energy Industries – AC 800M Control Library Development, Testing, Validation \& Lifecycle Support organization in Bangalore, India.


The work model for the role is: Hybrid

**You will be mainly accountable for**

* Design, develop, maintain, and validate AC 800M Control Library components, reusable function blocks, communication interfaces, and engineering modules while ensuring compliance with ABB engineering, quality, and functional safety standards.
* Perform impact analysis, product integration, regression testing, release validation, compatibility assessments, and root\-cause analysis to ensure reliable, high\-quality software throughout the product lifecycle.
* Collaborate with Product Management, Architects, Safety Engineers, Quality Engineering, and global R\&D teams to deliver customer\-focused solutions while participating in technical reviews, release readiness activities, and continuous product improvements.
* Drive engineering excellence by mentoring team members, adopting AI\-assisted engineering tools, promoting reusable engineering practices, contributing to innovation initiatives, and continuously improving software quality, testing effectiveness, and engineering productivity.

**Qualifications for the Role**
-------------------------------

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics, Electrical, Instrumentation, Automation Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* 6–10 years of experience in industrial automation, control systems, software development, testing, validation, or functional safety engineering.
* Strong experience with ABB System 800xA, AC 800M, Control Builder M, IEC 61131\-3 Structured Text, and control library development, testing, validation, and lifecycle management.
* Knowledge of IEC 61508 Functional Safety, regression testing, integration testing, release validation, impact analysis, and product quality assurance methodologies is preferred.
* Experience with Azure DevOps, Agile development practices, AI\-assisted engineering tools, and modern software engineering workflows is considered an advantage.
* Proven ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues, mentor engineers, contribute to reusable engineering solutions, and drive innovation across product development activities.
* Strong analytical, communication, collaboration, and problem\-solving skills with a commitment to engineering excellence, continuous learning, and delivering high\-quality industrial software.

**More About Us**
-----------------


ABB's Energy Industries business serves customers across hydrocarbons, chemicals, pharmaceuticals, power generation, water, and other process industries by delivering integrated automation, electrification, and digital solutions that improve operational efficiency, safety, sustainability, and reliability.


Our R\&D organization develops next\-generation industrial automation software, distributed control systems, safety solutions, and digital engineering platforms that help customers optimize operations and accelerate their digital transformation. By combining deep domain expertise with advanced technologies, ABB continues to shape the future of industrial automation.


At ABB, you'll collaborate with global engineering teams to develop mission\-critical automation software, enhance functional safety solutions, and contribute to innovative industrial control technologies. We foster a culture of innovation, continuous learning, diversity, and inclusion where every individual is empowered to make a meaningful impact.


ABB is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants. Employment is subject to applicable background verification and pre\-employment screening in accordance with ABB policies.

  

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.


Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

ABB never asks for payment from job applicants. All genuine job offers follow a formal application and interview process.

title: Senior Solutions Architect
description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100\* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.



The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high\-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co\-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.


* *Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025\. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.*
**An overview of this role**
----------------------------



As a Senior Solutions Architect on GitLab's India team, you'll be a trusted advisor to prospects, customers, and partners across India. You'll help them understand how GitLab's AI\-powered DevSecOps platform addresses technical requirements and business goals across the software development lifecycle. This role supports Commercial and Enterprise segments in India's Southern Region. Experience with Global Capability Centers (GCCs), Digital Native organizations, and startups is highly valued given the accounts you'll support.



You'll partner closely with Account Executives and cross\-functional teams to own technical evaluations, including proofs of value and workshops, shape solution architectures, and bring customer feedback to Product Management. You'll also occasionally support regional go\-to\-market partners that provide Professional Services. Your work will help customers adopt GitLab successfully, support revenue growth through solution selling, and build long\-term, trusted relationships.


**What you’ll do**
------------------


* Lead technical discovery, demonstrations, and validation to show how GitLab's AI\-powered DevSecOps platform meets customers' technical and business needs across the software development lifecycle.
* Own the technical evaluation process, including solution design, proofs of concept or value, workshops, and technical contributions to tenders, audits, and value stream assessments.
* Collaborate with Account Executives and regional sales teams across Commercial and Enterprise segments to shape account strategies for new customer acquisition and expansion, with a focus on GCC, Digital Native, and startup accounts.
* Support regional go\-to\-market partners that provide Professional Services, helping them deliver consistent technical guidance and apply effective practices during partner\-led engagements.
* Represent GitLab at online and in\-person marketing events, including webinars, industry events, presentations, roundtables, panels, demonstration days, and hackathons.
* Build trusted relationships with technical practitioners and business leaders, guide GitLab\-driven transformation, and help customers become GitLab advocates.
* Advise customers on modern software development, continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD), security, and cloud practices to improve their return on investment.
* Share customer feedback, use cases, and competitive insights with Product Management, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing while continuing to build expertise and reusable guidance in GitLab, DevSecOps, AI, and cloud technologies.

**What you’ll bring**
---------------------


* Experience guiding Commercial and Enterprise customers through solution design and evaluation in technical presales, consulting, or a similar role.
* Experience working with India's GCCs, Digital Native organizations, and startups is highly valued.
* Knowledge of the end\-to\-end software development lifecycle, including modern DevSecOps practices and CI/CD workflows.
* Hands\-on experience with GitLab or comparable source control, CI/CD, and collaboration platforms, with the ability to connect platform capabilities to customer use cases.
* Practical knowledge of cloud computing concepts and related technologies, including deployment, security, and operations options.
* Ability to lead proofs of concept or value, contribute to tenders or audits, and design and run workshops or value stream assessments.
* Clear technical communication and presentation skills, with the ability to adapt your message for practitioners and senior business and technical decision\-makers.
* Skill in building trusted relationships, listening with empathy, advocating for customers, collaborating with go\-to\-market or Professional Services partners, and continuously learning new technologies.

**About the team**
------------------



The Solutions Architect team is part of GitLab's Sales organization and serves as the technical counterpart to Account Executives. This role focuses on Commercial and Enterprise opportunities across India's Southern Region and works with Account Executives, the broader go\-to\-market team, and regional partners that provide Professional Services. The team advises on architecture, runs technical evaluations such as proofs of value, and guides customers through digital transformation. We collaborate asynchronously with Sales, Product Management, Engineering, and Marketing to share effective practices, create reusable technical resources, and represent the voice of the customer. Our focus is helping customers modernize software delivery, adopt GitLab at scale, and navigate a changing AI and DevSecOps landscape.

#### **How GitLab Supports Full\-Time Employees**


* Benefits to support your health, finances, and well\-being
* Flexible Paid Time Off
* Team Member Resource Groups
* Equity Compensation \& Employee Stock Purchase Plan
* Growth and Development Fund
* Parental Leave

Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.



**Country Hiring Guidelines:** GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location\-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.


**Privacy Policy:** Please review our Recruitment Privacy Policy. Your privacy is important to us.



GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. title: Senior Engineering Leader
description:
### **Job Title**

Senior Engineering Leader
### **Job Description**

**Job Profile: Director, Cardiology R\&D and Cloud Operations**

Compensation Grade: CG80 \| Function: Philips Cardiology Informatics R\&D


This Director\-level role provides strategic and operational leadership for Philips Cardiology Informatics R\&D, with accountability for software engineering leadership, cloud\-enabled product development, service and cloud operations, and lifecycle ownership of a large, regulated healthcare customer install base. The role is responsible for leading diverse and globally connected teams, aligning execution with business priorities, and ensuring that product creation, operational excellence, quality, regulatory expectations, and customer outcomes are delivered at scale.


**Role Purpose**
================

The leader will drive cloud operations and R\&D execution for cardiology solutions, including AWS\-based cloud platforms and services, while maintaining a strong focus on healthcare\-regulated product delivery, customer reliability, and operational continuity for an install base of up to approximately 5,000 B2B healthcare customers.


**Key Responsibilities**
========================

* Lead software R\&D and cloud operations teams across cardiology informatics portfolios, ensuring cohesive execution across functions, sites, and global stakeholders.
* Own operational performance for cloud\-driven products and services, including reliability, scalability, service continuity, incident response, and continuous improvement.
* Manage and maintain a healthcare\-regulated B2B customer install base of up to approximately 5,000 customers, ensuring high levels of customer trust, compliance, availability, and responsiveness.
* Translate business goals, customer and market needs, and technical strategy into multi\-year execution plans aligned with Health Suite Reference Architecture, cloud, DevOps, and platform modernization priorities.
* Provide oversight for planning, staffing, budgeting, expense prioritization, resource allocation, and execution governance across teams and programs.
* Influence product creation, software development processes, architecture decisions, and engineering practices to improve efficiency, quality, security, and regulatory readiness.
* Serve as a senior R\&D liaison with service, operations, quality, regulatory, commercial, and external stakeholder organizations to drive business outcomes and customer value.
* Lead talent management, succession planning, performance management, and leadership development for subordinate managers, architects, and technical leaders.
* Contribute to 2–3\-year operational planning and the 5\-year Strategic Plan of Record, shaping long\-term objectives and adapting strategy to evolving business and customer needs.

**Minimum Required Qualifications**
===================================

**Education**
-------------

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or an equivalent technical discipline. Minimum 18\+ years of relevant experience with a Bachelor’s degree, or equivalent senior leadership experience with a Master’s degree, in software development, software design and architecture, testing, quality assurance, cloud operations, or regulated product development. Minimum 8\+ years of working experience in the healthcare domain is required.


**Primary Requirements**
------------------------

* Proven experience successfully leading cloud teams, preferably AWS\-based, with strong understanding of cloud\-native engineering, service operations, R\&D architecture, and DevOps operating models.
* Demonstrated ability to run cloud\-driven development and customer\-facing operations in a regulated healthcare environment.
* Experience delivering, managing, and sustaining a large B2B healthcare customer install base, up to approximately 5,000 customers.
* Strong understanding of healthcare regulations, quality management expectations, FDA/MDR audit readiness, and software lifecycle controls for regulated medical or healthcare solutions.
* Domain exposure to cardiology and/or radiology workflows, clinical informatics, hospital operations, or adjacent healthcare technology environments.

**Preferred Qualifications**
============================

**Education**
-------------

Master’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Healthcare Informatics, or an equivalent technical or engineering discipline is preferred.


**Preferred Skills and Capabilities**
-------------------------------------

* Software Development Life Cycle leadership, including agile execution, architecture governance, design controls, verification, validation, and release readiness.
* Cloud operations leadership, including AWS, DevOps, service reliability, incident and escalation management, observability, resilience, and operational governance.
* Business acumen, strategic planning, portfolio management, budget management, resource planning, and stakeholder management across global functions.
* People leadership, including management through subordinate managers, technical leadership development, succession planning, performance management, and organizational capability building.
* Quality, regulatory, and audit readiness experience, including healthcare regulations, FDA/MDR expectations, risk\-based decision\-making, and regulated software delivery.

title: Senior Solution Architect IT/OT Security Platforms (f/m/d)
description:
Siemens IT enables secure, reliable and scalable digital services for Siemens businesses and factories worldwide. Within IT IPS, we develop and operate services that support the transformation of industrial environments towards modern, secure and standardized IT/OT operations.


As a Solution Architect for our **IT/OT Security Platforms** you will define the technical vision and architecture for strategic service offerings. You will work closely with factories, cybersecurity experts, service managers, product teams, and technology partners to design scalable, secure, and future\-ready solutions that support Siemens' Zero Trust and digitalization strategy. Our **OT Zero Trust Platform** enables secure IT/OT communication through identity\-based connectivity concepts, while our **OT Patch Management** enables centralized endpoint management, patching, hardening and compliance for enterprise and production\-related devices.


**What we offer you**


At Siemens, our Total Rewards approach is designed to inspire innovation, reward impact, and support your well\-being at every stage of your career. From competitive pay and benefits to recognition and development opportunities, we help you thrive both personally and professionally.

 **You'll make an impact by**


* You design and evolve the target architecture for our IT/OT Security Platforms (SINEC Secure Connect and ManageEngine), ensuring alignment with Siemens cybersecurity, operational, and business requirements.
* You define secure IT/OT communication concepts based on Zero Trust principles and develop architectures for remote access, machine connectivity, application communication, and future AI\-driven use cases.
* You support Siemens factories in integrating modern security and management solutions into existing brownfield environments, considering legacy systems, industrial protocols, and operational constraints.
* You translate business, security, and operational requirements into scalable platform architectures, governance models, technical standards, and implementation roadmaps.
* You collaborate with factories, cybersecurity teams, service owners, vendors, and technology partners to establish architecture standards and drive service adoption across Siemens.
* You define integration concepts between connectivity services, endpoint management platforms, monitoring solutions, automation frameworks, and enterprise systems.
* You evaluate new technologies and architecture patterns and contribute to the continuous evolution of Siemens' IT/OT security and platform landscape.
* You enable data\-driven and AI\-supported operational use cases by designing architectures that support secure data flows, automation, analytics, and platform interoperability.
* You actively shape the journey to AI\-native OT security services
  

**This is how you'll win us over**

* **Education**: You have a university degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Cybersecurity, or a comparable qualification.
* **Experience and Skills**:
	+ You possess strong expertise in Zero Trust and OT Security Architecture, including concepts such as identity\-centric networking, PKI, certificate lifecycle management, and industry frameworks such as NIST SP 800\-207 and IEC 62443\.
	+ You have proven experience with OT Infrastructure and Brownfield Integration (of at least 3\+ years), including industrial environments, legacy systems, machine\-to\-machine communication, industrial protocols, network segmentation, and hybrid IT/OT architectures.
	+ You bring solid knowledge of Endpoint, Asset and Service Management Architectures, including endpoint management, asset discovery, software deployment, patch management, CMDB, and IT service management platforms.
	+ You are experienced in Platform and Enterprise Architecture (of at least 3\+ years) and can translate business and security requirements into scalable technical solutions, governance models, operating concepts, and technology roadmaps.
	+ You possess strong capabilities in Platform Integration, Automation, AI and Analytics, including API\-based integration, monitoring, automation, operational data flows, and AI\-ready platform design.
* **Ways of Working**:
* + You are able to communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders and successfully align diverse stakeholder groups.
	+ You work in a structured and strategic manner and are comfortable operating in international and cross\-functional environments.
	+ You provide your support during Central European Time Zone (CET).
* **Languages**: • Fluent English skills complete your profile. German language skills are beneficial.
  


You are much more than your qualifications, and we believe in the potential of every single candidate. We look forward to getting to know you!


**Our Commitment to Equity and Inclusion in our Diverse Global Workforce.** At Siemens, we are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace that values your skills and provides equitable opportunities to progress. To solve the biggest challenges of our time, we need bright minds with the ambition to make the impossible possible. Siemens is the place where you can thrive, challenge the status quo, make an impact, and grow alongside a team of innovators who share your passion for technology. Are you in?

title: Applied AI ML Lead
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  

  

  

Shape the future of software delivery by building applied artificial intelligence solutions that are secure, reliable, and measurable. Join a team that turns advanced methods into production capabilities used by real customers, with strong engineering standards and clear ownership. Bring your expertise in building distributed systems and grow your impact through high\-visibility work, deep technical leadership, and cross\-team collaboration




As an Applied AI ML Lead at JPMorgan Chase, you will architect, build, and operate trusted applied artificial intelligence capabilities used in production. You will partner with product and engineering teams to deliver workflow automation and retrieval\-based solutions that improve user outcomes. You will translate technical tradeoffs across quality, latency, cost, and controls into clear recommendations that accelerate delivery and measurable business impact.




In this role, you will focus on production engineering for applied artificial intelligence, including retrieval\-based question answering and tool\-enabled workflow automation. You will set engineering patterns that improve consistency and reuse across teams, while maintaining strong standards for security, access controls, and operational resilience. You will define how solutions are evaluated, monitored, and improved over time based on real usage and measurable outcomes. This is a hands\-on role with significant influence through design leadership, reviews, and shared practices.


Job Responsibilities


* Own end\-to\-end technical delivery for applied artificial intelligence and machine learning solutions, from requirements shaping through production support.
* Architect retrieval‑augmented generation solutions, including data ingestion, content segmentation, embedding, indexing, retrieval, re\-ranking, and relevance tuning.
* Implement tool\-enabled, agent\-based workflows with orchestration, state management, retries, permissions, guardrails, and observability.
* Define evaluation strategies, including offline test suites, curated datasets, human review where needed, continuous evaluation, and telemetry\-driven monitoring.
* Build reusable engineering patterns and reference implementations that reduce duplication and speed delivery across teams.
* Drive reliability, performance, and cost outcomes through benchmarking, capacity planning, latency optimization, and post\-incident learning.
* Embed security and governance by design, including sensitive\-data\-aware handling, access controls, auditability, and disciplined release practices for models and prompts.
* Influence technical direction through clear design documents, design reviews, and pragmatic decision\-making aligned to partner needs and control requirements.
* Coach peers through pairing, feedback, and best\-practice guidance without direct people management.
* Champion a culture of opportunity, inclusion, and respect in day\-to\-day collaboration.


Required Qualifications, Capabilities, and Skills


* 8\+ years of hands\-on software engineering and/or data engineering experience delivering production distributed systems.
* Proficiency coding in Python and/or Java, including building, testing, and operating services in production.
* Demonstrated delivery of applied artificial intelligence and/or machine learning solutions to production, including monitoring and iterative improvement based on usage.
* Expertise designing retrieval‑augmented generation architectures, including embedding\-based search, retrieval/indexing, re\-ranking, grounding methods, and quality evaluation.
* Experience building tool\-enabled workflow automation (agent\-based patterns) with orchestration, state management, retries, and safety guardrails.
* Strong data engineering fundamentals, including data quality controls, idempotent pipelines, backfills, and metadata/lineage concepts.
* Experience deploying and operating secure, cloud\-native services on Amazon Web Services, including performance, latency, and cost management.
* Strong communication skills to explain technical tradeoffs and recommendations to product and engineering stakeholders.


Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, and Skills


* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.
* Working knowledge of PyTorch or TensorFlow to partner effectively on training, fine\-tuning, and evaluation.
* Experience automating evaluation and quality gates for applied artificial intelligence systems, including regression testing, continuous evaluation, and versioning for prompts and models.
* Familiarity with responsible artificial intelligence practices appropriate for regulated environments, including documentation, testing, and control\-aligned design.


**ABOUT US**  

  

  

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.  

  

We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

  

  

  

**ABOUT THE TEAM**
  

  

J.P. Morgan's Commercial \& Investment Bank is a global leader across banking, markets, securities services and payments. Corporations, governments and institutions throughout the world entrust us with their business in more than 100 countries. The Commercial \& Investment Bank provides strategic advice, raises capital, manages risk and extends liquidity in markets around the world.

title: Quality Engineer 2
description:
Job Description
**About the Role**  

The Arctic Wolf security operations platform ingests and processes upwards of 600 billion events a day from a wide variety of on\-premise devices and cloud platforms. The security pipeline is a distributed system of loosely\-coupled microservices that constitute our Realtime analysis and threat detection systems. These services distil the incoming events into actionable intelligence that our Concierge Security Teams use to protect customers.


We are looking for experienced quality engineers to join our pack and work with us to build and expand the capabilities of our testing platform.


**You Will:**

* Create and extend software frameworks and tools to run, monitor, and report on automated tests. Have experience building and maintaining Automation frameworks and CI/CD pipeline.
* Review testing strategies, approaches, and test plans and provide insight to development teams.
* Architect, design and build software to automate a variety of testing methods (e.g. API validation, performance/load testing, fuzzing, etc.)
* Develop and maintain test frameworks for GenAI\-based and AI/ML applications, including model validation, LLM prompt\-response consistency, hallucination detection, and regression testing for AI inference APIs.
* Implement evaluation pipelines to test LLM accuracy, latency, bias, toxicity, and reliability.
* Work as part of a team of highly skilled software professionals.
* Continuously learn and expand your technical horizons
* Our Technology Stack: Selenium, Playwright, Docker, Kubernetes, AWS (Bedrock, Lambda, SQS, S3, etc.), LangChain, LLM evaluation frameworks (e.g., Ragas), OpenAPI, Postgres, Linux.

**You:**

* Are excited to work at the intersection of AIML, Big Data and the Cybersecurity problem space
* Have 2 \- 4 years of experience shipping quality software
* Love driving high software quality
* Have experience deploying services on cloud computing platforms (e.g, AWS, Azure, GCP)
* Are an expert using common tools for executing functional, load and fuzz testing (e.g. Locust, CATS)
* Have worked on distributed systems and microservices architecture (preferred)

title: Senior Manager, AI and Innovation( Salesforce exp is a must)
description:
*To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.*

Job Category


Customer Success
Job Details


**About Salesforce**

Salesforce is the \#1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.


Ready to level\-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.


**Senior Manager, AI and Innovation( Salesforce exp is a must)**
----------------------------------------------------------------

**About the Role**
------------------

The AI Senior Manager operates at the intersection of strategy and execution — acting as both a **Strategist** , shaping the long\-term technical vision for AI adoption, and an **Orchestrator** , coordinating people, systems, and processes to turn that vision into working solutions. This role is central to designing, scaling, and governing AI and Agentforce\-driven architectures across the delivery organization, ensuring technical decisions align with business outcomes and customer value.


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Strategist Mindset**
----------------------

* Define and evolve the technical architecture strategy for AI initiatives, aligning with broader business and platform roadmaps.
* Evaluate emerging AI technologies (LLMs, agentic frameworks, automation platforms) and recommend where they create differentiated value.
* Partner with delivery, product, and engineering leadership to translate business goals into scalable, secure, and maintainable AI architectures.
* Establish architectural standards, patterns, and best practices for AI solution design across teams.
* Assess technical risk, feasibility, and total cost of ownership for proposed AI initiatives.

**Orchestrator Mindset**
------------------------

* Coordinate cross\-functional teams (engineering, data, product, delivery) to ensure AI solutions are designed, built, and deployed cohesively.
* Serve as the technical glue between strategy and execution — ensuring architecture decisions are implemented consistently across squads and projects.
* Facilitate technical governance forums, architecture reviews, and design decision checkpoints.
* Drive alignment between multiple parallel AI workstreams, resolving dependencies and technical conflicts.
* Mentor and enable technical teams and solution architects on AI\-first design principles.

**Delivery \& Governance**
--------------------------

**Builder Mindset**
-------------------

* Ship working AI solutions hands\-on — prototype, build, and iterate quickly rather than only designing on paper.
* Take ideas from concept to production, personally building agents, automations, and integrations when needed to prove value fast.
* Champion a bias for action: favor working demos and MVPs over long design documents.
* Continuously experiment with new AI tools and techniques, bringing working proofs\-of\-concept back to the team.
* Balance speed of shipping with architectural soundness, ensuring builds are scalable beyond the prototype stage.
* Own end\-to\-end technical quality of AI solutions from design through production readiness.
* Define and monitor architecture health metrics (scalability, reliability, cost\-efficiency, security posture).
* Ensure compliance with data governance, responsible AI, and security standards across all AI implementations.
* Provide technical escalation support for complex AI/architecture issues across the portfolio.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* 13\+ years of experience in software/solution architecture, with demonstrated depth in AI/ML or agentic systems architecture.
* Proven experience architecting and delivering enterprise\-scale AI solutions (e.g., LLM\-based systems, automation platforms, Agentforce, or equivalent).
* Strong grasp of cloud\-native architecture, integration patterns, and platform scalability principles.
* Demonstrated ability to operate as both a strategic thinker and hands\-on technical orchestrator across multiple teams.
* Experience with Salesforce platform architecture is highly valued.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills — able to translate technical concepts for both technical and non\-technical audiences.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

title: Mechanical Engineer
description:
Choosing Capgemini means choosing a place where you’ll be empowered to shape your career, supported by a collaborative global community, and inspired to reimagine what’s possible. Join us in helping leading Mechanical Engineer organizations unlock the value of technology and drive scalable, sustainable growth.


**Your Role**
-------------


We are seeking a Mechanical Design Engineer to join our offshore engineering team in India, supporting the development of automated mobile heavy equipment that removes humans from the dull, dirty, and dangerous jobs. In this role, you will apply industrial design thinking and strong real\-time 3D CAD skills to develop mechanical hardware from concept through production release. You will work closely with engineering, product, and manufacturing counterparts in the United States, contributing designs that balance form, function, manufacturability, and field durability.


**In this role, you will:**


* Develop mechanical designs from concept sketches through detailed 3D models, drawings, and production release.
* Apply industrial design principles — ergonomics, human factors, serviceability, proportion, and product aesthetics — to hardware that operates in demanding field environments.
* Build and maintain parametric 3D CAD models and large assemblies, working in real time within a cloud\-based CAD environment shared across geographies.
* Produce manufacturing\-ready detail drawings with GD\&T, tolerances, bills of material, and engineering change documentation.
* Apply design\-for\-manufacturing (DFM) and design\-for\-assembly (DFA) principles to reduce part count, cost, and assembly time.
* Create concept alternatives, renderings, and design studies to support early decision\-making and design reviews.
* Develop enclosures, brackets, mounts, guards, covers, and operator\-facing hardware in sheet metal, machined, molded, and fabricated forms.
* Support prototyping, fit checks, and design validation, and incorporate feedback from testing and field use into subsequent revisions.
* Coordinate with suppliers and vendors on component selection, tooling feasibility, and manufacturing methods.
* Maintain CAD data hygiene, part numbering, revision control, and design libraries in line with team standards.
**Your Profile**
----------------


* Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering, Product Design, Industrial Design, or a related field.
* 3 to 4 years of experience in mechanical design, preferably in industrial equipment, or heavy machinery.
* Strong industrial design skills with experience in concept development, product appearance, ergonomics, and hardware design.
* Proficient in 3D CAD tools, preferably Soldiworks; experience with, Creo or NX is also valuable.
* Good knowledge of GD\&T, tolerance analysis, and engineering drawing standards (ASME Y14\.5 or ISO).
* Understanding of manufacturing processes such as sheet metal fabrication, machining, welding, casting, extrusion, and injection molding.
* Knowledge of material selection, surface treatments, coatings, and corrosion protection for industrial and outdoor products.
* Familiarity with fasteners, joining methods, and standard mechanical components.
* Basic understanding of structural and thermal analysis is an added advantage.
* Strong English communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to clearly document and explain designs.
* Self\-motivated and capable of managing tasks independently with minimal supervision.
* Good understanding of pneumatic and hydraulic systems.
**What You’ll Love About Working Here**
---------------------------------------


We value flexibility and support our employees with remote work options and adaptable schedules to maintain a healthy work\-life balance.
  

Our inclusive culture brings together diverse professionals committed to growth, innovation, and excellence.

title: Test Architect
description:
##### **Project description**

We are seeking an experienced Test Architect to lead the end\-to\-end test strategy across the domain, embedding quality early in the software development lifecycle through shift\-left practices and leveraging AI to enhance and accelerate testing outcomes. This senior engineering leadership role requires the successful candidate to serve as the technical authority on test automation, quality engineering, and test strategy, establishing standards for designing, measuring, and delivering quality across teams.


##### **Responsibilities**


Define and own the domain\-wide test strategy covering functional, integration, regression, and end\-to\-end testing, ensuring alignment with business objectives, engineering practices, and release goals.


Drive shift\-left quality practices by embedding testing into design and development phases to detect, prevent, and resolve defects early, reducing change costs and delivery risks.


Lead the adoption and application of AI throughout the test lifecycle, including AI\-assisted test generation, coverage analysis, specification\-driven test development, automated code review, and intelligent test prioritization.


Establish and enforce standards for test automation frameworks, tooling selection, reusable test assets, and test data strategy to ensure consistency, maintainability, and scalability across the domain.


Implement and maintain quality gates, coverage targets, and measurable test\-effectiveness metrics, such as defect escape rate, test cycle time, and automation coverage, to provide clear visibility into quality status.


Coach and mentor engineers and test specialists across teams, enhancing test engineering capabilities and serving as the technical escalation point for complex quality issues.


Collaborate with architecture leads, delivery leads, and product owners to align testing approaches with CI/CD pipelines, engineering standards, and release schedules.


Continuously assess and adapt the test strategy in response to technology developments, platform changes, and emerging best practices in quality engineering and AI\-assisted development.


##### **Skills**


Must have


The role requires extensive expertise in test automation, quality engineering, and test architecture, gained through over 15 years of hands\-on experience at an enterprise scale. The candidate should have a strong background in designing and implementing shift\-left testing strategies that integrate quality controls into continuous integration and continuous delivery pipelines.


Hard skills include proficiency with test automation frameworks, specifically Selenium and Playwright, applied to both API and UI testing. The candidate must demonstrate practical experience in utilizing AI and generative AI technologies to enhance engineering and testing workflows, such as AI\-assisted test case creation, specification\-driven testing, intelligent coverage analysis, and automated test review. Additionally, expertise is expected in managing test data strategies, test environments, and service virtualization within complex, multi\-system architectures. The role also involves defining and managing quality gates, coverage metrics, and test\-effectiveness KPIs within agile and DevOps frameworks.


Soft skills entail strong technical leadership capabilities, with proven ability to influence and align engineering, delivery, and architecture teams without direct authority. Effective communication skills are essential for articulating testing strategies, risks, and trade\-offs to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.

title: Solutions Architect - Business Transformation
description:
**Company Overview** 




  





 Arcesium is a global financial technology firm that solves complex data\-driven challenges faced by some of the world’s most sophisticated financial institutions. We constantly innovate our platform and capabilities to meet tomorrow’s challenges, anticipate the risks our clients encounter, and design advanced solutions to help our clients achieve transformational business outcomes.
 



  





 Financial technology is a high\-growth industry as change and innovation continue to disrupt the status\-quo and prompt major transformation. Arcesium is at a particularly interesting time in our own growth as we look to leverage our successfully established market position and expand operations in pursuit of strategic new business opportunities. We value intellectual curiosity, proactive ownership, and collaboration with colleagues, and we empower you to meaningfully contribute from day one and accelerate your professional development.
 



  





**Job Overview** 




  





 Arcesium is building a Corporate AI Transformation team, and you will be one of its few first members. As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will work closely with business, operations and engineering teams to identify high\-impact internal use cases and convert them into working AI solutions that run in production.
 



 This is not a traditional backend or application engineering role. You will operate like a builder, systems engineer, and product thinker rolled into one. You will take ambiguous business problems, break them into solvable workflows, design the agent architecture, and ship production\-grade internal tools. You will work with Arcesium's corporate systems, data assets, and AI tech stack to build agents and automations that reduce manual effort, improve decision\-making, and scale repeatable work. Success for this role isn’t just measured by shipping a prototype or completing a project, it’s measured by putting solutions into production and driving meaningful adoption and impact.
 



 The ideal candidate brings strong engineering fundamentals, a builder’s mindset, and a passion for using AI to improve how work gets done. This is a high\-impact role for someone who wants to build AI solutions that meaningfully improve enterprise processes.
 



  





**What you'll do** 



* Partner with business and functional teams to find the opportunities: workflow automation, AI\-assisted decision\-making, and work that agents can take on.
* Understand complex operational processes across teams and convert them into structured problem statements, system designs, and technical workflows.
* Build agents, workflow automations, and internal applications on top of Arcesium's corporate data systems, and enterprise tools.
* Rapidly prototype using LLMs, agent frameworks, MCPs. Get something small in front of real users early and iterate on their feedback.
* Design agent architectures that complete business tasks reliably.
* Work with engineering, business, and security teams to take prototypes to move prototypes into scalable, maintainable solutions.
* Evaluate build\-vs\-buy options for AI workflows and identify the right technical approach for each use case.
* Create reusable components, templates and playbooks that accelerate this work across the firm.
* Define the KPIs, measure the impact, and drive adoption.



**What you'll need** 



* 6\+ years of hands\-on engineering experience, with a track record of shipping systems that other people depend on.
* Strong engineering fundamentals across APIs, data, and systems design.
* Experience building internal tools or automation systems for business teams.
* The ability to understand a platform quickly, build on top of it, and turn business context into reliable technical solutions.
* Systems thinking. You can hold a whole workflow in your head, see where it is structurally inefficient, and redesign it rather than automate it as it stands.
* A bias to ship iteratively. You get a thin version into real use, learn from it, and improve it, instead of waiting for a complete design.
* Credibility with senior business and technology leaders, and the ability to say hard things clearly to both.
* Comfort with ambiguity and ownership. You will pick your own problems as often as you are handed them.

 This role combines security architecture, applied AI expertise, and hands\-on collaboration to ensure AI technologies are adopted safely while empowering Infosec teams to move faster and make better decisions using modern AI platforms.

description:
**Description**
 AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small\- and mid\-market accounts to enterprise\-level customers including public sector.
   

  

 As a Solutions Architect, you’ll help your customers plan their successful cloud journey. You’ll solve complex, technical challenges so your customers can focus on their business. This includes using your knowledge to craft scalable, flexible, and resilient cloud architectures. You’ll drive or take part in technical solutions discussions, diving deep into the details with customer teams.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Building relationships to understand our customers and partners is key. As a trusted technical advisor, you’ll use your interpersonal skills to influence a variety of stakeholders from technical teams to executives. You’ll help ensure their short\-term technology decisions are aligned with their long\-term goals. Speeding up the adoption of our services will be part of your day to day.
   

  

 You’ll also act as thought leader in the wider community. This includes taking part in educating, sharing best practices, presenting at events, writing white papers, blogs, and running workshops. You won’t just be part of an industry movement; you’ll be leading it.
   

  

 As a customer obsessed advisor, you’ll also have the chance to shape the direction of our products and services. This is through gathering feedback from customers whilst collaborating with our engineering and service teams.
   

  

 A day in the life
   

  

 In this role, your technical depth, business aptitude, and ability to steer technology discussions at all levels will enable you to shape the customer journey. Your thought leadership, ability to look beyond the technology, and more holistically at the value technology creates for our customers, is crucial to your success.
   

  

 As a Solutions Architect you’ll own the overall technical relationship between customers, AWS and partners, and make recommendations on security, cost, performance, reliability and operational efficiency. You will go beyond the technical solution architecture, work with partners, sellers and specialists to understand the customer's business needs and give prescriptive guidance on how to create business value with technology.
   

  

**About The Team**
 This role is within the ISV team in Amazon Web Services India, working with the customers to help drive AWS services adoption.
   

  

**About AWS**
 Diverse Experiences
   

  

 Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Why AWS
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
   

  

 Inclusive Team Culture
   

  

 Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee\-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
   

  

 Mentorship and Career Growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.

title: Solution Architect
description:
Hyderabad, Telangana
  
Job Summary
  
  

What you’ll do Discover and shape the solution Run discovery workshops with client stakeholders, assess the current process, and frame the business problem as an agentic solution.Prioritise and shape use cases jointly with the client, then validate direction with a working prototype in days — followed by the production hardening that enterprise delivery demands. Build and integrate Design and ship single\- and multi\-agent systems in Python using ADKs, connecting into client ecosystems through proven integration patterns, standards\-based APIs and secure authentication.Engineer the agent core: prompt engineering, context engineering, prompt caching, RAG / context\-graph retrieval, memory, tool / function calling, MCP integration and multi\-agent orchestration.Build reusable agent components, skills, tool libraries and templates, with guardrails so agent behaviour stays predictable, safe and repeatable. Prove and govern Run eval\-driven development: build evaluation harnesses and test suites that measure correctness, safety and regression before anything ships.Own AgentOps and DevSecOps — CI/CD for agents, versioning, observability, telemetry, IAM, secrets management, privacy controls and shift\-left security — with Responsible AI governance from day one.Take agents through architecture review, security sign\-off and release governance on the way to production, then hand over with clear documentation and knowledge transfer into managed service.Design human oversight into every agent: approvals, exception handling and escalation paths appropriate to the process being automated. Own the outcome Set a baseline with the client, agree benefit targets, and track cycle time, manual effort, accuracy, exception rate, cost\-to\-serve, adoption and compliance as the scorecard.Run a continuous feedback loop: feed production telemetry, evals and client feedback back into prompts, context and agent design. Operate within HCLTech and the client Collaborate with account, consulting, architecture, data, security and delivery teams — the FDE role sits across both organisations, not apart from them.Keep internal alignment as tight as client alignment: follow HCLTech’s governance charter,and socialise and review the proposition with the wider SME cohort before committing the client to it.Look for the scaling opportunity in every engagement — where a pattern, accelerator or approach could extend across other domains within the Delivery Unit — and bring proactive proposals forward. Lead and mentor Set technical direction for the pod: run code and design reviews, mentor engineers, plan the work, manage delivery risk and raise the engineering bar.Stay ahead of the curve: adopt evolving agent frameworks and patterns quickly, and bring field learnings back to the practice.
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
  

Technology mandate Language Python — primary and mandatory; other languages and frameworks follow the engagement. For example in the ING context Java will be necessary. Frameworks Agent Development Kits (ADKs) — e.g. Google ADK, LangGraph, CrewAI, OpenAI Agents SDK, AWS Bedrock AgentCore, Microsoft Agent Framework / Semantic Kernel. Framework choice follows the engagement; the discipline is the same. Models Multi\-LLM via the kit (e.g. Claude on Bedrock, Gemini, Azure OpenAI), selected per use case for quality, latency and cost. Interfaces Tools and Model Context Protocol (MCP) for integration; standards\-based APIs and secure auth for client systems.
  
  

Skill Requirements
  
  

What you’ll bring (must\-have) Advanced Python engineering — idiomatic, typed, tested and packaged code — on a solid software engineering foundation (design, version control, architecture). Other languages follow the engagement; Python is the core.Hands\-on agent building with at least one ADK (Google ADK, LangGraph, CrewAI, OpenAI Agents SDK, AWS Bedrock AgentCore or Microsoft Agent Framework / Semantic Kernel).Solid command of agent engineering: prompt engineering, context engineering, prompt caching, RAG / context graphs, tool / function calling, MCP and multi\-agent orchestration.Eval\-driven development: designing evaluation harnesses and measuring agent quality, safety and reliability.Standards\-based integration and DevSecOps: APIs, secure authentication and authorisation, IAM, CI/CD, observability, resilience and AgentOps.Ability to conceptualise a business problem as an agent quickly, and operate effectively in ambiguous, client\-embedded settings.Client\-facing consulting skills: discovery facilitation, process assessment, use\-case selection, stakeholder management and executive communication.Comfortable working across account, consulting, architecture, data, security and delivery teams to get a solution to production.Responsible AI as a working discipline — applied throughout agent design, evaluation and production governance.Experience mentoring or leading small engineering teams.
  
  

Other Requirements
  
  

A day in the life A typical day blends client consulting with hands\-on engineering. It often starts alongside business and technology stakeholders — unpicking a process bottleneck, agreeing what a good outcome looks like, and shaping it into an agentic solution. From there the work turns practical: building or refining an agent, wiring it into client systems, reviewing evaluation results and production telemetry with the engineering pod, and working through security controls and Responsible AI checks as delivery issues surface.Throughout, there’s a leadership thread — setting direction for the pod and raising the engineering bar — alongside the constant balancing act of speed against enterprise\-grade quality: showing the client visible progress, measuring business impact, folding in user feedback, and turning what works into reusable HCLTech accelerators.

title: Architect — Design Management
description:
Architect — Design Management \| Vantrock Real Assets Private Limited \| Mumbai Metropolitan Region
 



  





 A developer's design manager is not a practice's project architect. Own the drawing from the yield test at land stage to the set issued to site, for a platform breaking ground on its first 2 million sq ft in January — and make sure the masterplan that wins the deal is the one that gets built.
 



  





 A note before you read on. Team structure, reporting lines, direct reports, seat titles and hiring entity reflect the platform's current plan and may change. Compensation is confirmed in the offer, not here.
 



  





 REPORTS TO: Head of Projects, or the CEO — Development Business until that seat is filled · DIRECT REPORTS: none; the consultant teams on every project are commanded by this seat · ASSET CLASSES: Grade A warehouses, logistics parks and industrial parks, PEB and RCC
 



  






 ABOUT VANTROCK
 




 Vantrock is India's independent, operator\-led real assets platform — real assets only — with logistics and industrial as the first phase of its growth. Founded by Anshul Singhal, Founder \& CEO, who has built three institutional platforms from zero and is building the fourth on his own capital: 52 million sq ft delivered (32 million as developer, 20 million as contractor), 2,000\+ acres acquired, 200\+ buildings, two SEBI Category II funds run to a successful close, India's first domestic warehousing AIF and India's largest industrial real estate exit — delivered across the founder's three prior platforms.
 



  






 THE PROJECTS TEAM
 




 Vantrock designs and builds in\-house. The projects function owns the asset from the first block plan to the day an occupier takes possession, and design management owns the drawing across all of it. The function is being built now, the seat does not exist in this form anywhere in the market, and the person who joins it will decide what it becomes.
 



  






 DESIGN OWNERSHIP, NOT COORDINATION
 




 In a practice, the drawing is the product. Here it is a means, and the product is a park that leases, clears its approvals and gets built for the number it was underwritten at.
 



 Land is our largest single cost and the masterplan is where it is either monetised or wasted. A point of ground coverage, a badly oriented dock face, a late fire NOC — each costs more than the entire design fee. This seat finds the yield, proves it is compliant, and makes sure it survives contact with site.
 



  






 WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS
 




 The platform breaks ground on its first 2 million sq ft in January and has 10 million behind it, across four cities and more than one state's development\-control regime. Every masterplan drawn this year will be built and leased for the next ten, approvals sit on the critical path in every state, and nobody owns them end to end today. This is the first design seat, and it sets the standards the portfolio is built to.
 



  






 WHAT YOU WILL OWN
 




 1\. The yield test at land stage — ground coverage, FSI, setbacks, truck circulation, dock\-face orientation and phasing on every opportunity, and the block plan and area statement the land recommendation is made on.
 



 2\. The portfolio design standards — 17 m bay grid, 12\.5 m clear height, 1:7,500 sq ft dock ratio, 28\.5 m yard depth, office area, FM2 and TR34 floors, defended against anything that erodes usable area.
 



 3\. The approval path — state industrial authority, town planning, fire NOC, environmental clearance, factory and DISH, CTE and CTO, on a live tracker with a real critical path.
 



 4\. The GFC set — coordinated, construction\-ready, issued in a state where the site does not have to ask what was meant. Site RFIs are the measure, and are counted.
 



 5\. The consultants — architectural, structural, MEP, façade and landscape, appointed, driven and held to what they hand over.
 



 6\. Buildability and change control — clash resolution before issue, then the RFI and design\-change log, with cost and time attached before a change reaches site.
 



 7\. Customer fit and design\-to\-cost — occupier briefs turned into fast, priced design responses, and design worked to the estimator's budget, not around it.
 



  






 WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR
 





 ESSENTIAL
 




 – 10–15 years in design management, most of it on industrial, warehousing or logistics assets, at a developer, or at a practice or PMC on that portfolio at project\-lead level.
 



 – Parks you have masterplanned yourself, with the numbers: site area, BUA, ground coverage, circulation efficiency. Tested in a practical.
 



 – The full statutory approval path run end to end in at least one state, and a working knowledge of how a second differs. NBC 2016, state fire and DCR in daily use.
 



 – Green certification to IGBC or LEED Platinum standard designed in from concept, not retrofitted at approval stage.
 



 – AutoCAD at expert level; fluent reading of structural and MEP drawings, specifications and contract conditions; SketchUp and Adobe for options, massing and presentation output.
 



 – Warehouse and industrial building systems: PEB and RCC, FM2 and TR34 flooring, dock equipment, K115 and K160 sprinklers, OSID and FAPA fire detection, roofing, cladding, external infrastructure.
 



 – Design\-to\-cost as a habit, not a phase: quantified options, value engineering without losing the specification.
 



 – B.Arch, with Council of Architecture registration. Based in the Mumbai Metropolitan Region.
 




 ADVANTAGEOUS
 




 – M.Arch, NICMAR or an equivalent construction\-management qualification. IGBC AP or LEED AP.
 



 – Revit and BIM for model\-based coordination rather than drawings with a model on the side. Power BI for approval trackers, drawing registers and design\-change dashboards.
 



 – Temperature\-controlled, cross\-dock or automation\-ready fit\-outs. Approvals in more than one state.
 




 WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT
 




 – Not a practice seat: the drawing is not the deliverable, a park that leases and gets built is. Not consultant coordination: you appoint, direct and hold the consultants. Not a delivery seat: execution on site belongs to projects. Not the programme office: cost and schedule control across the portfolio sits there.
 



  






 HOW YOU WILL WORK
 




 – Developer side, with real decision rights. You can reject a consultant's set, hold a land recommendation, and refuse a change that has not been priced.
 



 – Every decision traceable. A yield option has an area statement behind it; a released drawing has a name against it.
 



 – The reporting is not your job. Trackers, registers, RFI logs and dashboards run on Vantrock Intelligence, built before we bought an acre.
 



 – Mumbai Metropolitan Region, full\-time, in person, travel to every site.
 



 JUDGED ON FOUR STANDARDS, TOGETHER. Yield: BUA per acre, ground coverage, circulation efficiency. Compliance: approvals on the critical path, NBC and fire, green certification. Buildability: coordinated GFC sets, minimal site RFIs. Customer fit: BTS response and occupier specification.
 



  






 COMPENSATION
 




 Vantrock benchmarks compensation against the upper quartile for the role and market, weighted toward equity for candidates who want to build with us long\-term. We discuss specific numbers in the first conversation rather than anchoring either side prematurely. Wealth creation is part of the engine, not only the salary: a performance\-linked annual bonus and a path to ESOP\-linked incentives, confirmed in the offer.
 



  






 CULTURAL FIT
 




 We're building Vantrock over a decade, not a funding cycle. We're looking for people who treat technology as the default answer rather than a supplement, who want to be co\-builders of the platform rather than employees executing instructions, and who are comfortable saying "I don't know" and "I was wrong." If you want a defined role with defined edges, this isn't the right seat. If you want to help build an institution from zero, it might be.
 



 AI proficiency is a standing requirement in every Vantrock seat: fluent use of AI tools for option generation, code and drawing checking, research and presentation output, and building on the platform's dashboards rather than around them. A supervised AI Proficiency Test runs at every level, and we say so openly.
 



 Partner command is the second. The design is ours, but consultants, PMCs and liaison agents are commanded by this seat — briefed, held to a standard, integrated — never deferred to.
 



  






 HOW WE WILL ASSESS
 




 Everyone who applies hears from us within two working days, with two links: six questions answered by AI interview, about forty minutes, reviewed before the CV, and the Vantrock AI Proficiency Test, which every hire takes at every level. From there: a design conversation on a park you masterplanned, walked through in numbers; a three\-hour supervised practical on a real parcel with a real access constraint, a development\-control extract and an occupier brief, from which you produce an area statement, a block plan, two yield options with the trade\-off stated, and the approvals on the critical path; then two references, contacted directly.
 



 Your application is confidential: it is seen only by the Founder's Office and the hiring lead, and nothing is shared with your current employer or referenced without your consent.
 



  






 TO APPLY
 




 Write to careers@vantrock.com with the subject line "Architect — Design Management — \[your name]", and attach:
 



 – Your CV. Mandatory: a LinkedIn profile alone is not an application, though we read that too.
 



 – Your Yield Sheet — one row per park you masterplanned: state, site area, BUA, ground coverage, clear height, dock ratio, asset type, your role, and whether it was built. Template on request.
 



 – Your notice period and what you would need to move.
 



 – One short paragraph: the design decision you have seen destroy the most yield on an industrial park, and the check you would build so it never survives to GFC. That paragraph matters more than the CV.
 



 We read all that arrives that arrives with a Yield Sheet and a paragraph, properly, not skimmed.
 



  





 We don't hire roles. We build the platform. · Ownership, not employment. · Builders hire builders.
 



 Founder \& CEO, Vantrock
