title: Principal AI Go-to-Market Operations Engineer
description:
**Organization Overview**
**Company Description**
 QAD is a world\-class SaaS company, and we are growing. We are looking for talented individuals who want to join us on our mission to help solve relevant real\-world problems in manufacturing and the supply chain.
   

  

**Job Description**
 We are seeking a visionary and highly
 **technical AI Go\-To\-Market (GTM) Engineer** 
 to sit at the core of our revenue engine. This is not a traditional operations role; it is a hybrid of software engineering, data science, and revenue strategy. You will be responsible for architecting an AI\-first GTM ecosystem that bridges the gap between Sales, RevOps, Marketing, and Customer Success.
   

  

 Your goal is to ensure that every individual in our GTM organization and every piece of our technology stack is augmented by Artificial Intelligence. You will build the bridges that allow us to generate more pipeline, accelerate deal velocity, and eliminate administrative friction, all while optimizing our tech spend.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* AI Architecture \& Custom Integration
* Design, code, and deploy custom AI integrations from scratch to connect our CRM, Sales Engagement platforms, and other technology stack components.
* Build proprietary internal LLM\-based tools to automate account and contact enrichment, outbound messaging for early and middle of the funnel prospects.
* Develop agentic workflows that handle routine administrative tasks (e.g., CRM data, meeting summaries, and follow\-up scheduling) across the revenue organization.
* Revenue Ecosystem Optimization
* Partner with RevOps and Marketing Ops to audit the existing tech stack, identifying redundancies where AI can replace high\-cost, low\-utility third\-party vendors.
* Implement predictive modeling to identify high\-intent pipelines and provide Sales with real\-time "Next Best Action" recommendations.
* Ensure data integrity across all platforms, creating a "single source of truth" that AI models can leverage for accurate forecasting.
* Cross\-Functional Efficiency
* Collaborate with Customer Success to build AI\-driven retention loops and automated renewal triggers.
* Consult with Marketing leadership on AI\-driven content distribution and performance marketing automation to lower Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC).
* Act as an internal consultant, training GTM teams on how to effectively "prompt" and utilize deployed AI tools to maximize their individual output.


**Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of experience in Marketing/Revenue Operations or GTM Engineering. Deep understanding of the "Leads\-to\-Revenue" funnel and "Best\-in\-Class" SaaS ecosystems.
* Ability to write and maintain production integrations — Python, JavaScript, html, or equivalent — connecting AI agents to CRM, MAP, and sequencing tools via APIs. You don't need to be a software engineer, but you need to ship working code, not just configure no\-code tools.
* Deep working knowledge of the modern B2B GTM stack — specifically Salesforce (as CRM and data hub), Clay, Claude, Outreach, Gong or Chorus, etc
* Proven track record of consolidating tech stacks and reducing vendor spend without sacrificing performance.
* Understanding of pipeline math and unit economics: you should be able to work backward from a revenue target to pipeline required, conversion rates by stage, and the specific AI interventions that move each number. If someone says "we need 20 opportunities per quarter at 20% win rate and $75K ASD," you should immediately know where AI can compress that funnel.
* Experience with AI agent orchestration — managing multiple AI agents working different segments or functions simultaneously, resolving conflicts, preventing duplicate outreach, and maintaining data quality in the hub (Salesforce).
* Demonstrated ability to build prompt libraries, training datasets, and refinement workflows for AI agents — treating agent training as a discipline, not a one\-time setup.
* Strong opinions on when AI should replace human effort versus augment it — and the judgment to know that bad AI automation destroys deals faster than no automation at all.


**Additional Information**
* Your health and well being are important to us at QAD. We provide programs that help you strike a healthy work\-life balance.
* Opportunity to join a growing business, launching into its next phase of expansion and transformation.
* Collaborative culture of smart and hard\-working people who support one another to get the job done.
* An atmosphere of growth and opportunity, where idea\-sharing is always prioritized over level or hierarchy.

In order to survive and thrive, manufacturers must be able to innovate and change business models at unprecedented rates of speed. title: Principal Engineer – Application Architect
description:
**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**


Principal Engineer – Application Architect
Who is Mastercard?  

Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.  

Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all.  

Overview  

Payments Network Technology is seeking a Principal Engineer to provide technical and delivery leadership across payment\-network initiatives. This role will connect architecture, release coordination, dependency management, and engineering execution across multiple teams.  

Roles and Responsibilities  

* Define and evolve architecture for secure, scalable, and highly available payment\-network services.
* Coordinate technical delivery across teams, including releases, dependencies, defect triage, and resolution of cross\-cutting issues.
* Partner with product and engineering leaders to translate business needs into architecture and implementation direction.
* Lead design reviews and drive decisions on APIs, service interactions, data, resiliency, security, and operational readiness.
* Identify reuse opportunities and promote common engineering patterns and standards.
* Mentor engineers and technical leads across teams.
* Communicate architecture trade\-offs, delivery risks, and recommendations to senior stakeholders.
* Provide technical or product leadership, mentor team members, and drive decisions across multiple workstreams.

  

Essential Skills  

* Extensive software architecture and development experience in large\-scale systems.
* Deep knowledge of Java, Spring Boot, microservices, REST APIs, messaging, event\-driven architecture, SQL/NoSQL, and cloud\-native platforms.
* Experience with secure engineering, DevOps, performance, resiliency, observability, and production\-readiness practices.
* Ability to lead through influence across organizational boundaries.
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.


All About You  

* Experience working in Agile delivery environments and across the software development lifecycle.
* Clear communication, collaboration, problem\-solving, and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Ability to work with globally distributed product, engineering, architecture, operations, and business teams.
* Experience leading SOAR (Solution Architecture Review) and driving technical strategy, architecture alignment, engineering excellence, and risk management across multiple teams.
* Experience creating and reviewing TADs (Technical Architecture Documents) for large\-scale distributed systems, ensuring alignment with enterprise standards, security requirements, resiliency objectives, and long\-term maintainability.
* Demonstrated experience defining and governing cross\-platform architecture, enabling interoperability, reuse, standardization, and consistent engineering practices across multiple products and services.
* Experience designing and implementing multi\-region resiliency architectures, including active\-active and active\-passive deployment patterns, disaster recovery strategies, cross\-region data replication, failover mechanisms, and business continuity solutions.
* Strong understanding of distributed data management, including data replication, consistency models, recovery objectives, and operational considerations across geographic regions.
* Champions operability and maintainability as first\-class design principles, ensuring observability, monitoring, automation, self\-healing capabilities, supportability, and simplified operational management are built into solutions from inception.
* Deep understanding of Mastercard Engineering Principles (or equivalent large\-scale enterprise engineering standards) and a proven ability to apply them consistently across architecture, software design, deployment, resiliency, security, and operational practices.
* Demonstrated ability to balance architecture, business priorities, scalability, security, resiliency, and operational considerations while establishing technology direction for multiple engineering teams.
* Experience defining architecture guardrails, engineering standards, reference implementations, and reusable patterns that improve consistency, quality, and delivery effectiveness across the organization.
* Strong knowledge of reliability engineering practices, including service\-level objectives (SLOs), error budgets, observability, fault isolation, disaster recovery testing, and continuous resilience validation.
* Payments or financial\-services domain knowledge is preferred.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**

  

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

* Continuous learning and innovation mindset.

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Architect with extensive expertise in Java, Spring Boot, application security, microservices, event\-driven architecture on AWS, Kafka. The ideal candidate will play a critical role in designing scalable and secure applications while mentoring a talented team of developers.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities:
 



 Architecture Design: Lead the design and implementation of robust, scalable, and secure microservices\-based applications using Java and Spring Boot.
 



 Application Security: Develop and enforce security best practices throughout the software development lifecycle, ensuring compliance with industry standards.
 



 Cloud Solutions: Architect and deploy applications on AWS, leveraging services such as ECS, S3, Lambda, RDS, and others.
 



 Event\-Driven Architecture: Design and implement event\-driven systems using Kafka to enable real\-time data processing and communication between services.
 



 Collaboration: Work closely with cross\-functional teams including product management, DevOps, and QA to deliver high\-quality software solutions.
 



 Mentorship: Provide guidance and mentorship to junior developers, promoting best practices in software development and architecture.
 



 Documentation: Create and maintain architectural documentation, ensuring clarity and alignment across the team.
 



 Continuous Improvement: Stay updated with industry trends and technologies, recommending improvements and innovations to enhance system performance and security.
 



  





 Qualifications:
 



 Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
 



 Experience: 10\+ years of experience in software development, with at least 3 years in a senior architectural role.
 



  





 Technical Skills:
 



 Proficient in Java and Spring Boot.
 



 Extensive experience with microservices architecture.
 



 Strong knowledge of application security principles and practices.
 



 Hands\-on experience with AWS services and infrastructure.
 



 Familiarity with Kafka or similar event streaming platforms.
 



 Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.
 



  





 Soft Skills: Excellent problem\-solving skills, strong communication, and the ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.

title: Technical Architect – Multi-Stack (.NET / Java) & Enterprise Integration IRC303300
description:
**Description**
 We are seeking an experienced Technical Architect to drive the end\-to\-end design, integration, and modern engineering practices across complex multi\-stack environments (.NET and Java). In this role, you will architect resilient RESTful APIs, manage upstream/downstream integrations with third\-party platforms, and lead harness engineering and AI\-Assisted Software Development Life Cycle (AIDLC) initiatives. You will bridge high\-level strategy with technical execution across continuous deployment pipelines in an Agile delivery framework.
   

  

**Requirements**
**Location:** 
 Noida, India (2 days from office per week)
   

  

**Shift Timings:** 
 2:00 PM – 11:00 PM IST (Ensuring overlap with US/UK client timezones)
   

  

**Technical Qualifications:**
 Core Frameworks: Deep hands\-on expertise in both .NET Core and Java / Spring Boot, Microservices stacks.
   

  

 Integration \& APIs: Proven experience designing REST APIs, GraphQL, ESB/Message Brokers (Kafka, RabbitMQ), and third\-party vendor integrations.
   

  

 System Design: Extensive knowledge of Microservices, Event\-Driven Architecture, Domain\-Driven Design (DDD), and upstream/downstream data flow management.
   

  

 Engineering \& AI Practices: Mastery of Harness Engineering, TDD/BDD, automated testing frameworks, and AIDLC tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor).
   

  

 DevOps \& Pipelines: Expert understanding of deployment pipeline automation (Jenkins, GitLab CI, AWS, GitHub Actions) and container orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes).
   

  

**Soft Skills \& Operational Requirements:**
 Strategic Thinking: Exceptional analytical and architectural problem\-solving capabilities.
   

  

 Stakeholder Management: Excellent verbal and written communication skills to articulate technical vision to executive, product, and engineering stakeholders.
   

  

 Methodology: Deep familiarity with scaled Agile framework (SAFe), Scrum, or Kanban environments.
   

  

 Shift Flexibility: Readiness to work the 2:00 PM – 11:00 PM IST shift to align with global development teams and leads.
   

  

**Bonus Qualifications:**
 Domain Knowledge: Experience in Capital Markets (e.g., Retirement Plan Services, Trading Systems, Clearing/Settlements, or Wealth Management) is a strong plus.
   

  

 Job responsibilities
   

  

 Architecture \& Multi\-Stack Design: Define enterprise\-grade system architectures spanning both .NET and Java platforms, ensuring scalability, security, and high availability.
   

  

 API \& System Integration: Design robust API strategies and manage complex integrations with third\-party systems, legacy platforms, and critical upstream/downstream application dependencies.
   

  

 Harness Engineering \& AIDLC: Implement harness engineering practices (automated test harnesses, feature flags, chaos engineering) and embed AI\-Assisted Software Development Life Cycle (AIDLC) tools across dev teams to maximize engineering velocity.
   

  

 CI/CD \& Deployment Pipelines: Architect robust continuous integration and deployment (CI/CD) pipelines, establishing deployment strategies (blue/green, canary) for enterprise web services.
   

  

 Agile Leadership \& Governance: Establish technical standards, code quality gates, and architectural governance while guiding cross\-functional Agile teams and collaborating with business leaders.
   

  

 What we offer
   

  

**Exciting Projects:** 
 We focus on industries like High\-Tech, communication, media, healthcare, retail and telecom. Our customer list is full of fantastic global brands and leaders who love what we build for them.
   

  

**Collaborative Environment:** 
 You Can expand your skills by collaborating with a diverse team of highly talented people in an open, laidback environment — or even abroad in one of our global centers or client facilities!
   

  

**Work\-Life Balance:** 
 GlobalLogic prioritizes work\-life balance, which is why we offer flexible work schedules, opportunities to work from home, and paid time off and holidays.
   

  

**Professional Development:** 
 Our dedicated Learning \& Development team regularly organizes Communication skills training(GL Vantage, Toast Master),Stress Management program, professional certifications, and technical and soft skill trainings.
   

  

**Excellent Benefits:** 
 We provide our employees with competitive salaries, family medical insurance, Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance , NPS(National Pension Scheme ), Periodic health awareness program, extended maternity leave, annual performance bonuses, and referral bonuses.
   

  

**Fun Perks:** 
 We want you to love where you work, which is why we host sports events, cultural activities, offer food on subsidies rates, Corporate parties. Our vibrant offices also include dedicated GL Zones, rooftop decks and GL Club where you can drink coffee or tea with your colleagues over a game of table and offer discounts for popular stores and restaurants!
   

  

**About GlobalLogic**
 GlobalLogic, a Hitachi Group Company, is a trusted digital engineering partner to the world’s largest and most forward\-thinking companies. Since 2000, we’ve been at the forefront of the digital revolution – helping create some of the most innovative and widely used digital products and experiences. Today we continue to collaborate with clients in transforming businesses and redefining industries through intelligent products, platforms, and services.

##### **Project description**

We are seeking an experienced Test Architect to lead the end\-to\-end test strategy across the domain, embedding quality early in the software development lifecycle through shift\-left practices and leveraging AI to enhance and accelerate testing outcomes. This senior engineering leadership role requires the successful candidate to serve as the technical authority on test automation, quality engineering, and test strategy, establishing standards for designing, measuring, and delivering quality across teams.


##### **Responsibilities**


Define and own the domain\-wide test strategy covering functional, integration, regression, and end\-to\-end testing, ensuring alignment with business objectives, engineering practices, and release goals.


Drive shift\-left quality practices by embedding testing into design and development phases to detect, prevent, and resolve defects early, reducing change costs and delivery risks.


Lead the adoption and application of AI throughout the test lifecycle, including AI\-assisted test generation, coverage analysis, specification\-driven test development, automated code review, and intelligent test prioritization.


Establish and enforce standards for test automation frameworks, tooling selection, reusable test assets, and test data strategy to ensure consistency, maintainability, and scalability across the domain.


Implement and maintain quality gates, coverage targets, and measurable test\-effectiveness metrics, such as defect escape rate, test cycle time, and automation coverage, to provide clear visibility into quality status.


Coach and mentor engineers and test specialists across teams, enhancing test engineering capabilities and serving as the technical escalation point for complex quality issues.


Collaborate with architecture leads, delivery leads, and product owners to align testing approaches with CI/CD pipelines, engineering standards, and release schedules.


Continuously assess and adapt the test strategy in response to technology developments, platform changes, and emerging best practices in quality engineering and AI\-assisted development.


##### **Skills**


Must have


The role requires extensive expertise in test automation, quality engineering, and test architecture, gained through over 15 years of hands\-on experience at an enterprise scale. The candidate should have a strong background in designing and implementing shift\-left testing strategies that integrate quality controls into continuous integration and continuous delivery pipelines.


Hard skills include proficiency with test automation frameworks, specifically Selenium and Playwright, applied to both API and UI testing. The candidate must demonstrate practical experience in utilizing AI and generative AI technologies to enhance engineering and testing workflows, such as AI\-assisted test case creation, specification\-driven testing, intelligent coverage analysis, and automated test review. Additionally, expertise is expected in managing test data strategies, test environments, and service virtualization within complex, multi\-system architectures. The role also involves defining and managing quality gates, coverage metrics, and test\-effectiveness KPIs within agile and DevOps frameworks.


Soft skills entail strong technical leadership capabilities, with proven ability to influence and align engineering, delivery, and architecture teams without direct authority. title: Senior Architect
description:
1\. POSITION PURPOSE

The Senior Architect will provide senior\-level architectural leadership and project ownership across multiple projects, from conceptualization and design development through detailed documentation, coordination, and construction support.

The position is responsible for ensuring design excellence, technical quality, statutory compliance, timely project delivery, client satisfaction, and effective team performance.

The Senior Architect will act as a key link between the Lead/Principal Architect, design team, consultants, project team, clients, contractors, and statutory authorities.

2\. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

A. Design Leadership \& Architectural Development

Lead the architectural design process from concept stage through detailed design and execution.

Develop and review design concepts, planning strategies, space planning, elevations, sections, details, and presentations.

Translate client requirements, project objectives, and functional requirements into effective architectural solutions.

Provide strategic design direction to Architects and Junior Architects.

Review design alternatives and recommend practical, economical, and technically feasible solutions.

Maintain the architectural vision and design intent throughout the project lifecycle.

Ensure consistency of design quality across multiple projects.

Take responsibility for resolving complex architectural and design challenges.

B. Project Ownership \& Delivery

Take overall responsibility for assigned architectural projects and deliverables.

Establish project design priorities, deliverables, and internal timelines.

Monitor progress against project schedules and ensure timely submission of deliverables.

Identify potential delays, design risks, coordination issues, and resource requirements at an early stage.

Coordinate with the Project Head to ensure architectural activities remain aligned with overall project objectives.

Manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining quality and deadlines.

Ensure proper handover and continuity between design, documentation, and site execution stages.

C. Client Management \& Stakeholder Coordination

Act as a senior point of contact for clients on architectural matters.

Understand and evaluate client requirements and provide professional recommendations.

Lead design presentations and client review meetings.

Manage client feedback, design revisions, and approvals.

Maintain strong professional relationships with clients, consultants, contractors, PMC teams, and government authorities.

Represent the organization in important project meetings when delegated by the Lead/Principal Architect.

Handle sensitive design, coordination, and project\-related discussions professionally.

D. Multidisciplinary Coordination

Lead coordination with Structural, Electrical, HVAC/MEP, Landscape, Interior, Fire \& Safety, and other specialist consultants.

Review multidisciplinary drawings and identify clashes, discrepancies, and design conflicts.

Ensure architectural requirements are properly incorporated into other consultants' designs.

Project Manager \- Corporate InteriorsJLL Project \& Development Services (PDS) \| Gujarat, IndiaAbout JLLJones Lang LaSalle (JLL) is a leading professional services firm that specializes in real estate and investment management. Our Project \& Development Services (PDS) team delivers comprehensive project and program management services across diverse industries and geographies.
  
Position OverviewWe are seeking an experienced Project Manager to lead corporate interior projects across Gujarat. This role requires a strategic thinker with strong execution capabilities who can manage end\-to\-end project delivery while maintaining the highest standards of quality, cost control, and client satisfaction.
  
Key ResponsibilitiesProject Planning \& Execution
  
The Project Manager will oversee all phases of corporate interior projects from initiation through closeout. You will develop comprehensive project plans, establish timelines and milestones, coordinate design development with architects and consultants, and ensure alignment with client objectives and brand standards. Managing project scope, schedule, budget, and quality parameters while anticipating and mitigating risks will be central to your role.
  
Stakeholder Management
  
Serving as the primary point of contact for clients, you will build and maintain strong relationships with stakeholders including client representatives, design consultants, contractors, vendors, and internal JLL teams. You will conduct regular progress meetings, provide transparent communication on project status, and manage expectations effectively throughout the project lifecycle.
  
Financial \& Contract Management
  
You will be responsible for preparing detailed cost estimates and budget forecasts, monitoring project expenditures and cash flows, reviewing and approving contractor invoices and change orders, and ensuring projects are delivered within approved budgets. Administering contracts and ensuring compliance with terms and conditions will be essential aspects of this role.
  
Quality \& Compliance
  
Ensuring that all work meets JLL quality standards and client specifications is paramount. You will conduct regular site inspections and quality audits, verify compliance with building codes, safety regulations, and statutory requirements, coordinate testing and commissioning activities, and manage the punch list and defect rectification process.
  
Team Leadership
  
You will lead project teams including consultants, contractors, and JLL staff members. Building collaborative working relationships, providing clear direction and guidance, monitoring team performance, and fostering a culture of excellence and accountability will be key leadership responsibilities.
  
Required QualificationsEducation \& Experience
  
Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Architecture, Interior Design, or Construction Management is required. A minimum of 8\-12 years of experience in project management with specific focus on corporate interiors, office fit\-outs, or commercial projects is essential. Proven track record of successfully delivering multiple projects simultaneously in the Gujarat region is highly preferred.
  
Technical Competencies
  
Strong knowledge of interior construction methodologies, materials, and finishes is required. Proficiency in project management tools such as MS Project, Primavera, or equivalent software, along with advanced skills in MS Office Suite (Excel, PowerPoint, Word) is expected. Thorough understanding of building codes, safety regulations, and quality standards applicable to commercial interiors is necessary. Familiarity with MEP systems coordination and integration within interior spaces is valued.
  
Professional Skills
  
Excellent communication and presentation abilities in English and Hindi (Gujarati is advantageous) are required. Strong negotiation and conflict resolution capabilities, along with exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail, are essential. Financial acumen with experience in budgeting, cost control, and forecasting is necessary. Client\-focused mindset with commitment to service excellence is fundamental to success in this role.
  
Preferred QualificationsPMP or equivalent project management certification demonstrates professional commitment. Experience working with multinational corporations or large\-scale corporate clients is valuable. Knowledge of sustainable building practices and LEED/IGBC certification processes is beneficial. Exposure to design\-build or integrated project delivery methods is advantageous.
  
What We OfferOpportunity to work with leading multinational and domestic corporate clients on prestigious interior projects. Collaborative work environment with experienced professionals committed to excellence. Professional development opportunities including training programs and certifications. Competitive compensation package commensurate with experience and qualifications. Exposure to diverse project types across various industry sectors.
  
LocationGujarat (Ahmedabad/Gandhinagar preferred, with willingness to travel across Gujarat as needed)
  
JLL is an Equal Opportunity Employer
  
We are committed to creating an inclusive work environment that reflects the diversity of our clients and communities. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of gender, race, religion, age, disability, or other protected characteristics.
  
To apply, please submit your resume and cover letter through JLL's career portal or contact your local HR representative for application procedures.
  
If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!
  
  

Personalized benefits that support personal well\-being and growth:
  
  

JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health.
  
  

About JLL –
  
  

We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 102,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. That’s why we’re committed to our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world. We’re using the most advanced technology to create rewarding opportunities, amazing spaces and sustainable real estate solutions for our clients, our people, and our communities.
  
  

Our core values of teamwork, ethics and excellence are also fundamental to everything we do and we’re honored to be recognized with awards for our success by organizations both globally and locally.
  
  

Creating a diverse and inclusive culture where we all feel welcomed, valued and empowered to achieve our full potential is important to who we are today and where we’re headed in the future. And we know that unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives help us think bigger, spark innovation and succeed together.

**Job Description: Resilience Manager\- DB**
**Experience Range:** 
 12\-15 years \|

 Manager
   

  

**Role Summary**
 Lead enterprise database resilience and recovery programs across on\-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments. The role is responsible for assessing database recovery readiness, validating disaster recovery capabilities, strengthening cyber recovery preparedness, and driving database resilience improvements through structured assessments, testing, remediation planning, and stakeholder engagement.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead database resilience assessments across Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL, cloud\-native databases, and related infrastructure dependencies.
* Design, review, and validate database recovery strategies, including recovery sequencing, dependency mapping, recovery tiering, replication, and high availability configurations.
* Plan and execute database DR tests, cyber recovery simulations, failover/failback exercises, and evidence\-based recovery validation activities.
* Assess database backup and recovery architectures for immutability, replication, retention, air\-gap/vaulting controls, RPO/RTO alignment, and restoration readiness.
* Develop cyber recovery playbooks for ransomware and destructive cyber scenarios, including clean\-room recovery, trusted restore points, and database integrity validation.
* Identify resilience gaps, SPOFs, recovery risks, and operational weaknesses, and translate findings into remediation roadmaps and executive reporting.

* Participate in BIM coordination meetings and effectively communicate technical and coordination issues to relevant stakeholders.
* Provide technical guidance and support to **BIM Modellers, Architects, and other project team members**.
* Identify opportunities to improve BIM processes, workflows, and overall project efficiency.
* Support the implementation of BIM best practices and digital project delivery standards within the organization.

Technical Competencies

**Mandatory:**

* Advanced proficiency in **Autodesk Revit**.
* Strong working knowledge of **Navisworks Manage**.
* Good understanding of BIM coordination and multidisciplinary workflows.
* Knowledge of Architectural BIM modelling and documentation.
* Understanding of coordination between **Architecture, Structure, and MEP disciplines**.
* Experience in clash detection, coordination, and model quality control.

**Preferred:**

* Experience with **Autodesk Construction Cloud / BIM Collaborate Pro**.
* Knowledge of BIM 360 workflows and Common Data Environment (CDE).
* Familiarity with BIM Execution Plans.
* Knowledge of AutoCAD, SketchUp, or other relevant design/BIM software.

Educational Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree or Diploma in **Architecture, Civil Engineering, Architectural Engineering, or a related discipline**.
* Professional qualification or certification in **BIM / Architectural BIM** will be an added advantage.

Desired Candidate Profile

* **3–5 years of relevant experience** in BIM coordination, preferably within an architectural consultancy, multidisciplinary design firm, PMC, or similar professional environment.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Excellent understanding of BIM processes and model coordination.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and deliverables within defined timelines.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to model quality.
* Good interpersonal and communication skills.
* Ability to work collaboratively with multidisciplinary teams.
* Proactive approach towards identifying and resolving coordination issues.
* Ability to mentor and provide technical support to junior BIM team members.

Key Performance Areas

* BIM model quality and accuracy
* Multidisciplinary model coordination
* Clash detection and resolution
* Compliance with BIM standards and project protocols
* Timely BIM deliverables
* Effective coordination with internal and external stakeholders
* Continuous improvement of BIM workflows and processes

This role provides technical leadership on modern data platforms — spanning Data Lakes, Operational Data Stores, real\-time streaming, and Data Mesh — ensuring solutions are secure, performant, cost\-optimised, and aligned with enterprise data strategy. Design Data Lake and Operational Data Store architectures using cloud\-native technologies to support both analytical (OLAP) and operational (OLTP) workloads, ensuring proper separation, scalability, and performance.


Define and enforce Data Mesh principles for decentralized data ownership and governance, establishing domain\-oriented data products, self\-serve data infrastructure patterns, and federated governance.

Design batch and real\-time data ingestion pipelines using Apache Kafka and other streaming technologies, ensuring reliable, low\-latency data flow from source systems to Data Lakes, ODS, and downstream consumers.


Build and manage scalable ETL/ELT processes for data cleansing, validation, transformation, and enrichment across multiple source systems including core banking, payments, and transaction banking platforms.


Define patterns for data pipeline orchestration, error handling, retry logic, and monitoring to ensure production\-grade reliability and observability.


Utilize AWS services such as S3, Glue, Redshift, Lambda, Kinesis, Airflow, and SageMaker to deliver end\-to\-end cloud\-native data solutions aligned with security, cost optimization, and scalability principles.


Support advanced analytics and machine learning use cases by designing data pipelines and platform capabilities that provide governed, high\-quality data to data science and business intelligence teams.


Implement data quality frameworks incorporating validation, profiling, and anomaly detection to ensure data trustworthiness.


Establish and maintain metadata management and data lineage tracking to provide transparency into data origins, transformations, and usage.


Define data standards, policies, and best practices collaboratively with data owners, compliance, and business stakeholders to align with regulatory and governance frameworks.


Collaborate with data product owners, data engineers, analytics teams, and business stakeholders to understand requirements, define data products, and deliver solutions driving measurable business value.

Must have


The role requires extensive expertise in data architecture and engineering within large\-scale enterprise settings, focusing on designing and implementing complex data platforms. Strong capabilities in data modeling across conceptual, logical, and physical layers are required, with experience in dimensional and normalized schemas suited for both analytical and operational workloads.


Soft skills involve advanced problem\-solving and analytical abilities to identify and resolve complex data quality issues, pipeline failures, and performance challenges in distributed systems. Effective communication and stakeholder management are critical, enabling collaboration with technical teams, data product owners, business leaders, and governance stakeholders to ensure alignment and successful delivery. Experience within the banking domain, specifically transaction banking in areas such as trade finance, payments, cash management, and supply chain finance, is preferred.

Expertise in data architecture frameworks and production implementations.


Proficient in real\-time data streaming with Apache Kafka.


Skilled in AWS data service platforms for end\-to\-end cloud\-native solutions.


Strong data modeling across various schema designs and workloads.

Analytical problem\-solving for complex distributed data systems.

Domain knowledge in commercial banking transaction services.

title: Agentforce Technical Architect( Salesforce exp is a must)
description:
**Description**
 About the Role
   

  

 The AI Technical Architect operates at the intersection of strategy and execution — acting as both a
 **Strategist** 
 , shaping the long\-term technical vision for AI adoption, and an
 **Orchestrator** 
 , coordinating people, systems, and processes to turn that vision into working solutions. This role is central to designing, scaling, and governing AI and Agentforce\-driven architectures across the delivery organization, ensuring technical decisions align with business outcomes and customer value.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

**Strategist Mindset**
* Define and evolve the technical architecture strategy for AI initiatives, aligning with broader business and platform roadmaps.
* Evaluate emerging AI technologies (LLMs, agentic frameworks, automation platforms) and recommend where they create differentiated value.
* Partner with delivery, product, and engineering leadership to translate business goals into scalable, secure, and maintainable AI architectures.
* Establish architectural standards, patterns, and best practices for AI solution design across teams.
* Assess technical risk, feasibility, and total cost of ownership for proposed AI initiatives.


**Orchestrator Mindset**
* Coordinate cross\-functional teams (engineering, data, product, delivery) to ensure AI solutions are designed, built, and deployed cohesively.
* Serve as the technical glue between strategy and execution — ensuring architecture decisions are implemented consistently across squads and projects.
* Facilitate technical governance forums, architecture reviews, and design decision checkpoints.
* Drive alignment between multiple parallel AI workstreams, resolving dependencies and technical conflicts.
* Mentor and enable technical teams and solution architects on AI\-first design principles.


 Delivery \& Governance
   

  

 Builder Mindset
   

  

* Ship working AI solutions hands\-on — prototype, build, and iterate quickly rather than only designing on paper.
* Take ideas from concept to production, personally building agents, automations, and integrations when needed to prove value fast.
* Champion a bias for action: favor working demos and MVPs over long design documents.
* Continuously experiment with new AI tools and techniques, bringing working proofs\-of\-concept back to the team.
* Balance speed of shipping with architectural soundness, ensuring builds are scalable beyond the prototype stage.
* Own end\-to\-end technical quality of AI solutions from design through production readiness.
* Define and monitor architecture health metrics (scalability, reliability, cost\-efficiency, security posture).
* Ensure compliance with data governance, responsible AI, and security standards across all AI implementations.
* Provide technical escalation support for complex AI/architecture issues across the portfolio.


**Required Qualifications**
* 10\+ years of experience in software/solution architecture, with demonstrated depth in AI/ML or agentic systems architecture.
* Proven experience architecting and delivering enterprise\-scale AI solutions (e.g., LLM\-based systems, automation platforms, Agentforce, or equivalent).
* Strong grasp of cloud\-native architecture, integration patterns, and platform scalability principles.
* Demonstrated ability to operate as both a strategic thinker and hands\-on technical orchestrator across multiple teams.
* Experience with Salesforce platform architecture is highly valued.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills — able to translate technical concepts for both technical and non\-technical audiences.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Salesforce Certified Technical Architect (CTA) or equivalent architecture certification.
* Experience leading AI governance, responsible AI, or AI risk frameworks.
* Track record of mentoring architects and senior engineers.
* Exposure to multi\-org, multi\-cloud, or complex enterprise topology environments.
* Hands\-on experience building and deploying AI agents (e.g., Agentforce, custom agent frameworks) in real\-world settings.
* Practical experience with AI tools such as Gemini, Cursor, and Claude for coding, prototyping, or workflow automation.
* Familiarity with prompt engineering, LLM orchestration, and agentic tool\-use patterns.
* Comfortable working directly in code/config to build and ship — not purely a design\-and\-document architect.

title: Solution Architect - AI, Cross Industries
description:
**Description**
 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is leading the next phase of AI adoption and is seeking a hands\-on AI Solution Architect (SA). AWS Solutions Architect \- AI are SA's with deep domain\-specific expertise, able to address advanced concepts and feature designs.
   

  

 As part of the AWS sales organization, SAs work with customers who have complex challenges that require expert\-level knowledge to solve. SAs craft scalable, flexible, and resilient technical architectures that address those challenges. This might involve guiding customers as they refactor an application or design an entirely new cloud\-based system.
   

  

 SAs play a critical role in capturing customer feedback, advocating for roadmap enhancements and anticipating customer requirements as they work backwards from their needs. As domain experts, SAs also participate in field engagement and enablement, producing content such as whitepapers, blogs, and workshops for customers, partners, and the AWS Technical Field.
   

  

 This role focuses on converting Customers AI ambition into reality
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* The AI SA builds technical relationships with customers of all sizes and operate as their trusted advisor, ensuring they get the most out of the cloud at every stage of their journey while adopting GenAI/ML and Agentic technologies across their organisation.
* You’ll manage the overall technical relationship between AWS and our customers, making recommendations on security, cost, performance, reliability and operational efficiency to accelerate their challenging GenAI/ML and Agentic projects.
* Internally, you will be the voice of the customer, sharing their needs with regard to their usage of our services impacting the roadmap of AWS GenAI/ML and Agentic features.
* In this role, your creativity will link technology to tangible solutions, with the opportunity to define cloud\-native GenAI/ML and Agentic architectural patterns for a variety of use cases.
* You will participate in the creation and sharing of best practices, technical content and new reference architectures (e.g. white papers, code samples, blog posts) and evangelize and educate about running GenAI/ML and Agentic workloads on AWS technology (e.g. through workshops, user groups, meetups, public speaking, online videos or conferences).
* Technical Leadership \& Mentorship: Lead hands\-on deep dives and technical workshops, contributing reusable code, reference architectures, and internal technical assets for the broader Solution Architecture organization.


 A day in the life
   

  

 The Solutions Architect\-AI team at AWS is responsible for helping customers successfully implement GenAI/AgenticSolutions . In a typical week you will meet multiple customers, and you will collaborate with them on designing and operating well\-architected solutions. You will earn their trust and show them the art of the possible, educating them around the capabilities of AWS. Partnering with internal teams and experts, leveraging a deep knowledge of our tools and products, you’ll craft highly scalable, flexible, and resilient cloud architectures that address our customers’ business problems. As part of our team, you’ll have the opportunity to continuously learn and innovate daily.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Cross Industries work hand in hand with AWS customers across mutliple verticals like Auto/Manu, Retail/CPG, HCLS, Travel/Hospitality to help drive AWS GenAI/Agentic services adoption. They are at the crossroads of business and technology and engage with customers of different stages. Supporting the overall technical relationship between customers and AWS, they work to understand the customer's business needs and give prescriptive guidance on how to create business value with technology. Solutions Architects also have broader impact at scale, taking a supporting role in creating and presenting technical content and best practices.
   

  

 You will be part of a team that is responsible for driving adoption of GenAI/Agentic AWS technologies while bringing differentiated value to customers. This is a team dedicated to some of the largest Brands/Services/Ecommerce customers in India . This customers follow unique technology adoption patterns and growth trajectories that distinguish them from traditional businesses, so you will be employing engagement strategies and programs tailored to their business needs and technical preferences.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
* 5\+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data \& analytics) experience
* Experience in external enterprise customer\-facing role as a technical lead, with strong oral and written communication skills, presenting to both large and small audiences
* 5\+ years of management of technical, enterprise customer facing resources or equivalent experience
* Experience in developing and deploying LLMs in production on GPUs, Neuron, TPU or other AI acceleration hardware, or experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems
* Hands\-on experience with AWS ecosystems (including Bedrock, AgentCore, and SageMaker) to set up secure, private\-network AI environments, and practical experience implementing Retrieval\-Augmented Generation using embeddings, vector stores, and semantic search optimization.
* 6\+ years of design/implementation of production AI systems


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Cloud Technology Certification (such as Solutions Architecture, Cloud Security Professional or Cloud DevOps Engineering)
* Experience developing strategies that influence leadership decisions at the organizational level
* Cloud Technology Certification (such as Solutions Architecture, Cloud Security Professional or Cloud DevOps Engineering), or Bachelor's degree
* Experience with Machine Learning and Large Language Model fundamentals, including architecture, training/inference lifecycles, and optimization of model execution
* Proven ability to lead projects with complex challenges with extensible, operationally excellent, cost optimized, and aligned solutions outcomes
* Expertise in architecting AI systems within highly regulated or security\-sensitive environments (e.g., Financial Services, Healthcare, Public Sector).

* Partner closely with Data Engineering and Analytics teams to design modern data architectures, including data lakes, data mesh implementations, and real\-time streaming platforms. These architectures should enable advanced analytics, artificial intelligence (AI), and machine learning (ML) capabilities across the enterprise.



  




* **Security \& Resilience**
* Embed security by design throughout the architecture lifecycle. Implement zero\-trust networking principles, robust identity \& access management (IAM), strong encryption standards, and proven disaster\-recovery and business\-continuity architecture patterns.



  




* **Stakeholder Engagement**
* Communicate complex architectural concepts clearly and effectively to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. Produce well\-structured Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) and present strategic architectural proposals and reviews to governance boards and executive leadership.

Customer has to do much more than keep the wheels turning; it is the engine that drives functional excellence and the enabler of innovation and long\-term growth. Learn more about: Customer

* Enterprise solution architecture across multiple Adobe products, teams, operational models, and business use cases.
* Ability to design scalable frameworks for platform reliability, health monitoring, operational insights, proactive issue detection, and executive visibility.
* Strong understanding of governance architecture, including access visibility, entitlement tracking, auditability, privacy, compliance, and operational accountability.
* Ability to identify gaps between business needs, operational needs, and current product capabilities, then define practical architecture patterns or prototypes to close those gaps.
* Cross\-platform Adobe Experience Cloud understanding across AEP, RTCDP, AJO, CJA, Analytics, Workfront, GenStudio, Experience League, and related integrations.
* Ability to translate complex platform signals into meaningful KPIs, value realization metrics, leadership reporting, and decision\-ready insights.
* Strong architecture judgment to decide what should be automated, standardized, monitored, governed, or escalated to product/engineering roadmap.
* Technical fluency with data, APIs, reporting, cloud platforms, and integration patterns, without the role being limited to hands\-on pipeline engineering.
* Strong technical leadership to influence cross\-functional teams, align stakeholders, guide implementation teams, and connect platform capabilities with measurable business outcomes.
* We are not looking for traditional AEP DA here. We are looking for solution lead who can guide team, unblock and help R\&I take to next level.
* A traditional AEP Data Architect is primarily focused on core data architecture areas such as XDM design, datasets, identity strategy, ingestion patterns, data modeling, and activation readiness within AEP.
* he R\&I Solution Architect role is broader and more outcome\-driven.
* It focuses on making Adobe on Adobe reliable, governable, observable, automated, measurable, and scalable across teams and products.
* This includes designing solutions for platform health monitoring, data quality, access governance, operational insights, value realization, automation, and proactive issue detection.
* The key difference is that R\&I is not only designing how data flows through AEP. It is designing how the overall Adobe on Adobe ecosystem operates successfully at enterprise scale.
* R\&I also helps close product gaps where out\-of\-the\-box capabilities may not fully meet Customer Zero needs, while partnering closely with engineering and product teams to influence future roadmap.
* In short, the R\&I Solution Architect role combines solution architecture, operational excellence, governance, automation, observability, and business value measurement. It is a strategic architecture role that goes beyond traditional AEP data design and directly supports the success, scale, and maturity of Adobe on Adobe.

  


**Location and way of working:**

  


* Base location: Ahmedabad
* Education: Professional Qualification \- B.E./B.Tech/MCA/MBA/MS
* This profile involves occasional travelling to client locations.
* Hybrid is our default way of working. Each domain has customized the hybrid approach to their unique needs.

 As part of the AWS sales organization, SSAs work with customers who have complex challenges that require expert\-level knowledge to solve. SSAs craft scalable, flexible, and resilient technical architectures that address those challenges. This might involve guiding customers as they refactor an application or design an entirely new cloud\-based system.
   

  

 Specialist SAs play a critical role in capturing customer feedback, advocating for roadmap enhancements and anticipating customer requirements as they work backwards from their needs. As domain experts, SSAs also participate in field engagement and enablement, producing content such as whitepapers, blogs, and workshops for customers, partners, and the AWS Technical Field.
   

  

 This role focuses on converting AI ambition into programs that can be delivered, operated, and scaled in production environments.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* The AI Specialist SA team builds technical relationships with customers of all sizes and operate as their trusted advisor, ensuring they get the most out of the cloud at every stage of their journey while adopting GenAI/ML and Agentic technologies across their organisation.

title: Technical Architect - ML
description:
**Overview**
 We are seeking a seasoned \*\*Technical Architect specializing in Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence\*\* to lead the design, architecture, and implementation of large\-scale, production\-grade AI/ML systems. This role combines deep technical expertise with strategic vision to build scalable, reliable, and ethical AI solutions that drive business impact.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Roles \& Responsibilities
   

  

* Define and own the end\-to\-end technical architecture for AI/ML platforms and products (from data ingestion to model serving and monitoring).
* Lead the design of scalable ML pipelines, MLOps frameworks, and generative AI / LLM\-based systems.
* Architect cloud\-native AI solutions (AWS SageMaker, GCP Vertex AI, Azure ML, or multi\-cloud setups).
* Evaluate and select appropriate algorithms, frameworks, and tools (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow, JAX, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Ray, Kubeflow, MLflow, etc.).
* Design systems for large\-scale model training/inference (distributed training, model parallelism, quantization, efficient serving with Triton, vLLM, TGI, etc.).
* Establish best practices for Responsible AI \- fairness, explainability (SHAP, LIME), bias mitigation, privacy (federated learning, differential privacy), and security.
* Build and govern enterprise MLOps platforms including feature stores, model registries, CI/CD for ML, experiment tracking, and observability.
* Collaborate with data engineers, ML engineers, software engineers, and product teams to translate business requirements into robust technical solutions.
* Drive proof\-of\-concepts (PoCs) and spike solutions for emerging technologies (LLMs, multimodal models, agentic systems, retrieval\-augmented generation, etc.).
* Mentor senior ML engineers and architects; set technical standards and conduct architecture reviews.
* Stay ahead of the latest research and productionize cutting\-edge techniques when they add clear business value.


**Requirements**
 Technical Expertise
   

  

* 12\+ years of software engineering experience with at least 6\+ years focused on designing and deploying production ML/AI systems at scale.
* Expert\-level proficiency in Python and ML frameworks (PyTorch / TensorFlow / JAX).
* Hands\-on experience building and deploying Large Language Models (fine\-tuning, instruction tuning, RLHF, quantization, LoRA/QLoRA, inference optimization).
* Deep knowledge of MLOps tools and platforms (Kubeflow, MLflow, Airflow, Dagster, Flyte, Metaflow, ZenML, etc.).
* Strong understanding of distributed systems, microservices, containerization (Docker), orchestration (Kubernetes), and infrastructure\-as\-code (Terraform, Pulumi).
* Experience with vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, Milvus, Qdrant) and RAG architectures.
* Proven track record of designing feature stores (Feast, Tecton), online/offline inference systems, and model monitoring solutions.
* Expertise in cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) and their managed ML services.


 Leadership \& Soft Skills
   

  

* Demonstrated ability to lead cross\-functional technical teams and influence architecture decisions at the executive level.
* Excellent communication skills \- capable of explaining complex ML concepts to non\-technical stakeholders.
* Experience defining AI roadmaps and presenting to C\-level executives.


**Preferred (Nice\-to\-Have)**
* Contributions to open\-source ML projects.
* Knowledge of enterprise data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery).

title: Industrial Software Architect & Team Lead
description:
**About Kitron**
----------------

  

Kitron is a leading Scandinavian Electronics Manufacturing Services (EMS) company, delivering improved flexibility, cost efficiency, and innovation power through the value chain. The company has operations in Norway, Sweden, Denmark, Lithuania, Germany, Poland, the Czech Republic, India, China, Malaysia, and the United States. With 2500 highly skilled employees, Kitron manufactures and delivers anything from fully assembled electronic circuit boards to complete end \- products for customers globally. Related technical services like prototyping, industrialisation, material analysing and test development are also key competencies offered by Kitron.

**Our values**
--------------

 **Location:** Chennai  

**Deadline:** 2026\.09\.30

### **Job Description:**

* Lead, mentor, and develop the software engineering team, including software developers, vision engineers, testers, and interns.
* Define and own the software architecture, technology roadmap, and engineering standards for industrial automation software platforms.
* Design scalable, modular, and reusable software frameworks that can be adopted across multiple machine platforms.
* Act as the technical leader by actively participating in software development, code reviews, debugging, hardware integration, machine testing, commissioning, and complex technical problem\-solving.
* Design and develop industrial software applications using C\#, .NET, and Python for Industrial PCs and engineering applications.
* Develop software modules for machine orchestration, recipe management, production data collection, traceability, analytics, operator interfaces, engineering tools, and machine diagnostics.
* Design backend services, APIs, databases, and software platforms using modern software engineering practices.
* Collaborate closely with the PLC \& Controls team to integrate Industrial PC software with PLCs, motion controllers, robots, vision systems, sensors, barcode readers, and other industrial devices using standard industrial communication protocols.
* Develop communication layers using OPC UA, Modbus TCP/IP, MQTT, REST APIs, TCP/IP, WebSockets, and other industrial communication technologies.
* Work closely with Mechanical, Electrical, Controls, Robotics, and Computer Vision teams to deliver reliable machine automation solutions.
* Establish software engineering best practices, including software architecture reviews, coding standards, version control, automated testing, CI/CD, and deployment strategies.
* Support hardware integration, Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT), Site Acceptance Testing (SAT), commissioning, troubleshooting, and customer technical support from the software perspective.
* Lead cloud connectivity, Microsoft Azure integration, edge computing, Industrial IoT, and digitalization initiatives where applicable.
* Drive technical planning, project execution, software documentation, and continuous improvement of the software engineering organization.

### **Requirements:**

* Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, Electronics, Mechatronics, or a related engineering discipline.
* 8–12 years of experience in software development for industrial automation, machine control systems, robotics, or smart factory applications.
* Minimum 2 years of experience as a Software Architect or Software Team Lead.
* Strong expertise in C\#, .NET/.NET Core, and Python, with solid knowledge of software architecture, object\-oriented design, and design patterns.
* Hands\-on experience developing industrial machine software, including hardware integration, testing, commissioning, and production deployment.
* Experience integrating Industrial PC software with PLCs, robots, vision systems, sensors, and industrial devices using protocols such as OPC UA, Modbus TCP/IP, MQTT, REST APIs, and TCP/IP.
* Experience with backend development, SQL databases, and modern web technologies (React, Angular, or Vue.js).
* Experience with Azure, Docker, Git, Linux, and CI/CD is preferred.
* Knowledge of Industrial IoT, MES, SCADA, and Industry 4\.0 concepts is an added advantage.
* Strong leadership, communication, mentoring, and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to balance technical leadership and hands\-on software development.
* Willingness to support software development, hardware integration, machine testing, FAT/SAT, commissioning, and customer technical support.

### **We offer:**

* Global team and projects.
* Opportunities for personal and professional development.
* Training and competence development courses

title: Enterprise AI Architect
description:
Acuity Analytics (the trading name of Acuity Knowledge Partners) is a global, tech\-first organization helping financial institutions and corporates make better decisions through research, data, analytics and AI\-enabled solutions. We combine deep financial services expertise with strong engineering, digital and AI capabilities to solve complex, real\-world problems.
   

  

 With a team of 7,200\+ analysts, data specialists and technologists across 28 locations, we work with more than 800 organizations worldwide to drive efficiency, unlock insight and deliver measurable impact. Our success is built on the strength of our people—by investing in talent, encouraging collaboration and creating room to grow, we enable our teams to do their best work for clients.
   

  

 Acuity became an independent business in 2019 following its acquisition from Moody’s Corporation by Equistone Partners Europe. In 2023, funds advised by global private equity firm Permira acquired a majority stake, with Equistone remaining a minority investor—supporting our continued growth and innovation.
   

  

 For more information, visit www.acuityanalytics.com
   

  

 Organizational relationships
   

  

**Job Purpose**
 We are looking for a
 **15\+ years experienced Senior Enterprise AI Architect / Principal AI Engineer** 
 to define the technical vision and drive the architecture of our Enterprise Agent Fleet product — a platform for building, orchestrating, and governing fleets of autonomous and human\-in\-the\-loop AI agents at enterprise scale. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in agentic system design, LLM orchestration, multi\-agent frameworks, and enterprise\-grade platform architecture, and will act as a technical anchor across product, engineering, and AI research teams.
   

  

 Key responsibilities
   

  

* Key Responsibilities:
* Define and own the end\-to\-end technical architecture for the Enterprise Agent Fleet product, spanning agent orchestration, tool integration, and platform services.
* Design scalable, secure, and highly available multi\-agent systems capable of supporting thousands of concurrent enterprise workflows.
* Architect the agent lifecycle — planning, tool invocation, memory, evaluation, and governance — for autonomous and human\-in\-the\-loop agents.
* Lead technical design and deliveryusing multi\-agent orchestration frameworks such as LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, or MCP\-based architectures.
* Integrate the Agent Fleet platformwith LLM APIs, vector databases, RAG pipelines, enterprise data platforms, and real\-time event streams.
* Design protocols for agent\-to\-agent communication, tool\-use contracts, streaming responses, and human\-in\-the\-loop approval processes.
* Design and implement workflow\-driven agent orchestration using BPM/process engines (Camunda or similar) where deterministic control is required.
* Integrate the platform withenterprise identity, secrets management, observability, and CI/CD systems.
* Build frameworks for agent evaluation, exception management, guardrails, and SLA monitoring across the fleet.
* Collaborate with product and business teams to translate enterprise processes into agentic, BPMN/DMN\-based workflows.
* Establish standards for reusable agent components, prompt/context management, API integration, authentication, and error handling.
* Ensure platform observability, cost efficiency, latency optimization, and enterprise\-grade application security.
* Conduct architecture and design reviews, and mentor senior and staff\-level AI engineers.
* Collaborate with Product, AI Research, Backend, Data, Security, and DevOps teams across the organization.
* Own the design and evolution of theagent harnessthat governs agent execution, tool calling, sandboxing, retries, and runtime observability across the fleet.
* Architect the Agent Fleet product as amulti\-tenant SaaS platform, covering tenant isolation, subscription and usage\-based billing, RBAC, and enterprise\-grade onboarding.
* Own technical delivery of the Agent Fleet product from architecture and prototyping through production deployment, scaling, and optimization.


 Key competencies
   

  

* Design, build, and deploy enterprise\-grade agentic AI platforms usingPython and Goanddistributed, cloud\-native infrastructure (Kubernetes, event\-driven microservices)
* Deep hands\-on experience building and scalingmulti\-agent systems(e.g., planning agents, tool\-calling agents, retrieval\-augmented agents) into production enterprise workflows.
* 15\+ years of software engineering experience, with 5\+ years in AI/ML or GenAI platform architecture.
* Advanced, production experience withLangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, Semantic Kernel, or the Model Context Protocol (MCP).
* Proven track record architecting enterprise\-grade AI platforms serving thousands of users or high\-throughput workloads.
* Strong knowledge of LLM integration, prompt/context engineering, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), vector databases, and streaming inference.
* Hands\-on experience with workflow/process engines such as Camunda 7 or Camunda 8 for deterministic orchestration alongside agentic flows
* Strong understanding of BPMN 2\.0, DMN, workflow orchestration, agent evaluation frameworks, and human\-in\-the\-loop task management.
* Experience integrating enterprise platforms withREST APIs, GraphQL, gRPC, event streaming (Kafka), and microservices.
* Knowledge of agent memory/state management, evaluation and testing frameworks, and cost/latency performance optimization for LLM\-based systems.
* Deep understanding of cloud platforms (AWS/GCP/Azure), CI/CD pipelines, containerization/Kubernetes, security, and observability at enterprise scale.
* Hands\-on experience building or operating anagent harness— the runtime layer that manages agent execution loops, tool/function calling, context window and memory management, sandboxing, retries, and observability for autonomous agents.
* Prior experience architecting or scalingmulti\-tenant SaaS products, including tenant isolation, subscription/usage\-based billing, role\-based access control, and enterprise onboarding at scale.
* Strong technical leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.


 Acuity Analytics has earned several prestigious industry recognitions, including Great Place to Work® certifications in India and Costa Rica, AVTAR Best Companies for Women in India, the AVTAR Most Inclusive Companies Index, and silver accreditation in the Workplace Equality Index. These accolades reflect our commitment to building an inclusive, supportive and high\-performance workplace for our people. Learn more here.

title: Advanced Specialist, Enterprise Architect - (AI Systems & Distributed Engineering)
description:
**Job Title: Advance Specialist ,Enterprise Architect** 



  

  


**About the role:** 



  

  


 Seeking a visionary Enterprise Architect to be part of the Enterprise Architecture team. This is not an "advisory" role — we require a practitioner who balances high\-level strategic governance with deep\-dive technical execution. The ideal candidate will bridge the gap between traditional distributed and enterprise systems and the emerging frontier of Agentic AI, transforming how the enterprise leverages autonomous agents and LLM\-driven workflows.
 


  

  


**Experience Level:** 
 12\-15 Years
 **Location:** 
 Bangalore or Chennai, India
 **Role Type:** 
 Hands\-on Enterprise Architect
 


  

  


**Key Responsibilities** 



  

  
* **Architectural Strategy \& Blueprint Ownership**
  

  
* Own and maintain the enterprise architecture blueprint — current\-state and target\-state views across application, data, integration, and infrastructure layers.
  

  
* Define and evangelize reference architectures and reusable patterns for agentic AI systems (agent orchestration, tool\-calling, memory/state management, guardrails) so delivery teams don't reinvent foundational patterns per project.
  

  
* **AI Agent Ecosystems**
  

  
* Design and govern the architecture for multi\-agent systems, including agent\-to\-agent communication protocols, orchestration frameworks, and tool/function\-calling interfaces.
  

  
* Define standards for grounding, memory, retrieval, and context management across LLM\-driven workflows.
  

  
* Establish human\-in\-the\-loop checkpoints and escalation paths for autonomous agents operating on production data or systems.
  

  
* Evaluate and select frameworks/platforms for agent orchestration (e.g., orchestration engines, model routing, guardrail layers), balancing build vs. buy.
  

  
* **Modeling \& Governance**
  

  
* Chair or actively participate in the Architecture Review Chapter; define review cadence, entry/exit criteria, and a clear exception\-handling process for teams that need to move fast.
  

  
* Own Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) and maintain a lightweight, non\-bureaucratic approval workflow so governance catches drift without blocking delivery.
  

  
* Define non\-negotiable guardrails for AI/agentic systems — data access boundaries, PII handling, human\-in\-the\-loop requirements, and audit logging — that any new agent workflow must pass through review.
  

  
* Maintain enterprise modeling artifacts (capability maps, data flow diagrams, integration catalogs) as the single source of truth referenced during reviews.
  


  


**Required Technical Skills** 



  

  


**AI** 



  

  
* Hands\-on experience with LLM application architecture: RAG pipelines, agent frameworks, prompt/context engineering, model evaluation and guardrails.
  

  
* Familiarity with multi\-agent orchestration patterns and tool\-use/function\-calling architectures.
  


  


**Cloud \& Infrastructure** 



  

  
* Deep experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS/Azure/GCP), containerization (Kubernetes), and infra\-as\-code.
  

  
* Experience designing for scalability, resilience, and cost efficiency at enterprise scale.
  


  


**Distributed \& Enterprise Systems Integration** 



  

  
* Strong background in distributed systems design (event\-driven architecture, microservices, API gateways, messaging systems).
  

  
* Experience integrating legacy enterprise systems (ERP, CRM, core platforms) with modern cloud\-native and AI\-driven components.
  


  


**Data Architecture** 



  

  
* Experience designing enterprise data architectures — data pipelines, data mesh/data fabric concepts, governance, and lineage.
  

  
* Ability to model and maintain the data\-flow view that underpins the enterprise digital twin.
  


  


**Modeling \& Governance Tooling** 



  

  
* Practical experience with architecture modeling notations/tools (e.g., ArchiMate, C4 model, TOGAF\-aligned frameworks) and running formal EA review processes.
  


  


**Qualifications** 



  

  
* 12 \- 15 years of progressive experience in software engineering and solution architecture.
  

  
* Demonstrated ability to strategise and develop PoC and add create practices around it.
  

  
* A portfolio of successful large\-scale modernization or AI\-transformation projects, ideally including experience participating in an EA governance process (ARB, ADRs) from scratch or maturing an existing one.
  

  
* Prior experience building or working with an enterprise digital twin or equivalent simulation/dependency\-modeling capability is a strong plus.
