title: Senior API Product Engineer
description:
**About the job** 




**We’re hiring a Senior API Product Engineer in Pune!** 




 Be part of our growing international tech team building innovative telecom platforms for European market.
 



  





**About Peoplefone:** 




 Founded in Zurich in 2005, peoplefone started as a bold idea to transform telecommunications — and we’ve been growing ever since. Now active in
 **seven European countries** 
 and licensed telecom providers in five others, we’re a dynamic and forward\-thinking organization committed to innovation in VoIP and telecom services.
 



**🌐 Learn more:
 
 www.peoplefone.com**




  





**What We’re Looking For:** 




 We are looking for a Senior API Product Engineer to design and develop customer\-facing APIs as reliable, secure and easy\-to\-use products. This is not only a backend development position. You will work with product teams, internal developers, customers, and integration partners to understand their use cases, determine which capabilities and data should be exposed, and translate those requirements into clear and evolvable API contracts.
 



 You will own API design from the initial use case through contract definition, implementation, documentation, testing, publication and lifecycle management.
 



  





**Your impact:** 



* **Understand real usage** 
 – Gather and challenge API requirements together with customers, partners, product owners and internal teams, and understand how their developers will consume what we expose.
* **Design contract\-first** 
 – Design every API using a contract\-first approach with OpenAPI: agree resources, operations, schemas, error models, pagination, filtering, idempotency and async patterns before implementation starts, and use the contract as the source of truth for docs, mocks and tests.
* **Decide what's exposed** 
 – Work with product, architecture and security to decide what data and operations may be exposed, and translate business capabilities into intuitive, consistent API resources and workflows.
* **Build production\-grade APIs** 
 – Implement and maintain the REST APIs you design, with clean versioning, deprecation and backward\-compatibility strategies so partner integrations never break unexpectedly.
* **Secure by design** 
 – Define authentication and authorization, scopes and roles appropriate to customer\- and partner\-facing use cases.
* **Enable integrators** 
 – Create accurate documentation, examples and reference integrations, and support customers and partners directly during their integration work.
* **Close the loop** 
 – Establish automated contract, integration, security and performance testing, and feed real API\-consumer feedback back into the design.
* **Raise the bar platform\-wide** 
 – Define API design guidelines and reusable standards that other development teams adopt.
* **Work as one team** 
 – Participate in daily stand\-ups, sprint reviews and retrospectives, with code reviews, pair programming and CI/CD as standard practice.



  





**What You Bring** 




***The Must\-Haves:***



* 8\+ years of backend software engineering experience, including significant time designing and building REST APIs in production
* Hands\-on experience defining API contracts with OpenAPI/Swagger, and comfort treating the spec as a first\-class deliverable, not an afterthought
* Proven ability to design resources, schemas, versioning and backward\-compatibility strategies for APIs consumed by external customers or partners — not only internal services
* Solid understanding of API security fundamentals: OAuth 2\.0/OIDC, scopes, roles and data\-exposure controls
* Confident handling of relational databases and writing clean, maintainable, well\-tested code (automated unit/integration tests as standard practice)
* Experience working directly with customers, partners or third\-party integrators to gather requirements and support their integration work
* Self\-organized, a strong communicator, and comfortable owning a feature or capability from initial use case through go\-live
* Good written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to produce clear developer\-facing documentation



  





***Nice\-to\-Haves:***



* Telecom/VoIP domain experience.
* Experience with PHP 8\.x, Laravel \& OOP
* Frontend experience (Vue 2/3, CSS, React)
* Familiarity with contract/schema testing tools (e.g. OpenAPI diffing, Spectral, contract test frameworks)
* Experience with containers and CI/CD pipelines (Docker, Kubernetes, GitLab CI)
* Monitoring stack exposure: Grafana, Prometheus, OpenSearch
* Atlassian tooling: Jira, Confluence.
* Agile mindset and experience with Scrum methodologies



  





**Why Join peoplefone?** 



* Young, international team \- short communication paths, direct decisions
* Daily challenges in an open, innovative environment with a team that supports and inspires each other
* Training time and budget allocated for your growth
* Career Growth opportunities into an evolving team

title: Copilot Agents -M365 Power platform
description:
Date live: 09/10/2026


Business Area: GTIS


Area of Expertise: Technology


Contract: Permanent


Reference Code: JR\-0000113872


  
Join us as a “Copilot Agents \-M365 Power platform" at Barclays, where you'll spearhead the evolution of our digital landscape, driving innovation and excellence. You'll harness cutting\-edge technology to revolutionise our digital offerings, ensuring unapparelled customer experiences.
  

  

You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as experience with, skills to meet business requirement as well as job\-specific skillsets.


To be successful as a “Copilot Agents \-M365 Power platform", you should have experience with:


**Basic/ Essential Qualifications:**


* Hands\-on experience across the Microsoft 365 ecosystem, with a working understanding of tenant architecture, service interdependencies, licensing and admin controls, and practical knowledge of how Microsoft 365 Copilot grounds on tenant data through Microsoft Graph and the semantic index.
* Building and deploying Copilot agents — declarative agents covering the manifest and agent definition, instructions, knowledge sources, API plugin actions with OpenAPI specifications, packaging and the M365 admin approval process — together with an informed view of when a custom engine agent is the right choice.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID: users, groups and licensing, app registrations, enterprise applications and service principals, delegated versus application permissions and admin consent, and conditional access concepts.
* A sound practical grasp of authentication and token exchange — OAuth 2\.0 and OpenID Connect flows, access, refresh and ID tokens, scopes and claims, token lifetime and validation, the on\-behalf\-of flow, and single sign\-on within Teams and Copilot agent scenarios.
* Practical experience with the Microsoft Graph API, including the permissions model, authenticating in code, pagination, throttling and error handling.
* Strong competence in at least one development language such as C\#, Python, JavaScript or TypeScript, with REST and JSON fluency, PowerShell for administration, and sound engineering discipline across source control, code review, testing and secure coding.
* Proven delivery within an Agile team — backlog refinement, estimation, sprint commitment, stand\-ups, reviews and retrospectives, using Jira or Azure DevOps.
* Ability to contribute to design and architecture: producing and reviewing high\- and low\-level designs and authentication and integration flow diagrams, and assessing non\-functional requirements such as availability, resilience and security.
* Clear written and verbal communication, with the confidence to engage stakeholders outside the immediate team and explain technical detail to a non\-technical audience.

**Desirable skillsets/ good to have:**


* Building and publishing agents in Copilot Studio — topics, generative orchestration, knowledge sources, actions, channel publishing and solution management.
* Exposure to Copilot Cowork or other agentic, task\-based working patterns, including the governance and data\-handling considerations around them.
* Building Microsoft Graph connectors to bring external content into the Copilot grounding surface, and working with change notifications and webhooks.
* Teams app development using the Teams Toolkit, Adaptive Cards or the Bot Framework.
* Azure fundamentals and hosting experience — App Service, Functions, API Management and Key Vault — along with Azure OpenAI or Azure AI Foundry exposure.
* Retrieval\-augmented generation concepts, prompt engineering, evaluation and responsible AI practice.
* Infrastructure\-as\-code and CI/CD pipeline experience with Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions.
* Power Platform capability across Power Apps, Power Automate, custom connectors and Dataverse.
* Familiarity with M365 guardrails and compliance controls, including data loss prevention, retention and sensitivity labelling, external and guest access, and app consent policy.
* Microsoft certifications such as SC\-300, MS\-700, AI\-102, PL\-200, PL\-400, AZ\-104 or AZ\-204\.
* Experience in financial services or another regulated industry.

This role will be based out of Pune.


**Purpose of the role**


To build and maintain infrastructure platforms and products that support applications and data systems, using hardware, software, networks, and cloud computing platforms as required with the aim of ensuring that the infrastructure is reliable, scalable, and secure. Ensure the reliability, availability, and scalability of the systems, platforms, and technology through the application of software engineering techniques, automation, and best practices in incident response.


**Accountabilities**


* Build Engineering: Development, delivery, and maintenance of high\-quality infrastructure solutions to fulfil business requirements ensuring measurable reliability, performance, availability, and ease of use. Including the identification of the appropriate technologies and solutions to meet business, optimisation, and resourcing requirements.
* Incident Management: Monitoring of IT infrastructure and system performance to measure, identify, address, and resolve any potential issues, vulnerabilities, or outages. Use of data to drive down mean time to resolution.
* Automation: Development and implementation of automated tasks and processes to improve efficiency and reduce manual intervention, utilising software scripting/coding disciplines.
* Security: Implementation of a secure configuration and measures to protect infrastructure against cyber\-attacks, vulnerabilities, and other security threats, including protection of hardware, software, and data from unauthorised access.
* Teamwork: Cross\-functional collaboration with product managers, architects, and other engineers to define IT Infrastructure requirements, devise solutions, and ensure seamless integration and alignment with business objectives via a data driven approach.
* Learning: Stay informed of industry technology trends and innovations, and actively contribute to the organization's technology communities to foster a culture of technical excellence and growth.

**Analyst Expectations**


* To perform prescribed activities in a timely manner and to a high standard consistently driving continuous improvement.
* Requires in\-depth technical knowledge and experience in their assigned area of expertise
* Thorough understanding of the underlying principles and concepts within the area of expertise
* They lead and supervise a team, guiding and supporting professional development, allocating work requirements and coordinating team resources.
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they develop technical expertise in work area, acting as an advisor where appropriate.
* Will have an impact on the work of related teams within the area.
* Partner with other functions and business areas.
* Takes responsibility for end results of a team’s operational processing and activities.
* Escalate breaches of policies / procedure appropriately.
* Take responsibility for embedding new policies/ procedures adopted due to risk mitigation.
* Advise and influence decision making within own area of expertise.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work you own or contribute to. Deliver your work and areas of responsibility in line with relevant rules, regulation and codes of conduct.
* Maintain and continually build an understanding of how own sub\-function integrates with function, alongside knowledge of the organisations products, services and processes within the function.
* Demonstrate understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub\-function.
* Make evaluative judgements based on the analysis of factual information, paying attention to detail.
* Resolve problems by identifying and selecting solutions through the application of acquired technical experience and will be guided by precedents.
* Guide and persuade team members and communicate complex / sensitive information.
* Act as contact point for stakeholders outside of the immediate function, while building a network of contacts outside team and external to the organisation.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. In partnership with the Account Director, you will translate business priorities into a focused use\-case portfolio, an actionable adoption roadmap, and a clear path to durable customer value and growth. The Account Director owns commercial strategy; you own the technical strategy, customer journey, and path to production value.

  

You will remain accountable for the technical outcome while bringing in the right specialists across deployment, implementation, enablement, security, product, and partners to provide deeper expertise and execute work where needed. This role calls for strong industry fluency, sound architectural judgment, and the ability to move confidently between executive strategy and hands\-on technical conversations.

  

This role can be based in Delhi, Mumbai, or Bangalore. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees

* Serve as the primary technical advisor and long\-term technical relationship owner for a named portfolio of existing customers and pre\-sales prospects.

title: Global IT Solution Architect Expert Senior Manager
description:
Who We Are
   

  

 Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963\. Today, we help clients with total transformation\-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom\-line impact.
   

  

 To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading\-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

 The hands\-on Solution Architect is responsible for the architecture, design, and delivery of cohesive technical solutions across BCG business, primarily focusing on implementation of new solutions, solution enhancements, and system/data integration. The Solution Architect likely will be aligned with one or more business area, such that they can develop a thorough understanding of the business and drive consistency and integration across solutions for that business area. They will also maintain awareness of emerging technologies relevant to their areas of expertise and responsibility.
   

  

 The successful candidate will be a highly motivated strategic thinker, engaging collaborator, and effective influencer. Key objectives of the role are to drive digital transformation and the strategic and tactical use of technology to deliver business capabilities, while the organization with cutting edge technologies in a high paced environment. Critical to the Solution Architect’s success is their ability to drive projects and teams to deliver results for the business, balanced with adherence to standards and processes. They will coordinate and provide oversight to the solution/technical leads of multiple development squads.
   

  

 The Solution Architect will also facilitate cross\-enterprise coordination, ensuring that we accommodate requirements across the business and address system integration needs for solutions. They will collaborate with multi\-disciplinary architects and engineers across the Technology organization and within the business to develop strategy, technology roadmaps, and technical standards. They will also work as an interface point with strategic partners, determining where they may offer value to business partners and facilitating coordination on joint initiatives.
   

  

* Architect and deliver GenAI solutions (copilots, workflow automation, knowledge assistants) from prototype to production.
* Use AI\-assisted engineering tools (e.g., Claude code, Cursor, equivalents) to accelerate delivery with strong quality/security.
* Design and scale agentic systems; define standards for agent development, orchestration, deployment, and monitoring.
* Establish reusable MCP patterns/services for consistent tool integration, governance, and lifecycle management.
* Define patterns for enterprise scaling (access control, guardrails, evaluation, observability, cost/latency, reliability).
* Build production\-viable prototypes for emerging tech (incl. GenAI/agents) and validate feasibility, security, operability, and scale.
* Interpret business needs and requirements and design/develop technical solutions to deliver the desired business capabilities.
* Collaborate with Enterprise Architects and other Solution Architects and engineers to architect and design technical solutions that are aligned with enterprise technology standards and strategy, while also working to help develop and grow those standards and roadmaps.
* Work across multiple systems/solutions to ensure their consistency and alignment, as well as to determine how multiple systems/solutions can work together to serve a particular line of business and/or to ensure that a solution works across lines of business.
* Leverage experience and expertise across a wide variety of technology domains, including infrastructure, data management, systems integration, and application development, with a recent emphasis on technologies leveraged by BCG, such as FiveTrans, MuleSoft APIs, Infomatica, AWS, Azure, and SnowFlake.
* Employ and enforce system/solution develop processes, agile methodologies, DevOps principles and practices, and quality engineering best practices.
* Exercise concepts and best practices for designing system reliability/resilience, performance/scalability and maintainability/operability.
* Provide technical oversight to multiple project teams to ensure compliance with processes and standards. Ensure that solutions/systems developed in support of the business are aligned with BCG Enterprise Architecture, technical standards, and technology roadmaps.
* Organize Architecture and Design Reviews to ensure wider architecture peer group input is sought for robust design
* Conduct proof of concept exercises for emerging solutions and prove out potential enhancements to the design
* Ensure designs are implemented with target architecture and key design decisions are clearly communicated to leadership and all key stakeholders
* Review and consider prospective changes to the baseline solution that have been raised by process owners, projects, production support, continuous improvement initiatives and the business for architectural impact


 What You'll Bring
   

  

**Essential Education**
* Master’s Degree in Computer Science
* 14 years of work experience \+ 10 years of experience designing and implementing business critical applications in multi\-region environments \+1 year of deep exposure to LLM based business applications


**Essential Experience \& Job Requirements**
* Minimum of 7 years of experience as a software developer, preferably in multitenant/SaaS projects
* Work experience as a Solutions Architect in at least one project
* Demonstrated hands\-on Solution Architect experience; able to build reference implementations and unblock teams.
* Strong experience with AI coding assistants (Claude, Cursor, equivalents) and safe enterprise usage.
* Familiarity with GenAI dev platforms (e.g., AI Studio, Replit, Devin, equivalents) for rapid prototyping.
* Deep expertise in agent patterns (RAG, tool use, planning, memory, guardrails, HITL) and production operations.
* Experience with agent orchestration/deployment (CI/CD, runtime, monitoring, incident response).
* Experience building/managing MCP ecosystems (registry, access, versioning, performance/cost controls).
* Critical thinking and analytical skills to address complex technical challenges
* Experience in conducting technical assessments and feasibility studies
* Advanced Expertise in major cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud)
* Knowledge of cloud\-native technologies and practices
* Proficiency in multiple programming languages (Python, Typescript)
* Understanding of software development lifecycles and methodologies
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and practices
* Knowledge of containerization and orchestration (e.g. Docker, Kubernetes)
* Knowledge of distributed systems concepts
* Knowledge of current technical landscape and emerging trends
* Ability to document business processes and system architectures
* Experience with one or more application development languages and/or system integration platforms
* Knowledge of and exposure to Azure and AWS application services, including serverless solutions.
* Excellent collaboration skills, evidence of building highly effective partnerships with projects, vendors, peer architects, security teams and operational Service lines and engagement with senior stakeholders
* Provide technical coaching and mentoring, actively keeps current with developments
* Ability to work simultaneously on multiple projects, at times with conflicting priorities with a strong track record of delivery
* Ability to estimate tasks and workload to achieve deliverables and goals, delivering on time and on estimation
* Ability to work with multiple external teams and accomplish shared goals
* Demonstrated ability to constantly learn outside of a classroom environment, and successfully apply learnings
* Experience with relational and NoSQL databases
* Understanding of data modeling and data integration patterns
* Experience with various architectural patterns and styles (e.g. microservices, event\-driven, layered)
* Enthusiastic, high\-energy individual; self\-motivated and self\-directed
* Advanced understanding of LLM concepts (agents, vector db, graph db, RAG, MoE, guardrails, HITL, RFHL), frameworks (llamaindex, unstructured, etc)
* Capacity to learn new and emerging technologies


 Who You'll Work With
   

  

* Global functional tribe technical leaders (Finance, HR, Marketing, Legal, Risk, IT), product owners, functional area teams across levels
* Global Data Tribe Management \& teams (Enterprise Data Model, Data Catalog, Master Data Management)
* Consulting and internal Data Tribe teams across BCG

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer IRC302347
description:
**Description**
**About the Role \& Team**
 We are seeking a Forward\-Deployed AI Architect to help our enterprise customers radically accelerate and modernize their software delivery lifecycle. In this elite, high\-impact role, you will embed directly with customer engineering teams to prove the value of AI\-led engineering through hands\-on architecture, agentic workflows, and measurable delivery outcomes.
   

  

 This role is designed for senior architects and builders who sit at the intersection of core enterprise software architecture and cutting\-edge AI engineering. You will help customers transition from traditional, ticket\-bound Scrum cycles toward intent\-driven, increasingly autonomous delivery models where AI tools, agents, and human governance seamlessly turn business intent into production\-ready software.
   

  

**Requirements**
**Candidate Profile: Qualifications \& Experience**
**Must\-Have Attributes**
 – Experience: 12\+ years of proven experience across software engineering, architecture, product/platform engineering, or solution architecture, backed by a strong track record of product\-side delivery.
   

  

 – SDLC Mastery: Deep, foundational understanding of enterprise software architecture, DevSecOps pipelines, Agile/Scrum frameworks, and the broader product lifecycle.
   

  

 – Hands\-on AI Fluency: Direct, practical fluency with AI development tools, IDE\-based AI assistants, agentic workflows, and AI\-enabled software delivery. You must possess the ability to build, evaluate, and deeply explain working AI solutions.
   

  

 – Modern AI Tech Stack: Experience leveraging tools and frameworks such as Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, GitHub Copilot, LangChain, AutoGen, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, MCP (Model Context Protocol), RAG, and vector databases.
   

  

 – Hands on in Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), Vector Databases, Evaluation Frameworks, Prompt Engineering, Tool Calling, Function Calling, Multi\-agent orchestration, AI Observability
   

  

**Good\-to\-Have Skills**
 – Customer\-Facing Excellence: Prior experience in high\-touch, customer\-facing technical roles (e.g., Forward\-Deployed Engineer, Principal Solutions Architect, Field Engineer, or Pre\-Sales Engineering Leader).
   

  

 – AI Governance \& Security: A strong grasp of AI governance models, human\-in\-the\-loop controls, responsible AI frameworks, observability, and production readiness for AI\-enabled enterprise systems.
   

  

 Job responsibilities
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Client Engagement \& Strategic Architecture


 – Identify AI Opportunities: Work directly with customer engineering, product, architecture, and executive teams to diagnose SDLC bottlenecks and map out high\-value areas for AI\-led acceleration.
   

  

 – Design \& Build Proofs of Concept: Act as a hands\-on builder to design, develop, and deliver working proofs utilizing modern AI engineering tools, agentic workflows, and automation frameworks.
   

  

 – Lead the Intent\-Driven Transition: Guide clients away from rigid, manual sprint mechanics toward fluid, intent\-driven delivery loops capable of autonomously generating plans, code, tests, documentation, and validation artifacts.
   

  

  

* Value Measurement \& Executive Alignment


 – Quantify AI Impact: Define, measure, and report on hard engineering acceleration outcomes, including reduced cycle times, faster story\-to\-code conversion, improved automated testing, and accelerated code reviews.
   

  

 – Technical \& Executive Presentation: Communicate complex technical approaches, agentic architectures, proof results, and long\-term adoption strategies to both engineering teams and C\-level stakeholders.
   

  

 What we offer
   

  

**Exciting Projects:** 
 We focus on industries like High\-Tech, communication, media, healthcare, retail and telecom. Our customer list is full of fantastic global brands and leaders who love what we build for them.
   

  

**Collaborative Environment:** 
 You Can expand your skills by collaborating with a diverse team of highly talented people in an open, laidback environment — or even abroad in one of our global centers or client facilities!
   

  

**Work\-Life Balance:** 
 GlobalLogic prioritizes work\-life balance, which is why we offer flexible work schedules, opportunities to work from home, and paid time off and holidays.
   

  

**Professional Development:** 
 Our dedicated Learning \& Development team regularly organizes Communication skills training(GL Vantage, Toast Master),Stress Management program, professional certifications, and technical and soft skill trainings.
   

  

**Excellent Benefits:** 
 We provide our employees with competitive salaries, family medical insurance, Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance , NPS(National Pension Scheme ), Periodic health awareness program, extended maternity leave, annual performance bonuses, and referral bonuses.
   

  

**Fun Perks:** 
 We want you to love where you work, which is why we host sports events, cultural activities, offer food on subsidies rates, Corporate parties. Our vibrant offices also include dedicated GL Zones, rooftop decks and GL Club where you can drink coffee or tea with your colleagues over a game of table and offer discounts for popular stores and restaurants!
   

  

**About GlobalLogic**
 GlobalLogic, a Hitachi Group Company, is a trusted digital engineering partner to the world’s largest and most forward\-thinking companies. Since 2000, we’ve been at the forefront of the digital revolution – helping create some of the most innovative and widely used digital products and experiences. Today we continue to collaborate with clients in transforming businesses and redefining industries through intelligent products, platforms, and services.

title: Principal, Tech (Middleware)
company: D. E. Shaw India Private Limited
description:
The D. E. Shaw group is a global investment and technology development firm with more than $90 billion in investment capital as of March 1, 2026, and offices in North America, Europe, and Asia. Since our founding in 1988, our firm has earned an international reputation for successful investing based on innovation, careful risk management, and the quality and depth of our staff. We have a significant presence in the world’s capital markets, investing in a wide range of companies and financial instruments in both developed and developing economies.
   

  

 We are looking for a senior technologist to join our Messaging Middleware team based in the firm’s offices in Hyderabad, Bengaluru or Gurugram. The team is responsible for building and evolving a framework for real\-time data streaming web applications used across the firm. This framework enables partner teams to focus on business logic while relying on a robust shared platform to handle the complexity of real\-time messaging, data delivery, scalability, resiliency, observability, and developer ergonomics. As a principal\-level individual contributor, you will help shape the technical direction of a core platform, make key architectural and implementation decisions, contribute directly to high\-impact systems, and raise the engineering bar through technical leadership, mentorship, and example.
   

  

**WHAT YOU'LL DO DAY\-TO\-DAY:**
 In this role, you will design, build, and enhance a framework that powers real\-time data streaming web applications across the firm. You will work on capabilities that improve platform efficiency, robustness, scalability, observability, and ease of use for application teams. You will partner closely with framework users to understand their requirements and translate them into reusable platform capabilities that support low\-latency, high\-throughput, and fault\-tolerant application behavior. You will drive performance tuning across the stack, including messaging, serialization, transport, concurrency, backpressure handling, and client/server interactions. You will help design resilient systems that handle failures gracefully, including network interruptions, traffic spikes, and partial service degradation. You will also contribute directly to the implementation of critical components, review architecture and code, troubleshoot production issues, and drive improvements in testing, operability, and long\-term design health. As a senior technical leader on the team, you will mentor junior and mid\-level engineers through design reviews, code reviews, and day\-to\-day collaboration. You will influence engineering culture by setting a high bar in technical rigor, ownership, and execution, and periodically providing clear updates to senior stakeholders on technical direction, system health, key deliverables, and important risks or trade\-offs.
   

  

**WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR:**
 The ideal candidate should hold\-
   

  

 Basic qualifications:
   

  

* A bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related technical discipline with a strong foundation in algorithms, data structures, distributed systems, and object\-oriented programming
* The candidate should have 7\+ years of software engineering experience building high\-performance, real\-time distributed systems
* The candidate should have strong experience with messaging middleware, event\-driven systems, and low\-latency data streaming architectures
* Proven experience designing and building production\-grade frameworks, platforms, or shared infrastructure
* The candidate should have strong understanding of performance, scalability, reliability, and fault tolerance in distributed systems
* The candidate should have hands\-on experience with technologies such as Kafka, Solace, NATS, RabbitMQ, Pulsar, WebSockets, SSE, or gRPC streaming
* The candidate should have strong software design, debugging, testing, and code quality fundamentals
* The candidate should have experience with production observability, monitoring, troubleshooting, and operational support
* The candidate should have demonstrated technical leadership and mentoring experience as a senior individual contributor
* The candidate should have excellent written and oral communication skills
* The candidate should be comfortable working in a language\-agnostic environment
* Candidates with experience in browser\-facing real\-time applications, serialization and wire protocols, resilience patterns, or large\-scale performance testing will have an added advantage


 Interested candidates can apply through our website: https://www.deshawindia.com/recruit/jobs/Ads/Link/PrncplMiddlewareApr26
   

  

 We encourage candidates with relevant experience looking to restart their careers after a break to apply for this position. Learn about Recommence, our gender\-neutral return\-to\-work initiative.
   

  

 The Firm offers excellent benefits, a casual, collegial working environment, and an attractive compensation package. For further information about our recruitment process, including how applicant data will be processed, please visit https://www.deshawindia.com/careers

title: Solutions Architect Manager, Cross Industries - Travel & Logistics
description:
**Description**
 Are you a technical leader who thrives on solving complex architectural challenges while building and growing high\-performing teams? Amazon is looking for a Solutions Architect Manager to lead a team of solutions architects who design and deliver scalable, reliable systems that directly impact how our customers experience our products and services. In this role, you will define the strategic direction for your team, partner with cross\-functional stakeholders, and drive architectural decisions that balance performance, cost, security, and operational excellence. You will navigate ambiguity, set clear goals, and establish the metrics that measure success — all while developing the next generation of technical talent on your team.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Define and communicate team vision, goals, and long\-term strategy by working backwards from customer problems, partnering with stakeholders across engineering, product, and business teams to align on priorities and architectural direction.
* Lead architectural reviews and drive system design decisions, evaluating tradeoffs across reliability, security, performance, and cost while ensuring solutions are scalable and maintainable over time.
* Build, grow, and manage an inclusive team of solutions architects, providing coaching, career development, and actionable feedback that empowers each team member to deliver results and advance their professional growth.
* Establish workflows, service level agreements, and audit mechanisms that ensure operational excellence, data\-driven decision\-making, and measurable quality across your team's deliverables.
* Identify opportunities to simplify processes and reduce complexity, leveraging generative artificial intelligence tools and reusable patterns to improve team productivity and accelerate solution delivery.


 A day in the life
   

  

 You might start your morning reviewing an architecture proposal from a team member, asking targeted questions that sharpen the design before a stakeholder review. After a quick sync with partner engineering teams to align on integration timelines, you shift into a one\-on\-one with a direct report to discuss their development goals and an upcoming stretch project. Later, you prepare a narrative for leadership that outlines your team's progress against quarterly objectives and flags emerging risks. Throughout, you balance hands\-on technical guidance with the strategic thinking needed to keep your team moving in the right direction.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Our team is focused on designing solutions that help Travel \& Logistics customers in India build and scale systems that they can rely on every day. We work closely with engineering, product, and business partners to turn complex requirements into clear, actionable architectures. We value collaboration, intellectual curiosity, and a commitment to operational rigor. As we look ahead, we are investing in new approaches to accelerate how we deliver solutions — and we want leaders who are excited to shape that future while building a team culture grounded in trust, inclusion, and continuous learning.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 10\+ years of architecting/operating solutions built on any cloud service provider like Azure, AWS, GCP, OCI, etc. experience
* 2\+ years of infrastructure architecture, database architecture and networking experience
* 8\+ years of technology solutions development and evangelising end\-to\-end technology roadmaps that guide IT transformations toward cloud computing experience
* Bachelor's degree
* Experience leading and growing teams of senior technology professionals, ideally in customer facing roles


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience in cloud architecture and CXO level engagement

title: Forward Deployed Engineering Leader- Microsoft AI Business Solutions
description:
**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**


At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well\-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80\-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI\-enabled insights and technology\-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.

**Job Description:**

**Crowe's Microsoft focused delivery practice brings together advisory, outcome delivery and managed services across Dynamics 365, Power Platform, Azure, data, automation and AI. The practice is expected to double over the next two years, and this role will help shape how our approximately 20 person India engineering team operates as it grows.**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**We are looking for an experienced engineering leader who has built strong teams, raised technical standards and improved how complex software is delivered. Deep experience with every Microsoft product is not required. What matters most is engineering judgment, people leadership, learning agility and the ability to work with platform specialists to make sound architecture and delivery decisions.**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**This is a player coach role. You will remain technically engaged through architecture reviews, critical design decisions, prototypes, complex delivery situations and customer conversations. You will not be expected to be the deepest specialist in every Microsoft technology, but you must be able to ask the right questions, challenge assumptions and help teams reach practical, defensible decisions.**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**What you will do**
--------------------

* **Build a high performing engineering organization with clear expectations for quality, ownership, collaboration, technical judgment and continuous improvement.**
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Set and evolve engineering and architecture standards across applications, data, cloud, automation, AI, security and integration, partnering with Dynamics 365, Power Platform and Azure specialists where deep platform expertise is needed.**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Stay close to the work by reviewing critical designs, contributing to prototypes and accelerators, helping resolve complex delivery issues and participating in important client conversations.**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Translate ambiguous business problems into practical solution approaches, including deciding when AI or an agentic workflow is appropriate and when better data, a clearer process or a deterministic solution will serve the client better.**
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Coach engineers, technical leads and architects; identify high potential talent; strengthen succession; influence performance decisions; and make difficult talent calls when needed.**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Improve the team's ability to work directly with business users, IT teams, architects and senior leaders, particularly when requirements are incomplete or business processes need to change.**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Help expand the practice across Power Platform, Azure, data, automation, Copilot and agentic AI by creating an environment in which specialists can learn from one another and apply strong engineering fundamentals consistently.**
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**What you will do, continued**
-------------------------------

* **Identify opportunities to automate delivery, reuse components and create Crowe intellectual property that reduces effort, improves quality and increases margin across multiple engagements.**
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Establish meaningful measures for throughput, cycle time, predictability, rework, defects, escalations, reuse and team health, then drive visible improvement against them.**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Support solution shaping, estimation, technical workshops, pre sales and executive discussions, connecting technical choices to client outcomes, delivery risk and commercial value.**
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Partner with practice leadership to turn repeatable delivery patterns into fixed fee or managed services offerings with clear scope, architecture, delivery playbooks and operating measures.**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**What success looks like**
---------------------------

**Within your first year, you will have:**
------------------------------------------

* **Raised the engineering bar. Teams are operating with clearer standards, stronger architecture discipline and greater ownership of difficult decisions.**
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Strengthened the leadership bench. Technical leads and high potential engineers are visibly more capable, and expectations and performance decisions are clearer.**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Improved delivery health. Predictability, cycle time, quality, escalations and rework are measured, understood and moving in the right direction.**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Put reuse to work. Components, delivery patterns, automation and AI enabled workflows are being applied across multiple engagements rather than remaining isolated within one project.**
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Built credibility across the Microsoft practice. Platform specialists see you as a leader who improves their decisions and effectiveness, even when they have deeper product expertise.**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Earned client trust. Clients and colleagues involve you in ambiguous, high consequence technical and delivery decisions.**
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Opened a stronger commercial path. The practice has a growing pipeline of repeatable fixed fee or managed services offerings supported by real delivery playbooks.**
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Developed practical fluency across Crowe's Microsoft portfolio and a clear understanding of where specialist depth is required.**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Required experience**
-----------------------

* **Ten or more years of software engineering experience, including at least five years leading engineering teams in a global or distributed environment.**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **A demonstrated record of building high performing teams, developing leaders, mentoring engineers and improving engineering culture and delivery outcomes.**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Strong technical foundations across modern application architecture, cloud platforms, APIs, integrations, data, security, automation and software delivery practices.**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Required experience, continued**
----------------------------------

* **Experience setting technical standards and leading architecture or design decisions across complex products, platforms or client engagements.**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Sufficient hands on depth to review designs, challenge technical assumptions, guide prototypes and lead teams through difficult engineering problems.**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Experience with AI enabled software, automation or data driven solutions, including the judgment to evaluate whether AI is appropriate for a business problem.**
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Strong client and executive communication skills, with the ability to translate between business outcomes, engineering tradeoffs and delivery risk.**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Experience leading through a meaningful business or engineering transformation that changed how work was performed, not simply which system was used.**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Comfort operating with ambiguity, taking ownership and making progress before every detail is known.**
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Preferred experience**
------------------------

* **Experience with one or more parts of the Microsoft business applications and cloud ecosystem, such as Dynamics 365, Power Platform, Dataverse, Azure, Microsoft Fabric, Copilot Studio, Azure OpenAI or Azure AI Search.**
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Experience in consulting or professional services, including scoped client engagements, solution shaping, estimation and technical workshops.**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Experience leading production AI enabled or agentic solutions with appropriate evaluation, security, governance and human oversight.**
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Exposure to fixed fee delivery, managed services, reusable intellectual property or other approaches that improve delivery leverage and margin.**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Business process experience in areas such as customer service, sales, field service, finance, operations, risk or compliance.**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**How we will support your success**
------------------------------------

**You will work closely with experienced Dynamics 365, Power Platform and Azure practitioners who provide deep product expertise. In turn, you will help those specialists apply stronger engineering methods, architecture discipline, people leadership and delivery practices. We expect you to build practical Microsoft fluency quickly, while being candid about where specialist input is needed.**
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Mindset we value**
--------------------

* **You make other engineers and leaders better, remain technically engaged and do not need to be the expert in every room.**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **You automate unnecessary work, communicate clearly, seek evidence, invite challenge and own outcomes across people, technology, delivery and clients.**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**What It Means to Be a Consultant at Crowe**

**Consulting is a dynamic business focused on solving problems for our clients and serving our core markets through innovative solutions. As technology and AI continue to reshape the consulting landscape, we are looking for individuals who are curious, adaptable, and eager to learn. At Crowe, consultants are expected to build both technical and transferable skills, think critically, and use technology to solve real business problems. In this role, you will continuously learn, collaborate across teams, and explore how tools, including emerging AI capabilities, can improve efficiency, insights, and client outcomes.**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**In management at Crowe, you play a pivotal role in leading teams, guiding project execution, and deepening client relationships. You are expected to contribute to account planning, identify opportunities to add value, and ensure high\-quality delivery. As your responsibilities expand, you take on broader account ownership, balancing project leadership with growing involvement in client strategy and solution development.**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Success in this role comes from a growth mindset, strong communication skills, advanced critical thinking, and the ability to navigate new challenges with confidence.**
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Beyond that, we're looking for someone who:**
-----------------------------------------------

* **Has an automation mindset — the instinct is to eliminate the work, not just scale the number of people doing it.**
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Communicates just as well in front of an engineering team as in front of a client's leadership, without needing two different vocabularies to do it.**
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Takes ownership without waiting for permission and is willing to move before the path is fully clear.**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Has led through a real business transformation before — a change in how work actually gets done, not just a system migration.**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe’s values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times.

**Our Benefits:**  

At Crowe, we know that great people are what makes a great firm. We value our people and offer employees a comprehensive benefits package. Learn more about what working at Crowe can mean for you!  

  

**How You Can Grow:**  

We will nurture your talent in an inclusive culture that values diversity. You will have the chance to meet on a consistent basis with your Career Coach that will guide you in your career goals and aspirations. Learn more about where talent can prosper!  

  

**More about Crowe:**


Crowe Capability Center – India, operating under the legal entity C3 India Delivery Centre LLP (formerly known as Crowe Horwath IT Services LLP) is a wholly owned subsidiary of Crowe LLP (U.S.A.), a public accounting, consulting and technology firm with offices around the world. The network consists of more than 200 independent accounting and advisory firms in more than 130 countries around the world.

We are committed to a merit\-based hiring process, evaluating all candidates consistently using objective, job\-related criteria such as relevant experience, demonstrated skills, measurable impact, and alignment with the role’s responsibilities, and making employment decisions in a fair and inclusive manner free from discrimination.

title: Chapter Lead & Senior Manager – Data Engineering

In a world where data is critical to BCG's success, we are building first\-class, foundational data capabilities and products that enable better decision\-making, generate new insights, and drive operational excellence across the firm. Within this vision, LEAP is building BCG's new Learning Functional Data product to power the firm's learning and development needs with trusted, well\-integrated data.

  

We are looking for a Chapter Lead \& Manager – Data Engineering to lead the Data Engineering and Data Ingestion function within LEAP. You will define the standards and guardrails for how we build, create strategic and well\-constructed data pipelines aligned to our enterprise\-wide data strategy, and grow a high\-performing team that delivers the most important data ingestion, integration and analytics use cases for the Learning Functional Data product.

  

Reporting to the Technical Team Lead (TTL) of LEAP, you will lead a team of 5–10 external Data Engineers and Data Ingestion Engineers across the delivery lifecycle, and partner closely with Chapter Leads in other squads, as well as the QA and Business Analysis (BA) teams, to deliver against squad commitments.

 **Your key accountabilities will include:**

* Lead, coach, and develop a team of 5–10 external Data Engineers and Data Ingestion Engineers, managing capacity, performance, and technical growth.
* Define data engineering standards, best practices, and guardrails for the chapter, and ensure they are consistently adopted across the squad.
* Design and build scalable, secure, and well\-integrated data pipelines and ingestion frameworks in line with the enterprise\-wide data strategy.
* Partner with the QA team to reduce defect leakage, improve release quality, and reduce time to fix defects.
* Partner with the BA team to translate business and functional requirements into robust technical solutions for the Learning Functional Data product.
* Collaborate with Chapter Leads across other squads to align on shared standards, promote reuse, and balance business needs against technical priorities.
* Increase sprint velocity through modern engineering practices such as DevSecOps, CI/CD, and cloud\-oriented delivery.
* Contribute towards hands\-on design, development, and code review, acting as a technical role model for the team.

  

What You'll Bring

**Education and Certifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Sciences, or a related field.
* 12\+ years of relevant IT experience with a major focus on data engineering / data\-related projects, preferably in large international organisations, including several years leading and managing engineering teams.

**Functional/Technical Skills**

* Strong hands\-on experience designing and building scalable data pipelines and ingestion frameworks.
* Strong SQL and ETL/ELT experience (e.g., DBT, Talend, FiveTran, or similar).
* Experience with cloud data platforms and warehouses such as Snowflake, AWS, and/or Azure.
* Experience leading Agile development teams and reviewing design and implementation against quality standards.
* Experienced in software/data delivery including CI/CD and related DevSecOps practices on cloud\-based platforms.
* Solid understanding of data modelling, data quality, testing, diagnostics, and performance tuning.
* Ability to develop process documentation, technical manuals, and standards.
* Familiar with Scrum and Kanban delivery methodologies and cross\-functional Agile teams (Product Owners, QA, BA, Architects, data SMEs).

  

Who You'll Work With


The Chapter Lead \& Manager – Data Engineering is a position within LEAP, part of BCG's digital products organisation. Reporting to the Technical Team Lead (TTL) of LEAP, you will lead a team of external Data Engineers and Data Ingestion Engineers and work closely with the QA team, the Business Analysis (BA) team, Product Owners, and Chapter Leads across other squads to deliver the Learning Functional Data product. You will also share and adopt best practices as part of the Chapter Leads community.

  

Additional info


YOU'RE GOOD AT


To be successful, you should bring sound data engineering and delivery experience, coupled with the ability to lead people and drive technical governance, integration, and cloud\-oriented strategies. Ideally, you thrive in an environment that requires strong problem solving, analytical, and decision\-making skills, alongside collaboration and open communication.

* Exceptional people leadership — building, coaching, and retaining high\-performing engineering teams.
* Verbal and written communication at both a business and technical level.
* Translating business and functional requirements into scalable technical solutions.
* Defining and evangelising data engineering standards and a data\-as\-a\-product mindset.
* Building relationships across squads and functions; a reliable team player who shows consideration and respect for others.
* High level of initiative, self\-motivation, resourcefulness, and collaboration.
* Performing successfully in a fast\-paced, multi\-cultural, and service\-oriented environment.
* Exhibiting ownership and accountability for squad deliverables, with strong attention to detail and prioritisation.
* Being flexible to be available outside of normal business hours for international calls as needed.  

  

*At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in\-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.*  

  

*For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.*

 Role Summary
   

  

 The Application \& Cloud Security Lead will serve as a key security leader within the S\&P Global Energy Division BISO team, responsible for coordinating security initiatives across application, cloud, and AI\-enabled environments. This role directly supports the protection of applications, data, systems, and reputation by proactively managing cyber risk, strengthening resilience and embedding security into everything we do.
   

  

 The successful candidate will partner with technology, product, engineering, cloud, risk, compliance, and business stakeholders to ensure security is integrated into architecture, delivery, operations, and innovation. The role will focus on security architecture reviews, application security governance, cloud security enforcement, AI security oversight, risk remediation, and alignment with enterprise cybersecurity standards.
   

  

 This position requires a hands\-on security leader who can translate cybersecurity requirements into practical controls, influence engineering teams, guide secure design decisions, and drive measurable improvements in cyber resilience across the Energy Division.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Lead and coordinate application, cloud, and AI security initiatives across the S\&P Global Energy Division in alignment with S\&P Global's cyber risk management objectives.
* Conduct security architecture reviews for applications, APIs, cloud platforms, data flows, integrations, and AI\-enabled solutions to identify risks and recommend secure design improvements.
* Partner with engineering, product, architecture, cloud, and business teams to embed security requirements into solution design, development, deployment, and operations.
* Enforce application security controls, including secure coding practices, vulnerability remediation, authentication, authorization, secrets management, dependency security, and software supply chain risk management.
* Oversee cloud security control implementation across public cloud environments, including identity and access management, network security, encryption, logging, monitoring, workload protection, and secure configuration.
* Review and assess AI and machine learning use cases for security risks, including data leakage, prompt injection, model exposure, access control, third\-party AI risk, and misuse scenarios.
* Track, prioritize, and drive remediation of application, cloud, and AI security findings, exceptions, and risk acceptances in partnership with accountable technology owners.
* Support cyber risk assessments, compliance reviews, audit requests, and security reporting related to Energy Division applications, cloud services, and AI\-enabled platforms.
* Develop and maintain metrics, dashboards, and executive\-level reporting to communicate security posture, risk trends, remediation progress, and key security initiatives.
* Serve as a trusted security advisor and liaison between the Energy Division and Enterprise cybersecurity teams, promoting secure\-by\-design practices and consistent adoption of security standards.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* 5\-8\+ years experience in cybersecurity, with a strong focus on application security, cloud security, security architecture, and/or technology risk management.
* Experience conducting security architecture reviews for applications, APIs, cloud platforms, data platforms, and enterprise technology solutions.
* Experience with DevSecOps, CI/CD security, container security, Kubernetes security, infrastructure\-as\-code scanning, secrets management, and software supply chain security.
* Experience with cloud security tools such as CSPM, CWPP, CNAPP, SIEM, vulnerability management platforms, container scanners, and identity governance tools.
* Familiar with AI security concepts such as prompt injection, model access control, sensitive data exposure, model monitoring, adversarial testing, AI red teaming, and third\-party AI risk.
* Experience working with public cloud environments such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
* Experience partnering with cross\-functional stakeholders including technology, product, risk, compliance, privacy, legal, and business teams.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical security risks to both technical and non\-technical audiences.

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**EY\-ServiceNow – Supervising Associate (Product Delivery Manager – Now Assist \& HRSD)**
**Role Overview:**
 The ServiceNow Product Delivery Manager is responsible for the end\-to\-end management and delivery of one or more ServiceNow technology solutions within EY. The role ensures that solutions are aligned with the overall EY ServiceNow strategy, integrate effectively within the enterprise technology ecosystem, and consistently deliver high\-quality business outcomes.
   

  

 As the primary representative and advocate of ET ServiceNow, the Product Delivery Manager is accountable for the success of assigned products and services. This includes ownership of product planning, roadmap development, backlog prioritization, stakeholder engagement, and delivery oversight throughout the product lifecycle. The Product Delivery Manager is accountable for evaluating emerging ServiceNow capabilities, aligning them with business objectives, driving stakeholder awareness and adoption through demonstrations and consultations, and establishing a prioritized roadmap and implementation backlog to maximize platform value.
   

  

 The role of Product Delivery Manager is responsible for the end\-to\-end management and delivery of ServiceNow solutions focusing on HR Service Delivery as well as Now Assist capabilities (including AI agents, agentic workflows and now assist skills). In addition, this role would lead implementations to make ServiceNow as an orchestrator to call multiple AI agents within and outside of ServiceNow using Model Context Protocol (MCP) or Agent\-to\-Agent protocol (A2A) to allow ServiceNow agents to invoke external data sets and APIs.
   

  

 The Product Delivery Manager ensures that solutions are delivered in accordance with governance standards, within agreed timelines and budgets, and meet quality, security, and user experience expectation.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
**Product Strategy \& Lifecycle Management:**
* Ensure products align with the EY ServiceNow strategy and broader enterprise technology objectives.
* Evaluate new ServiceNow platform capabilities and features, assess business value, and drive adoption opportunities.
* Develop and maintain the product implementation backlog based on business priorities and platform capabilities.


**Stakeholder Management:**
* Serve as the primary point of contact and trusted advisor between ET ServiceNow and business stakeholders.
* Collaborate with business teams to understand requirements, challenges, and strategic objectives.
* Translate business needs into scalable ServiceNow solutions while promoting platform best practices and standardization.
* Work with multiple stakeholders/ vendors to clear business/ technical impediments/ blockers


**Product backlog and Planning:**
* Own and govern the product backlog, ensuring alignment with business priorities and strategic goals
* Work closely with Product Owners to define, prioritize, and refine features, enhancements, and technical requirements
* Balance business demands with platform capabilities, technical constraints, and long\-term solution sustainability (strong functional understanding of ServiceNow is a must. Development experience expected).


**Delivery Management:**
* Successfully execute the project to agreed schedule, budget and scope
* Manage the demand process
* Monitor risks, dependencies, and delivery milestones, implementing mitigation plans as required.
* Coordinate with cross\-functional teams, including architecture, development, testing, operations, and vendors.
* Coordinate UAT and production go\-live


**Governance and Continuous improvement:**
* Establish and maintain governance processes for product performance, quality, and compliance.
* Track product KPIs, adoption metrics, and customer satisfaction measures.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to optimize business processes and maximize platform value.


**Innovation and Platform enablement:**
* Stay current with ServiceNow roadmap developments and emerging platform capabilities.
* Demonstrate new features and innovations to business stakeholders and leadership teams.
* Identify opportunities to improve user experience, operational efficiency, and business outcomes through ServiceNow.


**Knowledge and Skills Requirements:**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field
* 3\+ years of hands\-on experience in ServiceNow development.
* Understanding of ITIL processes and HR Services
* Understanding of conversational experiences, virtual agents, knowledge management, and self\-service adoption strategies.
* Implementation expertise of Now Assist capabilities (out of box and custom skills), agentic workflow and AI agents
* Experience in configuring out of box agentic workflows and implementing custom AI agents
* Understanding of A2A and MCP protocols
* Deep functional knowledge of LLMs, agentic patterns and API integration paths (REST)
* Advanced comprehension of agile SAFe project management methodology, tools and templates (includes project planning, schedule development, scope management and cost management)
* Strong problem\-solving, analytical, and communication skills
* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) certification


**What are we looking for?**
* A team player and leader with strong technical acumen and leadership capabilities
* Proactive problem\-solving mindset with a focus on operational excellence
* Ability to manage multiple stakeholders and priorities in a fast\-paced environment
* Passion to learn and adapt to new technologies
* Strong functional/ technical understanding of HRSD and ITSM applications.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.
