title: Senior Principal Technical Architect
description:
### **Why join Stryker?**


Looking for a place that values your unique talents? Discover Stryker's award\-winning culture.  

We are proud to offer you our total rewards package which includes bonuses, healthcare, insurance benefits, retirement programs, wellness programs, as well as service and performance awards – not to mention various social and recreational activities, all of which are location specific.### **Job description**


We are excited to be named one of the World’s Best Workplaces by Fortune Magazine!
  

We are proud to offer you our total rewards package which includes bonuses, healthcare, insurance benefits, retirement programs, wellness programs, as well as service and performance awards – not to mention various social and recreational activities, all of which are location specific. **What you will do:**

* Define and evolve the enterprise Data \& Analytics architecture vision, standards, and multi\-year roadmap, leveraging Azure, Databricks, and Lakehouse principles to deliver secure, scalable, and cost\-efficient platforms.
* Lead architecture for complex, business\-critical initiatives spanning multiple domains, ensuring seamless integration and harmonization of SAP and non\-SAP data across the enterprise ecosystem.
* Design and modernize enterprise data solutions that accurately replicate complex operational processes while supporting both current and historical business data needs.
* Drive large\-scale transformation programs by migrating commercial, manufacturing, and compensation reporting platforms to governed, Azure\-native architectures and overseeing legacy platform decommissioning.
* Establish and govern enterprise\-wide architecture standards, including data lineage, classification, security, access controls, integration frameworks, and data governance practices.
* Ensure all solutions meet regulatory, compliance, and security requirements, including SOX, GxP, SDLC, validation, and change management standards.
* Partner with senior Engineering, Product, and Business leaders to shape technology strategy, evaluate emerging technologies, and define the future direction of the data platform landscape.
* Advance the organization's AI readiness by enabling governed enterprise data consumption, semantic models, retrieval\-augmented solutions, and responsible adoption of generative and agentic AI capabilities.
* Serve as the highest\-level technical authority for complex architectural decisions while championing best practices, reusable design patterns, and engineering excellence across teams.
* Represent Data \& Analytics in enterprise architecture forums and mentor Principal Architects and senior engineers, fostering architectural maturity, innovation, and technical leadership across the organization.
  

What you need:

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field required; advanced degree
* **14\+ years of experience** in Enterprise Data Architecture, Solution Architecture, or Data Engineering, with a proven track record of defining and delivering enterprise\-scale technology strategies and multi\-year transformation roadmaps.
* Deep expertise in **Azure, Databricks, Lakehouse architectures, and modern cloud data platforms**, with hands\-on experience building secure, scalable, and governed data ecosystems.
* Strong experience integrating **SAP and enterprise ERP platforms** across commercial, supply chain, manufacturing, and finance domains, coupled with expertise in data governance, security, and regulatory compliance.
* Demonstrated ability to architect and lead complex, cross\-functional transformation initiatives, translating ambiguous business challenges into pragmatic, future\-ready technology solutions.
* Advanced knowledge of **data modeling, analytics, and BI architectures**, including Lakehouse design patterns, data warehousing, semantic models, and enterprise reporting frameworks.
* Understanding of emerging **AI and Generative AI technologies**, including enterprise knowledge retrieval, vector search, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), and modern AI platform architectures.
* Proven executive leadership skills with the ability to influence senior stakeholders, drive architectural governance, build consensus across diverse teams, and communicate complex technical concepts to business leaders.
* Recognized as a trusted technical leader and mentor, with experience elevating architecture practices, coaching senior architects and engineers, and fostering engineering excellence across the organization.
* Certifications such as **TOGAF, Azure Solutions/Data Architect, Databricks, or Microsoft Fabric** are highly preferred.

Stryker is a global leader in medical technologies and, together with its customers, is driven to make healthcare better. The company offers innovative products and services in MedSurg, Neurotechnology, Orthopaedics and Spine that help improve patient and healthcare outcomes. Alongside its customers around the world, Stryker impacts more than 150 million patients annually.

title: Principle Enterprise Solution Architect
description:
Achieving our goals starts with supporting yours. Grow your career, access top\-tier health and wellness benefits, build lasting connections with your team and our customers, and travel the world using our extensive route network.
   

  

 Come join us to create what’s next. Let’s define tomorrow, together.
   

  

**Description**
 United's Digital Technology team is comprised of many talented individuals all working together with cutting\-edge technology to build the best airline in the history of aviation. Our team designs, develops and maintains massively scaling technology solutions brought to life with innovative architectures, data analytics, and digital solutions.
   

  

**Job Overview And Responsibilities**
 The Principal Enterprise Architect for DevOps is a high\-impact leadership and "evangelist" role within the IT Application Development function. This individual is responsible for architecting the enterprise\-wide software delivery ecosystem, ensuring that application development teams can deploy code with maximum speed, security, and reliability. You will serve as a technical visionary, driving the adoption of modern DevOps practices and tools across the organization's application portfolio.
   

  

* Architectural Strategy \& Vision: Define the long\-term architectural roadmap for DevOps within IT Application Development, ensuring alignment between software engineering goals and infrastructure capabilities.
* DevOps Evangelism: Act as a primary advocate and subject matter expert for DevOps culture, mentoring engineering teams on modern delivery patterns and operational excellence.
* Platform Standardization: Design and govern a centralized framework for CI/CD pipelines, SCM structures, and infrastructure templates to ensure consistency and compliance across various application development projects.
* Infrastructure as Code (IaC) Leadership: Lead the design and implementation of scalable, automated infrastructure using Terraform and AWS to support high\-performance application environments.
* Containerization Strategy: Architect and oversee the deployment of containerized applications using Docker and Kubernetes, optimizing for performance, resource availability, and resilience.
* Tooling Excellence: Evaluate and manage the enterprise tech stack, with a focus on Harness or Jenkins, ensuring the integration of best\-in\-class performance monitoring and security tools.
* Performance \& Security Governance: Architect automated guardrails for infrastructure security and availability, ensuring that application delivery pipelines meet rigorous enterprise standards.


**This position is offered on local terms and conditions. Expatriate assignments and sponsorship for employment visas, even on a time\-limited visa status, will not be awarded. This position is for United Airlines Business Services Pvt. Ltd \- a wholly owned subsidiary of United Airlines Inc.**
**Qualifications**
**Qualifications \& Experience:**
* Seniority: Minimum of 15 to 20 years of experience in the IT industry, with a proven track record in high\-level architectural roles.
* Architectural Expertise: Extensive experience serving as an Architect or Technical Evangelist, with the ability to influence leadership and drive organizational change.
* Cloud \& Infrastructure: Deep technical proficiency in AWS and Terraform for large\-scale, enterprise\-grade cloud environments.
* DevOps Mastery: Expert knowledge of CI/CD orchestration platforms (specifically Harness or Jenkins) and Source Code Management (SCM) using Git.
* Containerization: Advanced hands\-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes orchestration in a production environment.
* Observability \& Security: Proficiency with enterprise\-grade tools for infrastructure performance monitoring, high availability, and security.
* Leadership Skills: Exceptional communication skills with the ability to bridge the gap between business strategy and technical execution.
* AI Vision: Experience in leveraging artificial intelligence for automating tasks, knowledge on Prompt engineering and Agentic AI. Expertise or hands\-on in AI/ML is an added advantage.
